name: Brookside
description: The ground-breaking soap set in a housing estate on the outskirts of Liverpool.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments The First Episode
videos.overview: Although he has nothing to go on, Paul Collins accuses one of his new neighbours of stealing his toilet. But Barry believes that Damon's poor spelling clears him of responsibilty for the graffiti found in Gordon's bedroom.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments The Siege 1985
videos.overview: The Close is evacuated, and the residents monitor the situation as it is reported on television. Harry becomes concerned when Edna goes to the toilet and doesn't come back.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments Sheila Grant's rape
videos.overview: Sally Dinsdale's husband has gone on the rampage, and she is fearful of what he might do. Sheila and Matty argue in the taxi home after class, and she gets out and walks into a horrific ordeal.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments Aftermath of the rape
videos.overview: Sheila arrives home shaken and dazed, and although she tells Bobby what happened, she doesn't want to involve the police. The police pick up a drunken Pat, who looks like he's been in a fight.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments Sue and Danny fall from the scaffolding
videos.overview: A day off work leads to disaster for Sue.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments The Jordache Murder
videos.overview: Ron helps to move Bev into her new flat, then Lyn sees him kissing her. DD feels that she needs to talk to someone neutral. Mandy and Beth's plan does not go entirely as they hoped.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments Jimmy Corkhill on drugs
videos.overview: The bad news is broken at the reception, and a distraught Lyn is at Frank's bedside when he dies. Jimmy decides he has got to get away.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments The Lesbian Kiss
videos.overview: Simon introduces Terry to his friends and to non-alcoholic lager, giving him something to think about. Ron is lost for words after a celebrity demolishes Tony's pile of pennies, and feels that there is no hope for Tony. Beth and Margaret kiss.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments Jimmy on drugs - Tony Dixon's Funeral
videos.overview: There are guilty secrets, the return of a face from the past, and a dramatic graveside confession at Tony's funeral.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments The Cult Suicide Pact
videos.overview: Joey drafts in flying pickets to prevent the "scab" labour arriving, but the police turn up too, and Eddie wonders who tipped management off. Ron makes another attempt to retrieve his clothes. Patricia is determined to continue working. Simon and Terry decide to make a final statement, which involves stealing Barry's car.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments Discovery of Jordache Body
videos.overview: The residents hold an extraordinary meeting, but as well as the main business, Max insists on bringing up Ron's fence, and David wants to talk about dog dirt. Mandy tries to convince Beth that she isn't really a lesbian. The discovery of Trevor means that Rachel has to be told the truth, and she flees.......

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments Nat and Georgia's incest
videos.overview: Lindsey discovers what Little Jimmy has brought home with him. Patricia receives the results of her tests. Danny, distraught at seeing Nat and Georgia in bed together, rushes into the path of Max's car.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments Start of Gas Explosion
videos.overview: Kylie is missing, several of the other residents are injured or trapped, and a second blast rocks the parade.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments End of Gas Explosion
videos.overview: Time is running out for the trapped residents, and real bravery is required from some of the others.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments Antony kills Imelda
videos.overview: Jacqui finally admits defeat, and tells Max that she wants to go back to work. Emily worries that Tim's luck will run out one day. Leanne boasts that she has a star witness in her battle against Bev, not realising that he has been forbidden to say anything in her favour. Anthony suffers a worst humiliation than ever before at the hands of Imelda and Paige.

videos.title: Most Memorable Moments The Siege 2002 & Helicopter crash
videos.overview: Gary feels that Gabby doesn't understand him, but maybe Nisha does. Stuart discovers that Luke's face was cut while he was staying with Sean. Ruth thinks that Kirsty is holding something back. Psycho becomes increasingly frustrated at missing out on a pool final, and another hostage is released.

videos.title: Episode 1 - Bollocks
videos.overview: Although he has nothing to go on, Paul Collins accuses one of his new neighbours of stealing his toilet. But Barry believes that Damon's poor spelling clears him of responsibilty for the graffiti found in Gordon's bedroom.

videos.title: Episode 2 - Mass
videos.overview: The Grants are taken to church by the Collins when there car breaks down and Heather wants Roger to come back to bed instead of watching what is going on in the Close.

videos.title: Episode 3 - Shortage
videos.overview: Paul registers for benefit, Lucy struggles at the local comprehensive.school, realising that her posh voice and background will be a disadvantage. Barry has a dodgy suggestion for Annabelle.

videos.title: Episode 4 - Productivity
videos.overview: Roger tries to assemble a shelving unit, despite having not enough screws and no instructions. Bobby plans a strike at work, and there are cookers on the move on the Close.......

videos.title: Episode 5 - Cost
videos.overview: Paul's digging amuses Damon and his friends. Barry tells a horrific tale of an accident on the building site. Karen brings home her new boyfriend, Demon Duane.......

videos.title: Episode 6 - Diminishing Returns
videos.overview: Heather wonders why Paul is always at home, Roger is becoming agitated about the cookers in the next garden, Karen's period starts, and a strike looks imminent.

videos.title: Episode 7 - Gav and Pet
videos.overview: New neighbours arrive.......in a large frozen meat truck. Karen wants to persuade Bobby and Sheila to allow her to go on holiday, and Heather gets her revenge on Roger.

videos.title: Episode 8 - Humping
videos.overview: Barry makes Duane understand that boasting about his "conquest" of Karen was really not a very good idea. Meanwhile, Lucy is being physically intimidated at school.

videos.title: Episode 9 - Burgled
videos.overview: The whole close is burgled, but Petra has more reasons to be upset than most. Not only are her house contents not insured even though she works for an insurance company, but she is still not pregnant.

videos.title: Episode 10 - Property Values
videos.overview: A buyer for Gavin's cookers turns up at the Huntingtons'. Barry tries to persuade Sheila to bump up their insurance claim.

videos.title: Episode 11 - Intervention
videos.overview: Sheila is hassled, Bobby is pressurised, Gavin is visited by the council and given a week to dispose of his cookers, and Arthur dies.

videos.title: Episode 12 - Home Improvements
videos.overview: Gavin plans revenge, Barry delivers his new doors, and Petra fills in her chart. Damon advises Karen to keep quiet about her decision for the moment.

videos.title: Episode 13 - Burglar Alarm
videos.overview: Roger has an alarm installed, Gordon is resentful, Lucy is being followed, Petra is ovulating and Barry is stabbed.

videos.title: Episode 14 - Insecurities
videos.overview: Roger does his Christmas shopping, all of which is then stolen. Bobby is under increased pressure to end the strike as Christmas approaches.

videos.title: Episode 15 - Ill-mannered
videos.overview: Lucy is rescued from a kiss under the mistletoe by one of her class-mates. Karen wants to go to a party instead of attending the midnight Mass. Derek makes a pass at Heather.

videos.title: Episode 16 - Christmas Spirit
videos.overview: It is an upsetting Christmas for the Collins family, while Karen has a hangover, Bobby has an emergency meeting, Roger's burglar alarm goes off again, and Damon has no presents.

videos.title: Episode 17 - Bit of Business
videos.overview: Barry is determine to get revenge on his attacker, Paul receives some encouraging news, but Petra is still feeling fed up and depressed.

videos.title: Episode 18 - Open House
videos.overview: The Grants invite all their neighbours to their New Year's Eve party. Roger and Heather return home, and discover that their alarm has been tampered with, and Gavin has erected a multicoloured shed to house his cookers.

videos.title: Episode 19 - The Real World
videos.overview: Paul has a job interview and is confident that he has done well. Annabelle starts making clothes for Lucy as part of her economy drive. Bobby goes back to work after the strike, and finds that some of his co-workers are angry

videos.title: Episode 20 - Too Good To Be True
videos.overview: Paul jumps to some wrong conclusions. Petra becomes more obsessed with having a baby. Sheila makes a decision, and Damon invites his mates over.

videos.title: Episode 21 - Individualism
videos.overview: Karen and Sheila go shopping, while the rest of the family go to watch a football match. Roger joins a badminton club, and Paul suggests a trip to the Lakes to visit Annabelle's mother - but Lucy refuses to go.

videos.title: Episode 22 - Money
videos.overview: Annie's financial worries begin to trouble Sheila, and Barry discovers that he may also have some money problems. Lucy is amused that, without Paul knowing, Annabelle is looking for work.

videos.title: Episode 23 - Nothing's Easy
videos.overview: Damon almost reveals that Karen is on the Pill. Paul wants Annabelle to stay at home, but she would prefer to do some supply teaching. There is more bad news at work for Sheila.

videos.title: Episode 24 - The Poverty Trap
videos.overview: Roger's attempt to take up jogging are not successful. The boys' school reports are not good, so Damon has some serious grovelling to do. Sheila confronts Annie, although Barry has no sympathy.

videos.title: Episode 25 - Measuring
videos.overview: Barry has to back down in a heated argument with Victor, but then finds himself being propositioned by Eric's wife. Meanwhile, Sheila finds contraceptives in his bedroom, and is determined to find out whose they are.

videos.title: Episode 26 - Copped
videos.overview: Barry's denials when Eric confronts him after hearing rumours of his liaisons with Irene seem convincing enough, but he is not as good at explaining to Sheila why he has contraceptive pills in his bedroom. A TV Enquiry Officer visits the Close, and someone hasn't got a licence.......

videos.title: Episode 27 - Prospects
videos.overview: Sheila is told that Damon has been playing truant. Gavin and Petra have a blazing row, and he storms out, telling her that she will see him in the morning - if she's lucky. Petra's response is to throw a tray through the glass door after him.

videos.title: Episode 28 - He Was Younger Than Me
videos.overview: Petra awakens in the morning to discover that Gavin has died in his bed during the night, and has to be comforted by her brother-in-law George, her neighbours Roger and Heather, and - especially - Barry.

videos.title: Episode 29 - Inertia
videos.overview: Annabelle becomes exasperated when her car is caught behind Gavin's funeral cortege and she runs out of petrol. Paul resolves to be more decisive and find himself a job.

videos.title: Episode 30 - Campaign Plan
videos.overview: Lucy attends a meeting at school, expresses her grievances and tries to stir up some action. Sheila is not convinced that Karen should be on the Pill, and goes to speak to her doctor. Jeff reveals that Duane has been badly beaten up.

videos.title: Episode 31 - Intent
videos.overview: tries to set his relationship with Carol on a firmer footing. Redundancies look certain to occur, as one plant at Bobby's work is to be closed down. Sheila seeks advice from her priest.

videos.title: Episode 32 - Sides
videos.overview: Gordon is invited to an all-night party, but Paul wants him to be home by 10.30pm. Matty receives a redundancy notice, and is disappointed when Bobby seems unwilling to use his influence to help him. Carol is not impressed when she meets Barry's bit on the touchline.

videos.title: Episode 33 - Verbal Volleyball
videos.overview: Annabelle has an unexpected visitor, while Roger and Heather battle over Derek's dinner party. Damon steals Karen's Valentine card, and takes it to show to everyone at school.

videos.title: Episode 34 - Social Studies
videos.overview: Matty and Teresa have dinner with Bobby and Sheila, and end up arguing over redundancies. Meanwhile, Heather and Roger dine with Derek and Angela and their other guests - and Derek hints to Heather that Roger's career could depend on how co-operative she is.......

videos.title: Episode 35 - Rates
videos.overview: Damon steams open the wrong letter. Barry and Frank are horrified by Petra's attitude and her detemination to get Gavin completely out of her life.

videos.title: Episode 36 - Altruism
videos.overview: Annabelle tries to convince Paul that he cannot claim free meals for Gordon at his private school. Barry and Frank plan a surprise for Petra, but she has a bigger surprise for Barry.

videos.title: Episode 37 - About Damon
videos.overview: The Huntingtons are burgled again, and Roger sets off around the Close to interrogate his neighbours. The Educational Welfare Officer visits the Grants to find out why Damon has been missing school.

videos.title: Episode 38 - Closed Shop
videos.overview: Redundancy in the Grant household forces Damon and Karen to think of ways of earning cash. But Barry brightens the day by bringing home paint for the planned redecoration.

videos.title: Episode 39 - Donkey Work
videos.overview: When Petra's boss makes a pass at her, Michelle suggests that Petra tells him that she is pregnant. There are differing views over how a ratepayers' association should be run.

videos.title: Episode 40 - A Stay-Behind
videos.overview: Sheila waits at home while Bobby and his mates endlessly drink and drivel after-hours about nothing of any significance or interest.

videos.title: Episode 41 - Hard to Get
videos.overview: The Huntingtons suspect that they have another intruder, and they're right. Damon is stranded in the bungalow after arguing with his mates. Lucy tells Gordon of her doubts about her relationship with Jonathan.

videos.title: Episode 42 - Camp Beds
videos.overview: Roger's parents visit for Easter, and his father's offers to help around the house don't go down too well. Gordon suggests that Lucy should give Jonathan a taste of his own medicine.

videos.title: Episode 43 - Paving Stones
videos.overview: It's time for church, but Karen and Damon have gone missing. Sydney sees Barry laying paving stones for Petra, and asks whether he could get some for Roger. Lucy drops Gordon right in it.

videos.title: Episode 44 - Gentle Persuasion
videos.overview: After Michelle expresses doubts that they should be spending so much time together, Petra and Barry talk things over. Meanwhile Sydney makes Damon pay when he catches him doing something naughty in church.

videos.title: Episode 45 - Which Way Is South?
videos.overview: Alan measures the bungalow, but can he find anybody who knows enough geography to help him out? Roger invites everyone for a drink to celebrate his and Sydney's birthdays. Lucy practises for her stint on "What The Papers Say".

videos.title: Episode 46 - Party
videos.overview: Damon and his friends become uneasy about Alan, but their fears prove unfounded. The Huntingtons' party doesn't go as planned.

videos.title: Episode 47 - Oscillations
videos.overview: Paul suspects Barry of stealing his paving stones. Samantha resists Alan's invitation to more into the bungalow with him. Karen is threatened with suspension from school for swearing at a teacher.

videos.title: Episode 48 - Hypocrites
videos.overview: Bobby and Sheila have a fun evening out, followed by a full-scale row with Karen when she reveals that she no longer intends to go to church.

videos.title: Episode 49 - Perks
videos.overview: Barry resorts to drastic action when his boss, Ted, confronts him about removing materials from the building site. Alan chats to Michelle, and invites her to come and look at his computer. Lucy makes a new friend.

videos.title: Episode 50 - Learners
videos.overview: Heather is studying for her exams and feeling tetchy. Lucy decides to go to a CND rally. When she hears that Barry and Terry are planning to go into business together, Michelle suggests that Petra could do their secretarial work.

videos.title: Episode 51 - Stepladders
videos.overview: Bobby has some advice for Jonah, whose one-night-stand with Jean leaves him feeling lonely. Gordon tells Annabelle she is turning into Brookside's "iron lady" - but can she persuade Alan to join the ratepayers' association?

videos.title: Episode 52 - Access
videos.overview: When Jonah's aggression in court leads to his rights of access to his son becoming restricted, Bobby persuades him to appeal. Paul plans to sell his car, and Alan asks Samantha to marry him.

videos.title: Episode 53 - Gossip
videos.overview: Against Michelle's advice, Marie visits Sheila to explain why Barry is becoming too involved with Petra. Lucy and Gordon hatch a plot to enable her to go to the CND rally with Janice. Someone comes to stay with Heather while Roger is away.

videos.title: Episode 54 - Rumblings
videos.overview: Heather and Polly play scrabble, and compare their prospects. Lucy is disappointed with the small turnout at the demonstration. Petra and Barry are both annoyed when they discover that Marie spoke to Sheila about them.

videos.title: Episode 55 - Looking Forward
videos.overview: Although Annabelle visits Sheila to remind her about the ratepayers' meeting, Roger is the only one who turns up. Samantha increases Sheila's fears about Bobby's job by telling her she suspects Fairbanks will be closing soon.

videos.title: Episode 56 - Special Occaision
videos.overview: The Collins family celebrate Annabelle's birthday, while Bobby plans to take Sheila to London for the final of the F.A. Cup. Damon is sent home from school, suffering from lovesickness - and marriage still doesn't appeal to Samantha.

videos.title: Episode 57 - Mild Beer
videos.overview: Gordon attempts to convincingly order a drink in a pub. Barry's confrontation with Dave results in Petra quitting her job.

videos.title: Episode 58 - Thought and Effort
videos.overview: Barry pays Karen to cook lunch for him and Petra - but she goes out and it is burned. Tempers flare, and Petra storms out, doubting that Barry really wants to be with her.

videos.title: Episode 59 - Knocked for Six
videos.overview: Paul is recalled for a job interview, but decides not to take the position because he feels it is beneath his capabilities. Heather argues with Roger, who is then run over by a bus.

videos.title: Episode 60 - Comfortable
videos.overview: Now that his ribs are broken, Roger is reconciled with Heather. Annabelle goes to a district ratepayers' meeting, and Paul has another interview.

videos.title: Episode 61 - Forewarned
videos.overview: George Williams gives Bobby confidential and disturbing news about the factory's future, and Sheila dreads the conflicts that may follow. Michelle attempts to heal the rift between Barry and Petra, but Marie may not approve of their holiday plans.

videos.title: Episode 62 - Getting Old
videos.overview: A chance meeting with Barry affects Alan's holiday plans. Sheila fears that she and Bobby will have less time together, even though the factory closure seems even more likely.

videos.title: Episode 63 - Foursome
videos.overview: Michelle and the Grants awaken to discover that Petra and Barry have sneaked off to the Isle of Man for a holiday.......but so have Alan and Samantha!

videos.title: Episode 64 - Mysterious Ways
videos.overview: Barry and Petra sneak out of the hotel early in the hope of escaping from Alan and Samantha. When Petra begins to feel unwell, she thinks it's the baby.

videos.title: Episode 65 - Recuperating
videos.overview: Marie and Michelle visit Petra, who is in hospital after having a miscarriage. Barry offers to give them a lift home. Heather and Roger talk about their marriage, but Roger is summoned into work.

videos.title: Episode 66 - Inadequacies
videos.overview: Paul has another interview.......at the Dole office. Roger and Heather argue about work and starting a family.

videos.title: Episode 67 - Better Things to Do
videos.overview: Damon goes skating with Elsa, who then goes off with her mates. Lucy goes on a demonstration instead of sitting an exam.

videos.title: Episode 68 - In Clink
videos.overview: Paul goes to the police station, and Lucy is released with a caution. Damon and Elsa decide just to be good friends.

videos.title: Episode 69 - Dinner
videos.overview: As her final exams approach, the pressure is getting to Heather - and when she walks out after an argument with Roger, he rings another woman.... Alan and Samantha encourage Bobby to teach Sheila to drive. Annabelle is not convinced that their troubles with Lucy are over.

videos.title: Episode 70 - Stupid Rows
videos.overview: Petra tries to start facing the future. Heather and Roger are meant to be celebrating, but he doesn't come home. Karen gets her CSE results.

videos.title: Episode 71 - Thinking Badly
videos.overview: Gordon goes to look at Alan's computer. Jonah tries to placate Annabelle and Paul after Lucy's arrest. Roger reacts angrily to Heather's impulsive spending.

videos.title: Episode 72 - Summer Madness
videos.overview: Gordon and Lucy are uncomfortable about how close Annabelle seems to be with Robin Tate. Karen, Pauline and Susi go into town to investigate starting up a new venture.

videos.title: Episode 73 - Just Like Gavin
videos.overview: When Barry refuses to do Petra's decorating, Terry volunteers. Bobby is concerned when Alan Torenson questions him, fearing that the secret report has been leaked.

videos.title: Episode 74 - Stretch Covers
videos.overview: Practising her driving alone, Sheila crashes into Alan's car. Petra believes Gavin has returned from the dead, but it's someone else.

videos.title: Episode 75 - New Image
videos.overview: Gordon chooses a jacket that will "express his personality". Lucy loses her knickers. Roger misses out on a partnership, but Paul is offered a job, and decides to accept it.

videos.title: Episode 76 - Human Nature
videos.overview: Roger tells Heather a convincing lie about where he was last night. Lucy and Gordon discover that the family holiday will have to be postponed.

videos.title: Episode 77 - Straight Choice
videos.overview: The closure of the factory is announced, and redundancy is now only 90 days away for Bobby and Jonah. Meanwhile, someone is lurking in the undergrowth and observing the residents of the Close...

videos.title: Episode 78 - Working Away
videos.overview: Sheila is upset at the possibility that Bobby may have to seek work abroad, and even more upset when Barry leaves for London with her kidney fund money. Roger is worried when he is spotted dining out with his rich client.

videos.title: Episode 79 - Pane
videos.overview: Roger helps to mend Michelle's cassette recorder - but Damon is equally keen to repair Samantha's broken window.

videos.title: Episode 80 - Ghosts
videos.overview: Damon and Gizzmo play a trick on Karen and Susi while they are sunbathing. Bobby persuades Sheila to take a holiday in Anglesey. Petra returns home from the shops, packs a suitcase, and leaves home.

videos.title: Episode 81 - Over-reacting
videos.overview: Petra's car is found, and Alan mistakes the detective who arrives to speak to Michelle for the flasher. Lucy storms out after Annabelle slaps her during an argument.

videos.title: Episode 82 - She's All Right
videos.overview: Gordon reveals that Lucy is staying at Janice's. Mr Johnston thinks Heather is a secretary, then discovers that she is his accountant. Marie is convinced that Petra will come home.

videos.title: Episode 83 - She Wouldn't
videos.overview: A policewoman tells Michelle that Petra may have committed suicide. Paul convinces Lucy to come home. A chance remark cause Heather to become suspicious of Roger.

videos.title: Episode 84 - Long Holiday
videos.overview: Annabelle and Paul suggest that Lucy goes to France for six months, and she agrees. Heather discovers that Roger isn't where he should be - but she doesn't know where he is. Sheila decides that if Bobby isn't going to fight, she will...

videos.title: Episode 85 - Temperamental
videos.overview: Maureen Lomax arrives to collect the kidney machine money from Sheila, who can only give her a cheque. Heather accuses Roger of being unfaithful.

videos.title: Episode 86 - Inscrutable
videos.overview: A parcel arrives for Heather, but it might not distract her from questioning Roger about his movements. Barry returns home, but he is not alone. Lucy and Karen receive their O-level results, and there are more birthday celebrations in the Close.

videos.title: Episode 87 - Six in a Bed
videos.overview: Sheila is convinced that Val is not really unable to speak English, and proves it by having Alan pretend to by a fluent Chinese speaker. Diane gives Roger an expensive tie-pin for services rendered.

videos.title: Episode 88 - Bon Voyage
videos.overview: Diane wants Roger to go away on holiday with him, so he tells Heather more lies. Damon gets into more trouble, and Lucy leaves to spend six months in France.

videos.title: Episode 89 - Seperation Orders
videos.overview: On Paul's first day in his new job, he is called up for jury service. Roger is reluctant to commit himself to going on a holiday to Corfu with Heather. In return for a favour, Alan lets Val move in with him for a while.

videos.title: Episode 90 - Approaching the Crunch
videos.overview: Paul has to deal with a problematic trainee. Diane and Heather finally come face-to-face.

videos.title: Episode 91 - Bird Droppings
videos.overview: Damon and his mates find a new way of making mischief. Alan has a setback in his bid to earn more than Samantha.

videos.title: Episode 92 - Cliches
videos.overview: Heather receives her exam results, but Roger is too busy with Diane to ask her if she has passed.

videos.title: Episode 93 - Collapsing
videos.overview: Barry goes shopping for Bobby and Sheila's anniversary. Bobby discusses the factory closure with George Williams, and Heather and Roger fight. Annabelle has an unexpected guest.

videos.title: Episode 94 - You Sod!!
videos.overview: Marie finds a letter from Petra, and calls the police. Heather hears conclusive proof that Roger is having an affair with Diane, and throws him out.

videos.title: Episode 95 - Soaking
videos.overview: Roger gets a shock when he goes to see Diane again. Bobby and Sheila plan their 25th wedding anniversary party.

videos.title: Episode 96 - Memory Lane
videos.overview: Both Samantha and Val think a message Alan has left is for them. Sydney prepares to escort Heather, and Gizzmo is beaten up.

videos.title: Episode 97 - Worker's Wives
videos.overview: Sheila tries to set up an action committee. Barry tries to tempt Terry. Alan's bottom is bitten during a rugby match.

videos.title: Episode 98 - Neighbourliness
videos.overview: Barry and Terry's attempts to store their knock-off jeans are continually thwarted. Alan discovers who bit his bottom. The residents meet their new neighbours - Edna and Harry Cross.

videos.title: Episode 99 - Jack and Gill
videos.overview: While Heather visits her parents in Belfast, Roger returns to the Close and almost burns her house down.

videos.title: Episode 100 - Dulce
videos.overview: Heather talks to Will about her marriage, and prepares for life on her own. Annabelle takes Sheila for a driving lesson.

videos.title: Episode 101 - Fund Raising
videos.overview: Annabelle gets carried away, Sheila joins the picket line, and Barry and Terry discover that some of their jeans have gone missing.

videos.title: Episode 102 - Jeans
videos.overview: Sheila is disappointed when the newspaper coverage of the pocket line is dominated by Samantha. Terry and Barry are not the only ones selling jeans....

videos.title: Episode 103 - White Elephants
videos.overview: Sheila is invited to appear on television, and George buys Paul's cardigan at the bring and buy sale.

videos.title: Episode 104 - Good Cause
videos.overview: Sydney takes Heather and Roger out for the day in an attempt to reconcile them. Sheila puts forward strong arguments in her interview, but returns home to bad news.

videos.title: Episode 105 - Mischief Night
videos.overview: Bobby tries to negotiate a fair settlement, Barry and Terry need some cable, and Marie's washine machine needs to be repaired.

videos.title: Episode 106 - On the Fire
videos.overview: The Jacksons' bonfire has some surprising contents. Marie finds that her kitchen is full of water. Mike tells Karen he is joining the Army.

videos.title: Episode 107 - Daylight Robbery
videos.overview: Harry and Edna move in. While Harry tells Paul about his boxing medals, Mark steals them - but Damon and Gizzmo are blamed.

videos.title: Episode 108 - What You've Lost
videos.overview: Paul and Heather see Gizzmo being beaten up by his brother. Damon fights with Mark, and wins - but Bobby tells him off.

videos.title: Episode 109 - Gnomes
videos.overview: When Harry's attention is diverted, Damon and Gizzmo start moving his gnomes around. Barry helps Samantha retrieve a valuable disk Alan has accidentally dropped behind a cabinet, but then she spills coffee on it.

videos.title: Episode 110 - Age of Opportunity
videos.overview: Barry works on Bobby's car. Gordon and Mark go to a recording studio to hand in their demo tape. Gordon asks the receptionist for a date, but she turns him down.

videos.title: Episode 111 - Small Mercies
videos.overview: Sheila and Karen go to bingo, and Karen wins £75. Alan continues his search for the missing disk, and blames Gordon when it turns up damaged.

videos.title: Episode 112 - Foibles
videos.overview: Karen arrives home late with Mike, and Bobby throws him out. Karen and Bobby then argue over her giving away her bingo winnings.

videos.title: Episode 113 - Shopping Lists
videos.overview: Paul tries to pacify Jack when he discovers Gordon has the stolen drum-box. Everyone on the Close is having car trouble.

videos.title: Episode 114 - Outdoor Mechanics
videos.overview: Barry and Terry go to the beach to burn the Jaguar, but discover they haven't enough petrol. When they return with some, they find the car is sinking into the sand.

videos.title: Episode 115 - The Pit
videos.overview: Marie decides to try to contact Petra by putting an ad in the paper. Heather is invited to the firm's annual dinner with Roger and feels that she can't tell her boss that her marriage has broken up.

videos.title: Episode 116 - New Order
videos.overview: When Alan refuses to tell Harry why he has dug a pit, he starts to fill it in. Heather spends a day at Mr Johnston's printing firm in Billinge, and agrees to let Polly come and stay with her.

videos.title: Episode 117 - Sardines
videos.overview: Harry discovers that some of his gnomes are up Alan's Christmas tree, and that his is the only garden without a sapling. Marie and Michelle face a gruesome task. Heather and Polly gain a third lodger.

videos.title: Episode 118 - So Thoughtless
videos.overview: Polly and Sydney disturb Heather when she has work to do at home. Harry is asked to dress up as Father Christmas. Samantha returns home earlier than expected.

videos.title: Episode 119 - Nothing Serious
videos.overview: As Christmas approaches, Heather battles to save her client's business. Marie receives news that George has been injured and taken to hospital. Bobby and Matty deliver Christmas hampers, and Barry and Terry try to sell dodgy perfume.

videos.title: Episode 120 - Not Beaten Yet
videos.overview: Heather dashes back to Ireland, Marie and Michelle discover that Petra has sent them a Christmas card, and Barry and Terry discover a more profitable use for their perfume.

videos.title: Episode 121 - Nothing's Changed
videos.overview: Having Lucy home for Christmas doesn't improve Annabelle's mood, but can she be persuaded to see a doctor? Mike hears a few tales when he returns home on leave from the Army.

videos.title: Episode 122 - Survivors
videos.overview: The Collins family have a party on New Year's Eve, but Gordon is out getting drunk elsewhere. Mike comes to visit Karen, but ends up playing cards with Barry and Terry.

videos.title: Episode 123 - Long Johns
videos.overview: Harry loses his underwear. Annabelle goes to the doctor. The Huntingtons' burglar alarm goes off again.

videos.title: Episode 124 - Beyond Repair
videos.overview: The long johns thief is exposed. Sheila decides to set up an agency, and, after an argument with Marie, vows never to speak to her again.

videos.title: Episode 125 - Workmanship
videos.overview: Annabelle and Marie clean Heather's house. Samantha asks Alan to marry her. Paul has more problems with Skelly.

videos.title: Episode 126 - Sound Advice
videos.overview: Annabelle wants to have her hair done in case she is invited to Alan's wedding, but her telephone isn't working. Paul discusses how the YTS scheme is progressing with his boss.

videos.title: Episode 127 - Alan's Mother
videos.overview: When Alan hears that his mother is on the way to visit him, his extensive preparations including convincing Samantha to move out of the bungalow for a few days.

videos.title: Episode 128 - The Wrong Time
videos.overview: Molly finally meets Samantha, whose boss gives her something to think about as her wedding day approaches. Paul tells Annabelle that their medical insurance has lapsed. Marie and George can now go home - but do they want to?

videos.title: Episode 129 - Bad Luck
videos.overview: Marie tries to convince George that they should continue to live at Petra's. It's Alan and Samantha's wedding day, but not quite everything goes according to plan.

videos.title: Episode 130 - Bad News
videos.overview: Molly believes that Alan has been taken for a mug, and tries to dispose of his photo of Samantha. Marie and Michelle are at loggerheads over who should stay on at number 10, but then they have an unexpected visitor bringing bad news.

videos.title: Episode 131 - Muesli
videos.overview: Barry has to decide whether he should go to Petra's funeral. Alan discovers that Molly has fed his muesli to the birds. Harry finds a betting slip in Edna's purse.

videos.title: Episode 132 - Mummy's Boy
videos.overview: Harry prepares for a visit from his son, but he doesn't know that Kevin has told Edna he is living with a married woman and her daughter. When Mrs O'Rourke tells Marie it is what Petra wants, she and George move back to the Close.

videos.title: Episode 133 - Worrying
videos.overview: When Damon is sent out of his domestic science class, he discovers an ingenious use for a piece of clingfilm. Kevin worries about how Harry will react to his secret.

videos.title: Episode 134 - Disgraceful
videos.overview: While waiting to see his head of year, Damon invites Pat to the Valentine's Day disco. Harry confronts Edna about her betting.

videos.title: Episode 135 - Valentines
videos.overview: Everyone is waiting for Valentine cards, but who will receive them? Terry's tricks rebound. Heather has an interview.

videos.title: Episode 136 - Going Without
videos.overview: Damon faces suspension, Matty wants to fiddle his electricity meter, and Annabelle bows out of the ratepayers' association.

videos.title: Episode 137 - Market Forces
videos.overview: Heather's boss tries to convince her to change her mind about resigning. Barry thinks he has won a bet - but the arrival of a stranger from Ireland may change things.

videos.title: Episode 138 - All or Nothing
videos.overview: Bobby is more willing to help Matty with his problems than to help Sheila with hers. Terry pretends to be injured to avoid having to go jogging with Michelle.

videos.title: Episode 139 - Catalogue Stuff
videos.overview: Marie is not convinced that the Jacksons now face a better future. Karen receives a letter from Mike.

videos.title: Episode 140 - Blind Drunk
videos.overview: Damon plans to get drunk with Gizzmo to celebrate his 16th - or 4th - birthday. Heather has no shortage of willing helpers when her car won't go.

videos.title: Episode 141 - Blabbermouth
videos.overview: Harry is not pleased to find that Edna has discussed his attitude to Kevin with Marie. Sheila spots a tiny flaw in Karen's boycott plans.

videos.title: Episode 142 - Etiquette
videos.overview: Marie gets a shock when her long-lost father turns up. Heather gives Sheila some book-keeping advice. Harry and Edna try a spot of match-making.

videos.title: Episode 143 - King Rat
videos.overview: Ted tells Karen why he must refuse to support her campaign. Annabelle and Paul have a win on the premium bonds.

videos.title: Episode 144 - Tights
videos.overview: Robin asks Annabelle to be his election agent. Michelle finds that her tights have gone missing, but soon the Jacksons face a more difficult predicament

videos.title: Episode 145 - Transport
videos.overview: Even though Barry is without a car, he is determined to keep his promise to take Heather to the airport. Davey is shocked to discover the terms of Petra's will.

videos.title: Episode 146 - Off
videos.overview: Davey leaves, taking Michelle's catalogue money with him. A "For Sale" sign outside Heather's house causes speculation among her neighbours.

videos.title: Episode 147 - Dodging
videos.overview: Edna goes with Jessica to choose a mother's day present for Sally. Michelle insists that Barry takes Terry to hospital.

videos.title: Episode 148 - Mother's Day
videos.overview: There are surprises all round as Mother's Day and April Fools' Day coincide. Tommy McArdle turns up at the Grants' with some advice for Barry.

videos.title: Episode 149 - Cynicism
videos.overview: Robin needs to deliver his election nomination papers, but the Jacksons' dog is squatting on his car seat. Marie very nearly calls a truce.

videos.title: Episode 150 - Observer
videos.overview: Terry feels that Michelle is over-dressed for her first shift at the pub. There's a shock in store for Matty.

videos.title: Episode 151 - Risks
videos.overview: Sheila feels guilty over what has happened to Matty. Paul receives an invitation to a reunion at PetroChem.

videos.title: Episode 152 - On Parade
videos.overview: Annabelle is embarrassed when she doesn't realise that the potential buyers she has to show around Heather's house are a gay couple.

videos.title: Episode 153 - Job Prospects
videos.overview: Both Bobby and Paul feel that they are in with a good chance of landing a new job, while Tommy McArdle is looking for a car from Barry and Terry.

videos.title: Episode 154 - Sound Runner
videos.overview: When Alan shows his new girlfriend Liz his bungalow, she tells him they will have to move. The Grants go to church on Easter Sunday, except for Barry. who is worried about the car Tommy McArdle has borrowed.

videos.title: Episode 155 - Take the Money
videos.overview: Liz deliberately misleads Gordon about Alan's intentions, causing bad feeling throughout the Close and some embarrassing late-night outbursts.

videos.title: Episode 156 - Stupid
videos.overview: Annabelle is concerned when Paul hasn't returned home. Alan receives a rude awakening and some unpleasant truths, and Barry is subjected to some tough questioning.

videos.title: Episode 157 - Underpants
videos.overview: Marie finds something unfamiliar in George's bed. Bobby suspects that Barry is up to something and tells him to leave.

videos.title: Episode 158 - Bad Vibrations
videos.overview: When Annabelle discovers Paul and Dorothy together, she decides to go and stay with her mother. Bobby is elected District Secretary.

videos.title: Episode 159 - Bad Books
videos.overview: George wants Michelle and Marie to come to an agreement about the house. Harry wants his bed moved downstairs while he recuperates. Heather's senior manager receives a letter about her from Roger.

videos.title: Episode 160 - Conditions
videos.overview: Alan's day begins with the arrival of a parcel, but then he discovers its contents. Heather's meeting with an old acquaintance ends unhappily. Barry and Terry carpet everyone they can.

videos.title: Episode 161 - Unstable
videos.overview: Paul resigns from the youth training scheme and, in Annabelle's absence, celebrates with Dorothy. Heather has another visitor from Ireland. Alan becomes more depressed.

videos.title: Episode 162 - Unpredictable
videos.overview: Alan digs up his tree and destroys Harry's fence. Heather insists that Rose explains why she has arrived in Liverpool.

videos.title: Episode 163 - Little Pleasures
videos.overview: When Harry decides to get up, he finds that Edna has gone on strike. Karen tries to find out why Sheila is so moody. Will arrives at Heather's to take Rose home.

videos.title: Episode 164 - Puzzles
videos.overview: Terry and Michelle go to look at cars.......or vans. Karen encourages Sheila to think about going on holiday. Alan locks his keys in the car, and falls asleep on Edna's bed.

videos.title: Episode 165 - Delayed Strain
videos.overview: The neighbours rally round when Alan finds himself fighting for his life after Liz returns to the Close with a sinister friend who beats him up and wrecks the bungalow.

videos.title: Episode 166 - Encouragement
videos.overview: Annabelle returns home to find a suspicious son and an absent husband. Sheila decides to go on holiday, but a visit to the doctors confirms her worst fears. Alan discharges himself from hospital.

videos.title: Episode 167 - Fellow Travellers
videos.overview: Bobby and Sheila relax on holiday in Spain, but Sheila is trying to pluck up the courage to tell Bobby that she's pregnant.

videos.title: Episode 168 - Extending
videos.overview: Sheila and Bobby ponder on how the rest of the family will take their news. Michelle buys a car, and encourages Terry to teach her to drive.

videos.title: Episode 169 - Symptoms
videos.overview: Tensions mount in the Collins household, and Annabelle follows Paul to the tailors'. When Michelle comes home, she discovers that she has moved house.

videos.title: Episode 170 - Respectability
videos.overview: Barry tries to break into Heather's bedroom. Annabelle meets an old acquaintance. Marie wants to send the twins to private school.

videos.title: Episode 171 - Irresponsible
videos.overview: Karen realises that her parents have something to tell her, but isn't at all prepared for what it is.

videos.title: Episode 172 - Impatient
videos.overview: There are differences of opinion in the Grant household about Sheila's pregnancy. Barry and Celia discuss their tool-hire venture.

videos.title: Episode 173 - Bidding
videos.overview: Heather asks Rose to prepare an inventory and show a potential buyer around. Annabelle goes to an auction with Sonia. Harry discovers that someone has placed Heather's "For Sale" sign in front of his house.

videos.title: Episode 174 - Trump Card
videos.overview: Sheila tries to find out more about Barry's new girlfriend. Harry tries to find out who has bought Heather's house. Teresa appeals to Sheila for help with her money troubles.

videos.title: Episode 175 - Like Old Times
videos.overview: Alan rushes to the festival to see Samantha, and finds her surrounded by men. In desperation, he turns to drink again. Paul and Annabelle look forward to a dinner party.

videos.title: Episode 176 - Make a Wish
videos.overview: Marie takes the twins to be interviewed. Alan has to thank Samantha for preventing him from being arrested.

videos.title: Episode 177 - Reversing
videos.overview: Matty appears in court. Alan and Samantha spread the happy news of their impending marriage. Alan is offered a job abroad, and puts the bungalow on the market.

videos.title: Episode 178 - Negotiating
videos.overview: Harry makes an offer for Alan's bungalow, but Edna discovers that it involves blackmail. Marie receives some bad news about the twins' prospects of private education, and confronts the headmaster.

videos.title: Episode 179 - Omen
videos.overview: It is Samantha and Alan's wedding day - but there is a terrible accident.

videos.title: Episode 180 - Off to the Gulf
videos.overview: Alan prepares to leave the Close for good. Marie tries to persuade George to change his mind. The Grants visit Sheila in hospital, and the doctor has some disturbing news for Bobby.

videos.title: Episode 181 - Decision
videos.overview: Sheila has made her decision about the tests the hospital has suggested, but will Bobby agree with her? Michelle decides to train as a beautician, and Marie advises her on how to dress.

videos.title: Episode 182 - Spoiling
videos.overview: Marie and Michelle prepare for their cocktail party, but at least one of them may be in for a disappointment. Barry and Terry have to make a deal with Victor - but Celia isn't satisfied with it.

videos.title: Episode 183 - Smoke
videos.overview: Andrew asks Karen to go on holiday with him to the Lake District. Heather sorts out Alan's boat, and Marie voices her suspicions about Michelle and George.

videos.title: Episode 184 - Flammable Material
videos.overview: Marie is concerned when George fails to return from helping to quench a big warehouse fire. Celia receives money from her father to invest in the tool-hire business.

videos.title: Episode 185 - Equals
videos.overview: Bobby and Sheila receive a surprising telephone call. Michelle becomes an official partner in the tool-hire business, and Terry proposes to her - but they decide to try living together first.

videos.title: Episode 186 - Panic Stations
videos.overview: Sheila and Bobby arrange a Spanish reunion with Ken and Doreen, but it doesn't quite go according to plan. Victor is in a spot of trouble.

videos.title: Episode 187 - A Few Questions
videos.overview: The police call on the Jacksons', and George is taken away for questioning. Rose tells Heather she is returning to Ireland, then her fiance turns up on the doorstep....

videos.title: Episode 188 - Wistful
videos.overview: Paul advises Annabelle to keep her distance from the Jacksons, but she agrees to stand bail for George anyway. Damon tells Linda what he heard about her and Danny. Rose leaves for Ireland.

videos.title: Episode 189 - Social Standing
videos.overview: When prospective bungalow buyers the Prides arrive, Harry shows them round his house instead. Some familiar faces return to the Close, and one of them desperately needs a bath.

videos.title: Episode 190 - Financially Dependant
videos.overview: Damon and his mates meet up with some girls from London. Barry accidentally reveals that he knows more about George's predicament than he should. The Hardwicks visit Harry and Edna.

videos.title: Episode 191 - Not Helpful
videos.overview: George sees his solicitor, while Barry and Terry try to work out how they can help him. Damon and Gizzmo arrange to go to London with Yvonne and Dawn.

videos.title: Episode 192 - Getting Shaky
videos.overview: Celia warns Barry that he will have to mend his ways if they are to continue in business, but their problems are not over yet. Karen returns from holiday, but her lies are soon discovered.

videos.title: Episode 193 - Dealt With Delicately
videos.overview: Michelle returns from London and finds out what has happened to George from Terry - the couple spend their first night at the flat. George confronts Tommy McArdle, and soon regrets it.

videos.title: Episode 194 - Friendly Advice
videos.overview: Tommy McArdle assures George that he shouldn't worry if he is sent down. The twins start their new school. It's Karen's 18th birthday - but will Bobby spoil it for her?

videos.title: Episode 195 - Hopeless
videos.overview: Gordon receives a mysterious letter from a young lady demanding money from him. A depressed George tells Marie he is going to plead guilty. Can Annabelle or Paul talk him out of it?

videos.title: Episode 196 - Not a Robber
videos.overview: Marie worries that George won't turn up for his court appearance - but he does, and pleads not guilty. The young lady who wrote to Gordon turns up at the Collins' house.

videos.title: Episode 197 - Justice for All
videos.overview: Marie suggests to Edna that George can help them move house - but Harry won't allow him to. Cathy suggests to Gordon that he has an ear pierced, so that he looks less like a bank manager.

videos.title: Episode 198 - Forgetting Something
videos.overview: While on a day trip, George heroically rescues a drowning child, but his glory is short-lived. Sinbad tells Edna that he didn't place her bet, and she panics because she has already given Marie her share of the winnings.

videos.title: Episode 199 - Ideal Tenant
videos.overview: Harry produces a questionnaire for prospective tenants to complete and tries it out on Edna, who scores 23%. Michelle wants Terry to tell his father that he is moving in with her - or, failing that, to bring his record player over.

videos.title: Episode 200 - Nurses
videos.overview: Prospective tenants Sandra and Kate arrive at the Crosses, and Harry incorrectly assumes that the third tenant, Pat, is also female. When Linda finds out that Damon has lied, he has no girlfriend and no job.

videos.title: Episode 201 - A Good Story
videos.overview: Cathy and Gordon plan to turn a bathroom into a darkroom. After watching their new tenants move in, the Crosses begin to suspect that one of them is a man. George reads of his heroism in the newspaper - but will Marie respect his decision not to reveal his identity?

videos.title: Episode 202 - Twiddling
videos.overview: Harry confronts Pat. George receives another unexpected visitor - but will he be able to help? Things develop for Gordon and Cathy.

videos.title: Episode 203 - Aggrieved
videos.overview: Paul complains to Harry about Pat's mode of transport; but, surprisingly, Harry defends his tenants. Andrew suggests to Karen that they go away for a weekend to look at universities. Damon tells Sheila he is thinking of moving to London.

videos.title: Episode 204 - Men's Attitudes
videos.overview: Karen refuses to spend the night with Andrew. Sheila tries to help Damon to find a job. Ralph offers Harry and Edna a cheap holiday.

videos.title: Episode 205 - Precedents
videos.overview: George's solicitor tries to reassure him. Paul discovers that getting a repair done late on a Friday is not easy. An elite group selected by computer includes everyone living on the Close and visiting it.

videos.title: Episode 206 - Exploitation
videos.overview: Paul's never-ending search for a spare part crucially depends on finding a man called Wilf. Marie asks Michelle for money to pay for George's barrister. Damon telephones Linda.

videos.title: Episode 207 - Regina v Jackson
videos.overview: The case against George begins, with the prosecution calling a key witness, and his chances look poor.

videos.title: Episode 208 - New Evidence
videos.overview: On the second day of his trial, George speaks in his own defence. Barry and Terry finally decide to help him, but fear they are too late.

videos.title: Episode 209 - Through the Worst
videos.overview: Barry gets Sheila a pram, but discovers that she won't allow it in the house before the baby is born. Marie reflects on the outcome of the trial.

videos.title: Episode 210 - Not Insured for This
videos.overview: Pat, Sandra and Kate throw a party. Terry and Barry hear that their shop has been burgled and hope to turn this to their advantage, but something nastier is planned for them.

videos.title: Episode 211 - Truth Will Out
videos.overview: Paul makes a morbid discovery. The atmosphere at the hospital is tense. Celia and Michelle consider what to do about the tool-hire business.

videos.title: Episode 212 - Sold Out
videos.overview: Heather realises that she is the victim of a confidence trick, but by chance she has the last laugh. Bobby is annoyed with Barry, and Sheila is worried.

videos.title: Episode 213 - Ethics
videos.overview: Heather begins her audit of NSAOS. Bobby asks Barry to clear out the garage while he recuperates. The Crosses return from holiday, but Harry is still grumbling.

videos.title: Episode 214 - Falling Out
videos.overview: Heather impresses her boss by her handling of a delicate matter on the NSAOS audit. Pat warns Harry not to turn up uninvited at the nurses' home. Barry makes a major decision, and Edna finds out that Grace has died.

videos.title: Episode 215 - Right of Access
videos.overview: When Harry reappears in the nurses' home with a donkey instead of an invtation, Pat decides to have the locks changed. Barry seeks help from Celia, but will she offer it? Michelle is reluctant to employ someone to take Terry's place while he is recovering.

videos.title: Episode 216 - Terms
videos.overview: Sandra comes out of the shower to find Harry rummaging through her drawers. When she finally allows him to go home, he finds Ralph stripping in his lounge.

videos.title: Episode 217 - Pressure
videos.overview: Heather prepares for a dinner guest. Paul tries to convince the Board of the need to introduce external contractors. Edna has a run of bad luck with the horses.

videos.title: Episode 218 - Going for Good
videos.overview: Terry comes home from hospital. Barry says his farewells. Edna's money worries increase, and she has to take drastic action.

videos.title: Episode 219 - Burdens
videos.overview: Edna continues to gamble, even though it means she has to pawn her rings to raise some cash. Bobby takes on a case of unfair dismissal, and Michelle becomes disenchanted with having to look after Terry.

videos.title: Episode 220 - Sympathetic
videos.overview: Kevin wants Edna to consider going to Gamblers Anonymous - but will Harry agree? Marie goes to see her MP - but can he help her?

videos.title: Episode 221 - Lunch
videos.overview: Paul receives a lunch invitation. Marie is supported by her neighbours, and Stuart gets a surprise from Heather. Sheila is depressed when Bobby brings a woman home.

videos.title: Episode 222 - Documentary Evidence
videos.overview: Marie meets a journalist. Heather and Stuart's plans are dashed. Bobby learns the truth about the case he is pursuing. Annabelle prepares for a dinner party, not realising that some of the guests are vegetarians.

videos.title: Episode 223 - Seasonal Gifts
videos.overview: The twins are sent home from school for fighting. Annabelle and Paul view Christmas with mixed feelings. A rift develops between Terry and Michelle.

videos.title: Episode 224 - Gestures
videos.overview: Bobby is called on to assist with a case of sexual harrassment. Paul has a serious surplus of turkeys. It's time to switch on the Christmas lights at the bungalow - but will they work?

videos.title: Episode 225 - Long Journey
videos.overview: On Christmas Eve, Sheila has to make a mad dash for the hospital....

videos.title: Episode 226 - False Alarm
videos.overview: On Christmas Day, Marie is depressed about George, and refuses to let the twins keep a donkey they find. Paul is annoyed because he has lost the television page from his paper. Sheila is confined to bed while the others cook dinner, and Harry fears that he is having a heart attack.

videos.title: Episode 227 - Problems
videos.overview: Heather is called in to work for a crisis meeting. Betty is keen to further the campaign to free George, but Michelle has other ideas. Paul finds that there is not enough space for his car in the garage.

videos.title: Episode 228 - Working from Home
videos.overview: Heather tries to work from home, but she is continually interrupted. Ralph begins to miss Grace, but also starts to look to the future.

videos.title: Episode 229 - Still Here
videos.overview: Sheila prepares for a home delivery, and Marie sets off on a long journey to visit George.

videos.title: Episode 230 - Baby Grant
videos.overview: Annabelle has to act quickly when her dinner guests arrive early. Stuart has a belated Christmas present for Heather. Bobby and Sheila become parents of a new daughter.

videos.title: Episode 231 - Thanks Bob
videos.overview: Bobby is determined to sort out the sexual harrassment case. Kate discovers that Pat is selling food to hospital patients.

videos.title: Episode 232 - Allegations
videos.overview: Kate is in trouble at the hospital. Paul is accused of taking a bribe. Marie and Betty talk to Rick about George.

videos.title: Episode 233 - Health Warning
videos.overview: Sandra finds her first day back on theatre duties depressing. Annabelle's new freezer breaks down.

videos.title: Episode 234 - Backhanders
videos.overview: Sandra's husband unexpectedly turns up on the Close. The new union convenor at PetroChem makes further accusations against Paul.

videos.title: Episode 235 - Daytime Jog
videos.overview: The twins have a scheme to help Marie with her money problems. Pat writes a song. Damon is offered a job. Annabelle goes out jogging.

videos.title: Episode 236 - Nothing to Lose
videos.overview: Rick Sexton wants to publicise the sacrifices the Jackson twins have made for their family. Marie lobbies a visiting government official.

videos.title: Episode 237 - Bad Tactics
videos.overview: Paul meets up with Colin Peterson in an attempt to arrange a peace settlement. Sinbad tries to sell cheap watches.

videos.title: Episode 238 - Toryism
videos.overview: Paul has further problems with the maintenance contract. Damon and Neil start up their bin-liner business. Celia doesn't make Terry and Michelle welcome when they return.

videos.title: Episode 239 - Minding
videos.overview: Kate looks after Sheila's baby, allowing Damon and Neil to borrow the pram to carry their bin liners. Ralph goes missing.

videos.title: Episode 240 - Going Under
videos.overview: Ralph returns to the bungalow, and Marie and Betty travel to Downing Street. Mrs Bancroft has her sights on a certain young man. Sheila is depressed.

videos.title: Episode 241 - Anything to Sell Papers
videos.overview: Marie is annoyed when she is accused of neglecting her children. Edna and Ralph become hooked on newspaper bingo.

videos.title: Episode 242 - Putty in Her Hands
videos.overview: Damon thinks he's in for a good time when he is invited upstairs by Mrs Bancroft. Marie receives more hate-mail. Sheila is annoyed by the amount of influence Janet seems to have on Bobby.

videos.title: Episode 243 - Absconded
videos.overview: Heather starts a new assignment which leads to something other than business. Marie goes to visit George in prison, but finds that he has absconded.

videos.title: Episode 244 - Where Can He Go
videos.overview: Heather meets an old flame. Marie is visited by the police. Sheila shows signs of post-natal depression.

videos.title: Episode 245 - At the Sharp End
videos.overview: Sheila confesses to Annabelle that she has started to resent having a new baby. Curzon Communications' chief accountant makes life difficult for Heather.

videos.title: Episode 246 - Searching
videos.overview: Terry tells Sheila about a letter he has received from George. Annabelle gets a shock.

videos.title: Episode 247 - Trying Times
videos.overview: Paul has to attend a difficult business meeting instead of accompanying Annabelle to Gordon's school.

videos.title: Episode 248 - Black
videos.overview: Michelle trips the light fantastic with the new dance instructor. Colin is in favour of calling a strike, and Heather meets Tom Curzon. It emerges that Gordon is in France with Lucy.

videos.title: Episode 249 - Emotional Involvement
videos.overview: Mrs Duncan visits Annabelle. Accusations of an unprofessional relationship cause grief.

videos.title: Episode 250 - Frogs
videos.overview: Annabelle leaves to visit Gordon in France. George has some bad news for Marie. At a disco, Karen and Susi pretend to be French girls.

videos.title: Episode 251 - First Day Out
videos.overview: Bobby proposes a "cooling off" period to Paul. The Grants' baby has a minor accident. A stranger arrives at the Jacksons'.

videos.title: Episode 252 - Meatballs
videos.overview: Marie wakens to find that the visitor has left, taking several of her possessions with him.

videos.title: Episode 253 - Pull-back
videos.overview: Despite playing a prank on Neil, it is Damon who finds himself the April Fool. Heather finds herself back on the Curzon review, and Marie prepares to move out.

videos.title: Episode 254 - Rebirth
videos.overview: Sheila's sister Margaret and her family arrive for the christening ceremony. Karen tries to conceal a love-bite on her neck. Before leaving the Close, Marie gives Sheila a present for the baby.

videos.title: Episode 255 - How Much
videos.overview: Heather returns to Curzon's to find the company in a crisis. Edna and Ralph place an accumulator bet on six horses.

videos.title: Episode 256 - That'll Be All
videos.overview: Sackings follow when Howard, Joyce and Heather present their review to Tom Curzon, and Harry takes action against Billy Mac. Things get physical between Karen and Andrew.

videos.title: Episode 257 - Choice
videos.overview: Damon has to attend a YTS interview. Sandra and Pat consider hiring a kissogram for Kate's birthday. When one man comes to her door, Heather has to hide another one in the kitchen.

videos.title: Episode 258 - Gorilla
videos.overview: Pat sets up a singing telegram service and tries to involve Damon, but Bobby has other plans for him. Tom Curzon invites Heather to spend a weekend with him in Portugal.

videos.title: Episode 259 - Separate Rooms
videos.overview: The singing telegram turns out to be a few notes short. Harry consults a lawyer.

videos.title: Episode 260 - Oppressed
videos.overview: Sandra is disgusted that Jackie is delivering kissograms as "Fifi The Naughty Night Nurse", and that Kate made the costume. Heather and Tom travel around Portugal - but what lies ahead for them when they return?

videos.title: Episode 261 - Dignity
videos.overview: Sandras discovers that radiographer Jimmy Powell has x-ray eyes. Damon receives a job offer. A pillar box is installed on the Close.

videos.title: Episode 262 - Day One
videos.overview: Annabelle employs a cleaner. Pat has "words" with the radiographer who attacked Sandra. Damon begins his YTS scheme.

videos.title: Episode 263 - Invitation
videos.overview: Michelle goes dancing with Richard, but later finds out that he's not who he claims to be. When Victor visits the bungalow on Tommy McArdle's behalf, Ralph ends up flat on his back.

videos.title: Episode 264 - In the You-Know-What
videos.overview: Harry is made an offer, but only if he keeps his mouth shot. Michelle has a surprise for Terry. There's some bad news for Pat.

videos.title: Episode 265 - A Woman's Work
videos.overview: Paul finds himself in a somewhat embarrassing position. Heather has something to celebrate. Ralph makes a decision.

videos.title: Episode 266 - Crumbling
videos.overview: Serious pressure is put on Harry to drop the court case. Michelle and Terry continue to fool each other and themselves.

videos.title: Episode 267 - Not Your Day
videos.overview: Bobby thinks it's time to resume sexual relations with Sheila, but he is called away on business. Edna is in for a shock.

videos.title: Episode 268 - Nobody's Fool
videos.overview: Tommy McArdle makes Harry an even more tempting offer. The Grants have a visitor. There is bad news for Terry and Michelle.

videos.title: Episode 269 - Changes
videos.overview: Edna refuses to venture out after being mugged. Annabelle makes a worrying discovery. An old friend of Damon's makes a surprise return to the Close.

videos.title: Episode 270 - Revising
videos.overview: When Annabelle confronts Carol about the food that is going missing from the freezer, the search for the thief widens. There's a surprise for Edna.

videos.title: Episode 271 - Asking Questions
videos.overview: Annabelle discovers that Harry has been giving Edna the same food that has been going missing from her freezer. When Terry arrives late for work, he discovers that the club has been raided. He then returns home early, and finds out that Michelle is cheating on him with Richard.

videos.title: Episode 272 - Recompensed
videos.overview: Terry disturbs Karen's reunion. Paul is asked to be more specific about how he will reward the strike-breakers. The food thief is finally caught in the act.

videos.title: Episode 273 - Rights and Wrongs
videos.overview: Terry learns that McArdle has been released. Bobby speaks to his doctor about the possibility of having a vasectomy. Paul believes he may have found a way of ending the strike.

videos.title: Episode 274 - Personal Reasons
videos.overview: Heather amuses Greg with her attempts to park Tom's car. Bobby tries to arrange to have a vasectomy without Sheila finding out. Karen and David decide to go to see a film that doesn't have scenes of gratuitous singing and dancing.

videos.title: Episode 275 - Indubitably
videos.overview: Karen sits her last exam, Tom invites Heather to dinner, and Terry makes a statement.

videos.title: Episode 276 - Magic Rabbits
videos.overview: Michelle leaves the Close to live with Marie in Leeds. Sandra plans a holiday in Rimini. Tom discovers that something valuable he has left in Heather's car has gone missing.

videos.title: Episode 277 - Stuff to Burn
videos.overview: Sheila becomes suspicious about Bobby's visit to the doctor, and Karen gets a shock when she goes to visit Bobby at work.

videos.title: Episode 278 - X Marks the Spot
videos.overview: Bobby is forced to come clean about his vasectomy when Sheila's stepladders accidentally poke him in the front room. Sinbad buries a television.

videos.title: Episode 279 - You Don't Understand
videos.overview: Sheila overhears Damon and Karen discussing the stand-off between her and Bobby. Jack wants to impress a new woman, and asks Terry a favour. Tom tells Heather there is someone he wants her to meet.

videos.title: Episode 280 - Lulling
videos.overview: Eileen becomes suspicious of Jack's living arrangements. Bobby and Sheila consider separating. Tom introduces Heather to his father, Jim.

videos.title: Episode 281 - Preparation
videos.overview: Terry suggests that Sheila should consult a priest. Harry and Ralph decide to go to a car auction.

videos.title: Episode 282 - Flawed
videos.overview: Tom and Heather discuss their future. Sheila turns to the church for help with her problems.

videos.title: Episode 283 - Gullibility
videos.overview: Heather plans a celebration with Tom but gets a shock when she calls unexpectedly at his office. Sandra returns from her holidy in Rimini, and Neil persuades Damon to go busking.

videos.title: Episode 284 - Lost
videos.overview: Neil and Damon plan the seduction of their girlfriends. Heather forces Tom to admit the truth about the girl she saw him with. At the hospital fete, some of the residents get Russell Grant's autograph, while others encounter a stranger...

videos.title: Episode 285 - Hallo Again
videos.overview: Harry discovers that running a car will be expensive. Tom suggests to Heather that they cancel a date. Neil asks Damon for a divorce. The stranger returns.

videos.title: Episode 286 - He Won't Go
videos.overview: Pat, Sandra, and Kate find themselves at the mercy of an unbalanced man with a gun.

videos.title: Episode 287 - There's Something Wrong
videos.overview: Annabelle becomes suspicious after speaking to Kate and hearing about her encounters with Harry and the milkman, but Paul doesn't believe her. Damon and Neil prepare for a seance. The captor becomes increasingly unhinged.

videos.title: Episode 288 - Is There Anybody There
videos.overview: The siege continues, and Pat undermines Kate's attempts to end it peacefully.

videos.title: Episode 289 - You Two Must Go Now
videos.overview: The Close is evacuated, and the residents monitor the situation as it is reported on television. Harry becomes concerned when Edna goes to the toilet and doesn't come back.

videos.title: Episode 290 - Tragic
videos.overview: After gunshots ring out, the police move in, but there are only dead bodies to be recovered.

videos.title: Episode 291 - Give Us a Story
videos.overview: Reporters are swarming around the Close, and Terry accuses Harry of profiteering from the death of one of his tenants.

videos.title: Episode 292 - Snaps
videos.overview: As a result of the newspaper coverage of the siege, Annabelle and Harry both receive letters from the tax man. Terry and Sandra have to go to London for a funeral.

videos.title: Episode 293 - Nosing
videos.overview: Ghoulish appetites for a glimpse of the scene of the crime make matters worse. While Harry is arguing with other residents outside, Edna suffers a stroke in the kitchen.

videos.title: Episode 294 - A Few More Years
videos.overview: Paul and Annabelle prepare to go on holiday, but first he wants to know why an extra television set has appeared in the house. There is no hospital bed available for Edna. Karen's exam results arrive.

videos.title: Episode 295 - Nothing to Do
videos.overview: Edna has a relapse and is in a critical condition. Paul and Annabelle prepare to camp out in their back garden, but is their tent waterproof?

videos.title: Episode 296 - Kidding Ourselves
videos.overview: Damon and Neil find out that the photo of Karen they entered for a competition has won. Harry's spirits are low, as Edna's condition remains unchanged.

videos.title: Episode 297 - No Change
videos.overview: Harry is hopeful that Edna will be able to come home. Sandra is surprised when someone from the Close turns up while she visits her mother in Glasgow.

videos.title: Episode 298 - Depressed
videos.overview: Harry and his family maintain a vigil at Edna's bedside, but she is not going to wake up. Matty is disappointed when he is unsuccessful at his job interview.

videos.title: Episode 299 - Mushroom Whatsits
videos.overview: Pat and Sandra return from Glasgow and find Harry in their house, distraught because Edna has died.

videos.title: Episode 300 - You Have to Go
videos.overview: There's an unfortunate case of mistaken identity, as the vicar puts his foot in it at Edna's funeral. When Terry returns from the funeral, he discovers that new arrivals the Corkhills have dumped his belongings outside number 10.

videos.title: Episode 301 - Expense No Object
videos.overview: Terry and Pat discover that televisions dug up from the garden don't necessarily work. Billy has a surprise for Doreen: a ready-to-assemble fireplace kit. Jim hears something he shouldn't hear on Heather's answerphone.

videos.title: Episode 302 - A New Way
videos.overview: Sandra is feeling the strain of being the only breadwinner in the house. Heather regrets lying to Jim. Doreen needs help with the building of her fireplace.

videos.title: Episode 303 - Handouts
videos.overview: Terry and Pat go to the bank. Karen and David play monopoly. Paul sets off for a military reunion dinner but has no intention of arriving there.

videos.title: Episode 304 - Moment of Weakness
videos.overview: Doreen's mother, Julia, reveals a few home truths about Billy's criminal past. Annabelle is startled when she questions Paul over his reunion dinner. Harry sells, then buys again.

videos.title: Episode 305 - Tobacco Casserole
videos.overview: Heather is worried when she receives some mysterious phone calls. By chance, a cigarette end found down the toilet ends up in Sandra's meal.

videos.title: Episode 306 - Initiative
videos.overview: Tom asks Heather to be "Mrs Curzon". Sandra gives Pat three months to make the van-hire business a success. Damon needs plenty of initiative when Karen asks him to change a book he has given her, and he almost succeeds.

videos.title: Episode 307 - Not Like School
videos.overview: Billy Corkhill has forgotten about a little electricity job, but it's someone else who is caught red-handed. On Karen's first day at university, her worries turn into outright fear when she meets other students.

videos.title: Episode 308 - Cultural Life
videos.overview: Billy's new shutters are causing a bit of a stir. Damon and Rod are determined to outdo each other in their displays of support for different football teams.

videos.title: Episode 309 - Gunga Grant
videos.overview: Rod plans to impress Heather by washing her car, but then the water supply is cut off. Lucy Collins returns to the Close.

videos.title: Episode 310 - Good Parts and Bad
videos.overview: The cleaner meets the daughter, but who has more reason to be suspicious? Heather reflects on becoming a free woman again as her divorce from Roger becomes absolute.

videos.title: Episode 311 - Programmes
videos.overview: It's Lucy's birthday, but she has disappeared again. Damon and Rod make a bet, and Harry agrees to adjudicate.

videos.title: Episode 312 - Student Prank
videos.overview: Karen goes to a party without telling Bobby and Sheila and does something she later regrets on the way home. Heather is not sure how to answer Tom's proposal.

videos.title: Episode 313 - Best Kept Secrets
videos.overview: Doreen discovers that Julia has nearly burned her house down. Lucy tells Annabelle her plans. Damon sets about returning the Corkhills' alarm without them knowing.

videos.title: Episode 314 - Knock It Off
videos.overview: Heather is confused when Tom refuses to invite his daughter to the wedding. The Corkhills are more confused about what has happened during the night.

videos.title: Episode 315 - Why Her
videos.overview: Lucy is confident about her job interview but finds that it isn't the walkover that she expected. Julia appears in court.

videos.title: Episode 316 - Playing Trains
videos.overview: Jim has a proposal for Tom. Ralph and Harry go on a trip to Blaenau Festiniog. Julia discovers a love letter written by Tracy to a lad at school. Or is it?

videos.title: Episode 317 - Homewatch Meeting
videos.overview: Annabelle's homewatch meeting doesn't quite go to plan. Terry and Pat take on an awkward customer.

videos.title: Episode 318 - Going Up in the World
videos.overview: Heather discovers that Tom has bought her a new house and handed in her resignation. The appearance of Gummy George on the Close results in Paul getting a black eye.

videos.title: Episode 319 - Not Getting Any Easier
videos.overview: Heather struggles with her preparations for the wedding. Harry and Ralph go to the cemetery to see Edna's grave.

videos.title: Episode 320 - Nowhere to Climb
videos.overview: Heather has serious doubts about marrying Tom. Lucy tells Paul and Annabelle that she has a boyfriend. Harry inadvertently causes a fight between Billy and Doreen.

videos.title: Episode 321 - Defending
videos.overview: Rod arrives home with a black eye, but finds that it wasn't worth getting. Doreen's turkey fund becomes a little under-done.

videos.title: Episode 322 - Missing Money
videos.overview: Pat and Terry are summoned by their bank manager. Doreen confronts Julia. Heather has a visitor, but does she still have a job?

videos.title: Episode 323 - Work
videos.overview: Lucy invites James home. Pat and Terry meet a potential new customer. Damon starts work in a stately home. Ralph and Harry are bored.

videos.title: Episode 324 - Conscientiousness
videos.overview: Damon is in a spot of bother at work but won't blow the whistle on the guilty party. Harry and Ralph man the phones.

videos.title: Episode 325 - Moral Scruples
videos.overview: Damon confesses that he has been suspended. Pamela encourages Karen to crib an essay. Pat and Terry blame Harry for sending them on a wild goose chase.

videos.title: Episode 326 - A Quiet Word
videos.overview: Sheila takes steps to clear Damon's name. Sandra is not pleased when Harry wakes her up. Karen obtains a second-hand essay to save her some time.

videos.title: Episode 327 - What's the Catch
videos.overview: Sinbad tries to interest the residents of the Close in fresh turkey for Christmas. Karen discovers that her tutor originally wrote the essay she handed in to him.

videos.title: Episode 328 - Fresh Turkey
videos.overview: Sinbad introduces Trevor the Turkey to the residents, most of whom decide that it's slightly too fresh for them. Karen is flattered by the weirdest Guy she knows.

videos.title: Episode 329 - Surprise Visit
videos.overview: Lucy feels trapped as Annabelle sets a date for James's visit. Billy is asked to work over Christmas. Sheila is surprised that Father Christmas knows so much about Claire. Pat, Sandra, and Terry celebrate early.

videos.title: Episode 330 - A Bed for the Night
videos.overview: At Billy's factory, many of the men are made redundant just before Christmas, and it's time for Bobby to take action. An ex-girlfriend of Barry's turns up and has a few surprises for everyone.

videos.title: Episode 331 - Installing
videos.overview: Barry discovers that Jane hasn't kicked her habit and confiscates what he finds. There's trouble between Billy and Bobby at the picket line. Joyce turns up at Heather's in need of somewhere to stay.

videos.title: Episode 332 - Fraternising
videos.overview: Bobby and Sheila learn from Barry that the heroin belongs to Jane. Joyce tells Heather she is setting up in business, and invites Heather to join her.

videos.title: Episode 333 - Forgetful
videos.overview: James has dinner at the Collins', and Annabelle and Paul soon suspect that he has something to hide. Jane receives some good advice, but will she listen?

videos.title: Episode 334 - Birthday Girl
videos.overview: It's Claire's first birthday. Paul and Annabelle's fears about Lucy have been confirmed. Pat and Sandra discover that Jane has left during the night, taking a few of their things with her.

videos.title: Episode 335 - Difference of Opinion
videos.overview: When the Clearys remove the wheels from Pat and Terry's van, they get much more than they bargained for. Nicholas helps Heather with her decorating and insists on staying to finish it. Bobby is annoyed with Billy because he crossed the picket line.

videos.title: Episode 336 - No Harm Done
videos.overview: Barry and Pat have plans to stop a war. Vicki blames Terry for her brothers being beaten up. Paul and Annabelle try to discover where James really works.

videos.title: Episode 337 - Brass Tacks
videos.overview: Pat defies Terry and takes the law into his own hands with Barry. When Paul discovers something about James, he gives him a week to reveal it to Lucy. Heather is disappointed to discover who her new boss is and what he thinks of her.

videos.title: Episode 338 - Some Mistake
videos.overview: Barry is determined to continue sorting out Terry's problems with the Clearys, but he is about to make a big mistake. Billy and Doreen meet with Tracy's headmaster and the teacher involved in the allegations.

videos.title: Episode 339 - Rats
videos.overview: Damon and Neil have another cunning plan, but as usual, it's about to backfire. James's attempts to dump Lucy don't have the intended result.

videos.title: Episode 340 - Privatisation
videos.overview: Bobby is bothered by scabs on the Close. Lucy decides to tell her parents that she has stopped seeing James. Sheila wants to adopt, or at least sponsor, a child. Nicholas takes Heather to dinner, but who will end up paying for it?

videos.title: Episode 341 - What's She Been Doing
