videos.overview: Lucy and Tracy have exactly the same problem: their parents don't understand them or approve of their actions.

videos.title: Episode 342 - So It's True
videos.overview: Tracy comes clean about Peter, who wishes she hadn't, when Billy exacts brutal revenge. But James is still keeping Lucy blissfully unaware of a few things.

videos.title: Episode 343 - Spying
videos.overview: Annabelle spots Lucy and James together in town but isn't prepared for what Lucy tells her. Sheila spots Barry handing over a bundle of money to a stranger.

videos.title: Episode 344 - Goings
videos.overview: Heather is attacked for political incorrectness. There are some unwelcome revelations for Lucy. Tracy disappears.

videos.title: Episode 345 - Listening
videos.overview: Tracy is staying away, and Lucy refuses to face up to the facts about James.

videos.title: Episode 346 - Taking it Badly
videos.overview: Lucy discovers that her boyfriend isn't even called James when she decides it is time to pay a visit to his wife.

videos.title: Episode 347 - Personalising
videos.overview: Doreen fears that Billy will be sent to prison. Can someone with previous experience reassure her? Ralph tries to help Harry compose a "lonely hearts" ad. When Heather gives Nick a present, he recognises it.

videos.title: Episode 348 - Interpretation
videos.overview: Harry wonders if he is being disloyal to Edna. Ralph can't make up his mind. Heather's curiosity about Barbara gets the better of her, but she is not at all prepared for what she discovers.

videos.title: Episode 349 - Uncooperative
videos.overview: Harry receives nineteen replies to his advert, one of which is from a man. Billy appears in court but refuses to cooperate with his probation officer.

videos.title: Episode 350 - Change of Mind
videos.overview: After Harry posts his letter to Madge, he has second thoughts and wants to get it back.

videos.title: Episode 351 - Mistaken Identity
videos.overview: Sandra is offered a promotion, but to the private ward. Bobby receives a letter about a loan taken out in his name. At the art gallery at which Madge is due to meet Harry, she unfortunately isn't the only woman wearing a green coat.

videos.title: Episode 352 - Be My Guest
videos.overview: Bobby is jealous of Sheila's tutor when he holds a class in their front room. Sandra is annoyed to find Vicki cooking her steaks in the kitchen. Ralph wants to borrow Harry's car.

videos.title: Episode 353 - In-Depth Interview
videos.overview: Sandra starts her new job, and Sally Dinsdale turns up at the Grants' with a black eye. Karen interviews Paula Yates.

videos.title: Episode 354 - Born Romancer
videos.overview: Sandra and Jackie show the pest control man their cockroach-infested rooms. Sheila tries to convince Bobby that he has nothing to worry about.

videos.title: Episode 355 - Birthday Cards
videos.overview: On Bobby's birthday, Damon gets his cards. Pat pesters Sandra about why she is so irritable, not expecting the answer he gets. A telephone call from Teresa forces Sheila to lie for matty.

videos.title: Episode 356 - Cruel to be Kind
videos.overview: Sandra tries to let Pat down gently, but it's almost impossible.

videos.title: Episode 357 - Are You Ready
videos.overview: Guy invites Karen to spend the night with him, and she agrees. Ralph sneaks out to see Madge. leaving Harry to spend the bank holiday on his own.

videos.title: Episode 358 - A Tricky One
videos.overview: A shop steward draws Bobby's attention to some surprising payslips. Madge pays a visit to the bungalow, and Ralph's planned trip to Torquay with her turns into a foursome.

videos.title: Episode 359 - Best Out Of It
videos.overview: When Tracy is bored at home, the Corkhills' telephone bill is about to start shooting up. Sheila confronts Mo, who tells her that Matty is leaving Teresa to marry her.

videos.title: Episode 360 - Differentials
videos.overview: George tries to convince Bobby to take the "long view". Heather and Keith return from Aberdeen. Sally Dinsdale turns up again, and this time Sheila insists that she stays. Damon gets a new idea about how he might find a job.

videos.title: Episode 361 - Diving
videos.overview: Sheila has a frightening secret she doesn't want to worry Bobby with. A visit by Jehovah's Witnesses results in Pat and Terry missing "The Magic Rabbits". Harry, Ralph, Julia and Madge enjoy a holiday in Torquay, while Damon looks for work.

videos.title: Episode 362 - Fraud Investigation
videos.overview: Sheila confides in Alun over the poison-pen letter. Pat and Terry appear to have dropped themselves in it with an unexpected visitor, but is there a solution?

videos.title: Episode 363 - Sexual Blackmail
videos.overview: Lucy seems to have got over losing James, as she meets another man; but Paul and Annabelle are not convinced that Barry is a suitable partner for anyone. Bobby is annoyed with Sheila again.

videos.title: Episode 364 - Making it Worse
videos.overview: Bobby faces a difficult choice - his job or his men? When Karen gets a nasty telephone call, Sheila explains that it was meant for her. Nick has a confrontation with Keith Tench over Heather, and comes off worse.

videos.title: Episode 365 - Rationalisation
videos.overview: Billy and Doreen anxiously go to court, as so much depends on the result of their appeal. Keith Tench is determined to make Heather's life difficult.

videos.title: Episode 366 - Au Revoir
videos.overview: Rod and Damon are both convinced that they have won their bet. Petrochem is taken over. Lucy says her goodbyes as she prepares to leave for France with Barry, but she's leaving something behind her. Billy regrets not mentioning something important to Doreen.

videos.title: Episode 367 - Deferred
videos.overview: Bobby advises Billy to go to his union, but he isn't hopeful. Rod and Damon both try to snatch victory in their programme collecting contest. Heather discovers that Nick's phone has been cut off.

videos.title: Episode 368 - Reassurance
videos.overview: Romance is in the air for Heather. Sheila feels guilty about lying to Teresa. Damon leaves home.

videos.title: Episode 369 - Just Like That
videos.overview: Paul is in for more than one disappointment. Doreen thinks her new acquisition will help out - but disaster is about to strike.

videos.title: Episode 370 - Vibes
videos.overview: Paul takes his redundancy in his stride, but is dubious about news he receives of Lucy. Doreen is angry with Billy for not returning the bricks, fearing that they might jeopardise his court appeal.

videos.title: Episode 371 - Hang-ups
videos.overview: Doreen is reluctant to worry Billy with the phone bill, but he's got a bigger problem to face anyway. Karen is frightened after receiving several phone calls in which no-one speaks to her.

videos.title: Episode 372 - First Time
videos.overview: Karen sleeps with Guy, Paul voices his feelings of insecurity, and Madge offers to help Harry learn to drive.

videos.title: Episode 373 - Dinner Guests
videos.overview: Just as Karen and Guy are happy with their relationship, he has a proposal that would make it permanent. Billy and Doreen discover why the phone bill is so high.

videos.title: Episode 374 - First Impressions
videos.overview: Heather meets Nick's children for the first time, and they're not all impressed with her. Then one of them is involved in an accident...

videos.title: Episode 375 - Coming of Age
videos.overview: Billy convinces Doreen that the furniture should be moved upstairs while Rod has a party. Pat is determined to have an argument and eventually finds one. Heather and Nick reconsider whether they should marry if his children don't approve.

videos.title: Episode 376 - Something Beginning With Sss
videos.overview: Rod decides that he would like to join the police, but Billy isn't impressed with that idea. A romantic kiss leaves Karen in an awkward predicament.

videos.title: Episode 377 - MYOB
videos.overview: Bobby puts his job on the line by defying George Williams. Annabelle tries to talk Paul out of protesting. Ralph and Harry aren't speaking.

videos.title: Episode 378 - Unlawful
videos.overview: Harry and Ralph misuse a "disabled driver" badge. Paul buys timber to build a lollipop sign, and Sandra denies everything.

videos.title: Episode 379 - Misguided
videos.overview: Paul's impression of a lollipop man is not appreciated by some of the schoolchildren, who relieve him of his sign, nor by a policeman, who visits him at home. Nick has forgotten something important, so Heather calls on Annabelle for advice.

videos.title: Episode 380 - Sound and Fury
videos.overview: When Tony arrives, Pat realises that Sandra may not have dropped the Cribbs-Baker case after all. Sheila is nervous about her seminar. Terry tries to find somewhere to go where there isn't a furious row blazing.

videos.title: Episode 381 - Similarity
videos.overview: Harry finds a photograph that makes him believe his house is being used for immoral purposes. Sheila has even more to worry about.

videos.title: Episode 382 - Reality
videos.overview: Pat is shown up by a bottle of perfume. Sheila finally discovers who wrote the threatening letter to her. However, the person responsible wasn't making the phone calls.

videos.title: Episode 383 - Rice
videos.overview: Pat and Sandra don't go to Heather and Nick's wedding reception, and things become violent between them. Matty is in for a shock.

videos.title: Episode 384 - On the Line
videos.overview: Bobby goes to London to face a disciplinary committee. Terry finds out about Vicki's photograph. Cribbs-Baker tries to intimidate Tony and Sandra. Matty accuses Sheila of turning Mo against him, and becomes aggressive.

videos.title: Episode 385 - Hope
videos.overview: Ralph finds himself giving Harry a driving lesson, and discovers it's not something he'd like to repeat.

videos.title: Episode 386 - No Hope
videos.overview: Sally Dinsdale's husband has gone on the rampage, and she is fearful of what he might do. Sheila and Matty argue in the taxi home after class, and she gets out and walks into a horrific ordeal.

videos.title: Episode 387 - Raped
videos.overview: Sheila arrives home shaken and dazed, and although she tells Bobby what happened, she doesn't want to involve the police. The police pick up a drunken Pat, who looks like he's been in a fight.

videos.title: Episode 388 - We Have To Ask
videos.overview: Sheila is persuaded to call the police and discuss the attack, and Pat becomes the prime suspect.

videos.title: Episode 389 - Who Could It Be
videos.overview: Sheila isn't telling the police everything she knows. Matty tells Bobby who he thinks is the rapist.

videos.title: Episode 390 - It Couldn't Be
videos.overview: Bobby feels that there are things to be cleared up between him and Sheila - but she disagrees.

videos.title: Episode 391 - Leaving All This Behind
videos.overview: Nick discovers that Ruth has disobeyed him. Tony has an announcement to make about his future. Matty does nothing to improve his situation with the police

videos.title: Episode 392 - A Real Suspect
videos.overview: Following their investigation, the police believe they now have enough evidence to make an arrest.

videos.title: Episode 393 - Time to Confess
videos.overview: Matty is questioned by the police and encouraged to admit that he is the rapist. Bobby tries to return to work, but is prevented from doing so by George.

videos.title: Episode 394 - Poor Teresa
videos.overview: A confession convinces the police that they have found the guilty man, while Harry tries to discover the identity of the victim. Billy finds himself locked out, Paul finds himself with a bicycle he can't ride, and Teresa decides there is only one solution for her problems.

videos.title: Episode 395 - Persistence
videos.overview: At Teresa's funeral, Matty's family blame him for her death. Adam teaches Paul to ride his bicycle. Sandra fails to convince a reporter to cover her story, and Tracy is too fully clothed to interest him either.

videos.title: Episode 396 - Facing Up
videos.overview: Bobby returns to his work, and conflict with George. Harry decides that it is time to raise the rents payable by his tenants.......including Ralph. Karen confides in Sandra that she plans to move in with Guy.

videos.title: Episode 397 - Crossing the Road
videos.overview: Paul thinks he has found a way of blocking the dangerous road legally, but it leads to him spending time in a police cell and losing his bike. Sheila believes the rape has left her with more than memories.

videos.title: Episode 398 - Qualifications
videos.overview: Sheila has some relieving news, Rod receives his "O" Level results, Doreen holds a clothes party, and Annabelle has her interview.

videos.title: Episode 399 - Home
videos.overview: Annabelle and Paul meet Gordon's friend, but are they right to be optimistic? Charlie is behaving suspiciously. Guy finds accomodation for himself and Karen.

videos.title: Episode 400 - Playing Politics
videos.overview: Ruth discovers where Charlie is. Kathleen's aggressiveness could jeopardise the road safety campaign. Terry warns Pat that he could be in trouble if he sees Andrea again.

videos.title: Episode 401 - Disagreement
videos.overview: When Carol discovers that Gordon is gay, she refuses to go on working for Annabelle. Karen and Guy have a row. Heather is back from Hong Kong, and her first visitor is Charlie. Nick throws him out.

videos.title: Episode 402 - Flares
videos.overview: When Andrea calls, Terry locks Pat out in the cold with only his pants to keep him warm, and his appeals to Heather for help lead to her discovering that Nick has lied to her. Ruth has tea at the Corkhills', and Paul and Annabelle meet Chris.

videos.title: Episode 403 - Under Pressure
videos.overview: While Pat is with Andrea, her husband turns up, and Terry has to distract him. Harry challenges Paul to a race. Sandra is determined that Pat is not going to force her out of the house.

videos.title: Episode 404 - Pedal Power
videos.overview: Sandra disapproves when Pat continues to see Andrea. Billy has a narrow escape from a serious accident at work. Harry and Paul's race to Delamere Forest ends in a draw.

videos.title: Episode 405 - Connection
videos.overview: Nick and Charlie have a brush with the law. Dr. Hurrell returns to say goodbye to Sandra and stays overnight. After Damon catches them in bed together, Karen and Guy go to view a flat. Damon meets a girl.

videos.title: Episode 406 - Wondering
videos.overview: Gordon is appearing in a television interview, and Paul and Annabelle try to ensure that none of the neighbours watch it.

videos.title: Episode 407 - Newspapers
videos.overview: Karen tells Sandra she plans to move in with Guy. When Sally comes to stay, Harry wants Ralph to give up his bed. A mix-up by the paper boy causes Billy to discover that Gordon is gay.

videos.title: Episode 408 - Flowers
videos.overview: Bobby and Sheila go to tea with Guy and Karen, and Bobby ruins everything with one remark. Heather is being tormented by Nick and Charlie's behaviour.

videos.title: Episode 409 - Could Have Been
videos.overview: Ruth seems to know more about Nick than Heather does. Gail plans to have sex with Damon in a hotel room, but there's a man in the bath. Sandra leaves the close with Tony.

videos.title: Episode 410 - Nobody Wants To Know
videos.overview: Terry has a small problem with the rent. Damon has to run to catch Gail. Harry buys a huge teddy, but no one seems interested in knowing why. Ruth is forced to reveal the horrifying truth about Nick to Heather.

videos.title: Episode 411 - Too Much, Too Soon
videos.overview: Harry insists on helping to select a new flatmate for Pat and Terry.

videos.title: Episode 412 - Double Glazing
videos.overview: Nick has some hard choices to make. Sheila tells Damon he can leave her alone in the house, but a salesman calls and unwittingly reminds her of the rape.

videos.title: Episode 413 - Misconceptions
videos.overview: Annabelle begins her training to be a magistrate and isn't very successful. Pat wonders why Gill keeps staring at him. When Bobby comes home, he finds that Gail has taken over.

videos.title: Episode 414 - For His Own good
videos.overview: Heather is determined to reform Nick. Annabelle is reluctant to give Damon driving lessons.

videos.title: Episode 415 - Shortcomings
videos.overview: Andrea makes it clear that she's only after one thing. Sheila tries to be left alone, and Nick is going to be found out.

videos.title: Episode 416 - Schemes
videos.overview: Gordon goes for a job interview. Barry takes Sheila shopping. Harry does some scheming.

videos.title: Episode 417 - Impure Thoughts
videos.overview: In his interview, Rod begins to worry about the reputation of the Corkhills. When Sheila finds Gail and Damon coming out of his bedroom, she doesn't believe they were just tidying it. Barry decides it's time to take the law into his own hands.

videos.title: Episode 418 - A Personal Favour
videos.overview: Pat and Terry win a trip to Barbados. Billy is not keen on Tracy's intention of becoming a model. Nick begs Heather to let him stay with her.

videos.title: Episode 419 - Financially Embarrassed
videos.overview: Julian Tyler is determined to find Billy. Pat and Terry collect their tickets for Barbados. Doreen reaches her credit limit. Heather asks Barry's advice.

videos.title: Episode 420 - Custard Powder
videos.overview: Gail prepares a meal, but is missing a vital ingredient. When she starts to talk about marriage, Damon starts to panic. Barry makes a prediction.

videos.title: Episode 421 - Taken For a Ride
videos.overview: Things get tight for the Corkhills. Pat and Terry set off for Barbados, and although they believe Mrs McArdle is slightly senile, she secretly conceals a package in a locker at the airport.

videos.title: Episode 422 - Getting Suspicious
videos.overview: Rod takes his police exams. Heather discovers that Nick has been using her cheque book. Pat thinks he's in love. Harry decides to confiscate a hi-fi from his tenants' home, and Paul treats himself to a video camera and recorder.

videos.title: Episode 423 - Discerning
videos.overview: Tommy McArdle's attempts to chat up Gill are not appreciated. Mrs McArdle gives her minders the slip, and Annabelle is irritated when Paul video-records her in the kitchen.

videos.title: Episode 424 - How Could You
videos.overview: Sheila discovers why the trial has been postponed, and is annoyed with others for interfering. Paul confronts Barry, believing he is being disloyal to Lucy. Gordon buys a motorbike.

videos.title: Episode 425 - Finishing the Job
videos.overview: Pat and Terry find out that they have been duped, and that Tommy now requires them to go to Glasgow. Nick reaches rock bottom when the council decide he is a liability. Annabelle has problems with her freezer.

videos.title: Episode 426 - One Careless Owner
videos.overview: Nick tries to raise money so that he can go into a clinic. Doreen wants rid of Jimmy in case he ruins Rod's chances of joining the police. Annabelle has to ask her neighbors to look after a lot of food - and most of them eat it.

videos.title: Episode 427 - Something Missing
videos.overview: When Annabelle goes round the Close to collect all her food, she discovers there isn't as much as she remembered. Vicki is suspicious of Terry. Harry puts pressure on Sally to move into his house.

videos.title: Episode 428 - Severe Food Poisoning
videos.overview: After the meal she has served has not been received quite as well as she hoped, Annabelle feels that she must makes enquires about the state of health of her neighbours. Harry blames himself for the loss of his grandchild.

videos.title: Episode 429 - Found
videos.overview: The police bring Heather the news that Nick has been found. Gordon discovers that Chris has gone on a skiing holiday. The Corkhills' television is repossessed, and Annabelle decides to give up the catering business.

videos.title: Episode 430 - Too Many Memories
videos.overview: Pat receives a letter from Avril. Tracy signs up for a hairdressing job. Tragic news forces Heather to decide about her future.

videos.title: Episode 431 - Offences
videos.overview: Annabelle finds her first day in court as a magistrate to be something of an anti-climax. Paul accidentally sets off Heather's burglar alarm. Rod wonders whether he really stands a chance of making it into the police force.

videos.title: Episode 432 - Misplaced Loyalty
videos.overview: Gordon and Annabelle are not impressed that Paul is gloating because Barry is still expecting Lucy to come home for Christmas. Charlie discovers that Nick is dead. Tracy arrives late at the salon on her first.

videos.title: Episode 433 - Father Christmas
videos.overview: Jimmy brings a Christmas present for Billy, but Doreen isn't convinced that he should accept it. Harry observes some suspicious behaviour involving Father Christmas and some hampers.

videos.title: Episode 434 - Robin Hood
videos.overview: It's party time on the Close, and Gail is trying her luck with more than just one man. Harry overhears Jack explaining his scam, and turns it to his own advantage. Rod's time alone with Kirsty is interrupted when burglars strike next door.

videos.title: Episode 435 - No Joke
videos.overview: Guy is distraught because Karen has finished with him and is moving to London. Rod receives potentially useful press coverage. While Doreen confides in Sheila about her financial problems, the electricity at number 10 is disconnected.

videos.title: Episode 436 - All Mod Cons
videos.overview: To Rod's dismay, Billy just can't keep his hands off the electrics. Gail gate-crashes a party Damon has gone to. Bobby and Barry have a long chat in the pub.

videos.title: Episode 437 - Give Us a Clue
videos.overview: Harry is speechless for once, and it's time for Barry to leave again. Shelley lets Tracy go home early when she claims that her mother is awaiting the results of medical tests.

videos.title: Episode 438 - Not Even Ill
videos.overview: Damon is hanging around the school gates. Julia's incessant chatter causes Harry to regain the power of speech. Doreen visits Tracy at the salon, and Shelley is surprised that she is looking so well.

videos.title: Episode 439 - Just Confused
videos.overview: Sheila is in need of spiritual sustenance. Billy is offered a job in Tunbridge Wells. Harry confronts Madge about her birthdays.

videos.title: Episode 440 - Good Turn
videos.overview: Sheila is convinced that she needs to go to Rome, while Billy is convinced that he should go to Tunbridge Wells. Eric tries to convince Bobby that Martin's claims about asbestos need not be taken seriously.

videos.title: Episode 441 - Double Talk
videos.overview: After rowing with Doreen while Kirsty is visiting, Billy turns off the electricity again. Bobby has lunch with the industrial relations officer of Billinge's, and becomes more convinced that something funny is going on.

videos.title: Episode 442 - Reconnection
videos.overview: Harry is not pleased that Ralph is going on holiday with Madge, and makes sure everybody knows. Billy returns from the bank with good news, but is not pleased about what he finds at home.

videos.title: Episode 443 - Accommodation
videos.overview: Pat and Terry are both looking for a third tenant, and they both find one. Sheila looks for a job to help her save the money for going to Rome. Billy warns Doreen against over-spending.

videos.title: Episode 444 - Singing the Same Tune
videos.overview: Sheila is determined to go to Rome, with or without Bobby. Bobby is certain that the shop steward at Billinge Chemicals is in the management's pocket. Pat and Terry try to cope with the lodger from Hell.

videos.title: Episode 445 - Surprises
videos.overview: Paul rescues a drowning puppy, and Annabelle allows it into the house only until it can be taken to the RSPCA. Bobby wonders if he has got the wrong end of the stick regarding the asbestos scare.

videos.title: Episode 446 - Moving On Soon
videos.overview: A disturbing encounter galvanises Bobby into action - after meeting a man with asbestosis, he decides to call in the factory inspectors. Annabelle sets Lucky free, but Paul finds her and brings her back home. Mick's pipe nearly burns the house down.

videos.title: Episode 447 - Little Messages
videos.overview: Ralph and Madge return from their holiday engaged to be married. Bobby is accused of being a member of the Militant Tendency.

videos.title: Episode 448 - Smooth Operator
videos.overview: There are complaints from around the Close about the Collins' dog. Harry finds out how he can solve the riddle surrounding Madge's birthday.

videos.title: Episode 449 - Bone of Contention
videos.overview: Annabelle is annoyed when Lucky gets to the paper before she does, and mistakenly believes that Damon is in trouble with the police. Pat loses a lot of money in a card game. Madge has a story to tell about her birthday.

videos.title: Episode 450 - Thinking the Worst
videos.overview: Chinese whispers slur Damon's name, and it isn't long before he is allegedly a hardened criminal. Bobby faces an irate workforce at the factory.

videos.title: Episode 451 - Rumbled
videos.overview: Bobby discovers he has been spied on. Harry successfully impersonates a retired civil servant by putting on a stupid hat.

videos.title: Episode 452 - Shedding
videos.overview: Madge breaks off her engagement to Ralph, and Harry makes sure he retrieves the ring from her before she disappears.

videos.title: Episode 453 - Fast Workers
videos.overview: Mike makes a pass at Doreen. Jamie, who is delivering supplies to the salon, asks Tracy out. Trish and Fran have a business proposition for Pat and Terry.

videos.title: Episode 454 - Snags
videos.overview: Terry buys Heather's bed, but then realises he will have a problem getting it home. Harry is keen to buy her answerphone, until he finds out the price. Annabelle and Paul are late for the sale because Paul gets caught in a fence while trying to entice Lucky out of an awkward position.

videos.title: Episode 455 - Our Lucky Night
videos.overview: Harry finally confirms his suspicions, discovering that he has an extra tenant. Chris and Gordon act out a fantasy, with tragic results.

videos.title: Episode 456 - Gory Details
videos.overview: Terry confronts Pat over his neglect of their business. Paul sets out to discover who killed his dog. Mick and Mike make a noisy departure, while Ralph prepares to make a much quieter one.

videos.title: Episode 457 - Who Is She
videos.overview: A pregnant woman arrives looking for Mike. Terry is worried that he will be caught by the DHSS. Doreen witnesses the conditions Billy has been living in, and a series of strange encounters make her wonder what he has been up to.

videos.title: Episode 458 - Raw Nerve
videos.overview: Julia finds out about Tracy's night out with Jamie and is concerned about how Doreen will react. Thinking he has discovered who killed Lucky, Paul is intent on revenge.

videos.title: Episode 459 - Reporting
videos.overview: Pat's foolishness causes more work to be lost, and Terry is not pleased. Paul continues to gather evidence and is determined to use it against them, when he should really be reading a letter Gordon has written to him.

videos.title: Episode 460 - Explaining
videos.overview: Billy returns home unexpectedly. When he discovers what Paul has done, Gordon has a confession to make. Annabelle leaves Paul and Gordon to go to her mother's.

videos.title: Episode 461 - Sunday Dinner
videos.overview: Pat and Terry want the world to know that Paul has been spying for the DHSS, and they place a banner on their roof pointing to his house. Paul and Gordon burn their dinner.

videos.title: Episode 462 - Crossfire
videos.overview: Jimmy makes a suggestion, which might end Billy's bad luck. Sheila's mind is made up, but Margaret may be having second thoughts. Annabelle returns home and takes swift action to have the banner maligning Paul removed. When Tracy gives a young girl the hairstyle she wants, she is sacked.

videos.title: Episode 463 - Bad Gamble
videos.overview: Doreen decides the time has come to make a shrewd investment; she asks Damon to place a bet on a horse race for her. Billy and Doreen discover Tracy has lost her job. There are new arrivals on the Close.

videos.title: Episode 464 - Hickory Dickory Dock
videos.overview: Damon and Mark use an old clock to extricate themselves from a financial predicament. Doreen goes to the salon to try to convince Shelley to give Tracy her job back.

videos.title: Episode 465 - No Inner Peace
videos.overview: Bobby feels that too much is expected of him. Damon tries to impress Debbie with his culinary skills, but Mark has been trying to spice things up. Billy puts Doreen's winnings on another "cert."

videos.title: Episode 466 - Ti Amo
videos.overview: Bobby and Sheila's holiday in Rome goes from bad to worse, and neither of them can see how to mend things. Billy considers breaking the law to resolve his financial problems, and Doreen meets Jamie for the first time, just as the Corkhills have run out of toilet rolls.

videos.title: Episode 467 - Pride And Guts
videos.overview: While the Corkhills are at Rod's passing-out parade, Jimmy carries out a spot of burglary. Billy is appalled by the results, and he's not the only one.......

videos.title: Episode 468 - Writing Fiction
videos.overview: Jonathan is annoyed that Joanne is still hanging around, and Laura is annoyed that she has been trying on all her clothes. Preparing an insurance claim, Paul has to decide how many portable televisions were stolen along with Gordon's suede jacket and electric drill.

videos.title: Episode 469 - Accusing
videos.overview: Having agreed to do some work for the church, Sheila is taken aback when Father Gibbons brings his laundry round. Mona accuses Paul of attempting to poison her. Billy insists that Jimmy retrieves Annabelle's stolen brooch.

videos.title: Episode 470 - Washing
videos.overview: Rod's talk about his police work makes Billy feel uneasy. Pat and Terry finally realise that Harry is serious about selling their house when they find him showing an estate agent round it.

videos.title: Episode 471 - Deckchairs
videos.overview: Mona is becoming more and more paranoid about Paul. Laura is becoming disenchanted with the wedding arrangements. Vicky makes a decision which pleases Terry, and at the Grants', Father Gibbons finds he has to take a deckchair instead of a pew.

videos.title: Episode 472 - Sling It
videos.overview: Doreen's money worries start to affect her work. Paul and Annabelle discover what Mona is doing with her food and why.

videos.title: Episode 473 - Blocked
videos.overview: A problem with the drains escalates into a full-scale alert on the Close. Mr McGrath warns Damon off Debbie, but Damon is not keen on following his advice.

videos.title: Episode 474 - Going Spare
videos.overview: Jack experiences a certain amount of pain after his hand spends too much time on Vicki's bottom. Harry finds out why his toilet is blocked - but only after he has smashed it.

videos.title: Episode 475 - Barking Mad
videos.overview: Mona is concerned that Annabelle and Paul will put her into a home. Terry quickly regrets not listening to Vicki's advice. Jonathan and Laura discover a hole in the road - but not until their car falls into it.

videos.title: Episode 476 - Down the Drain
videos.overview: Vicki tells Terry that she is going to leave. The hole in the road claims another victim.......

videos.title: Episode 477 - Nuisances
videos.overview: Billy is furious when the neighbours keep driving over his garden to avoid the hole in the road, and confronts Pat.

videos.title: Episode 478 - Job Offer
videos.overview: Desperation causes Billy to open up his loft, then he finds that he needs to keep Rod at the door. Damon is offered a job, but can he keep a straight face?

videos.title: Episode 479 - Extra Care
videos.overview: Doreen is looking for a shoulder to cry on, and her boss has one available.......

videos.title: Episode 480 - Always a Way
videos.overview: The Corkhills have to face repossession, but Mr Howman has an offer of help with easy repayments by Doreen. Pat blackmails his way into the band.

videos.title: Episode 481 - Forces
videos.overview: Doreen still hasn't told Billy about the mortgage, and Mr Howman's offer begins to look appealing. Harry carries out a geological survey with a coat-hanger. Pat makes his debut with the band.

videos.title: Episode 482 - Circling
videos.overview: Laura buys a painting that really has "something", but Jonathan thinks it's incurable. Tracy and Jamie have a slight accident with Rod's shirt. When Doreen tells Billy what she nearly did with Mr Howman in a hotel room, everyone else's front gardens end up suffering.......

videos.title: Episode 483 - Unwelcome
videos.overview: Harry tries to discover where Ralph is going. Mona is due out of hospital, and Paul resents her impending return. Laura convinces Jonathan to have an AIDS test, while Damon has doors shut in his face at every opportunity.

videos.title: Episode 484 - Grandmother's Rising
videos.overview: Billy decides that more criminal action is called for. Mona gives Gordon a family heirloom to pass on to his girlfriend.

videos.title: Episode 485 - Just a Job
videos.overview: Harry learns where Ralph has been, and becomes confused. Debbie thinks Damon is going to chuch her. Laura has news about her deportation case.

videos.title: Episode 486 - Approval
videos.overview: Mona discovers the truth about Chris. Tracy and Rod find out how desperate the Corkhills' situation is.

videos.title: Episode 487 - Happy Medium
videos.overview: Jonathan starts to have doubts about Laura. Against Harry's better advice, Ralph invites a medium to visit the Close. Damon tries to finish with Debbie, but she wins him back with an ice-cream.

videos.title: Episode 488 - Fire and Liver
videos.overview: Jonathan feels that it is time to make Laura choose. Bobby and Paul each have their own interpretations of Edna's message from beyond the grave, but are Harry and Ralph going to place a winning bet?

videos.title: Episode 489 - Just Postpojned
videos.overview: Laura's parents are not too happy when they hear Laura's decision about the wedding. Gordon is annoyed when Chris offers to rent Mona's home to Ralph.

videos.title: Episode 490 - Compulsive Liar
videos.overview: Sheila takes a turn for the worse, Gordon tackles Chris about rent money. Laura becomes a compulsive liar.

videos.title: Episode 491 - Bad Influence
videos.overview: There's trouble for Chris when Paul and Annabelle find out where Ralph has been staying in the Lake District. There's a surprise in the post for Pat on his 28th birthday.

videos.title: Episode 492 - First One
videos.overview: Jonathan and Laura's first wedding guest arrives, not having received the message about its postponement. Rod is desperate to make a first arrest, but it turns out to be a real anti-climax.

videos.title: Episode 493 - Cover-up
videos.overview: Someone forgets to pick up rings from the jewellers, while all the evidence seems to be supporting the view that Alison is on the game.......

videos.title: Episode 494 - A Good Job
videos.overview: A window opens for Damon, but will it shut the door on his relationship with Debbie?

videos.title: Episode 495 - Takeover Bid
videos.overview: Now that Laura and Jonathan's big problems are behind them, the little things like cork tiles are getting them down. Damon has to decide whether to look a gift McGrath in the mouth.

videos.title: Episode 496 - Bargaining
videos.overview: The marquee arrives, and it looks as if someone hasn't been very accurate regarding the measurements, or in which garden it is to be installed.......

videos.title: Episode 497 - Recruiting
videos.overview: Surprisingly enough, the mix of their song on the demo tape causes the girls in the band to resent Pat. Billy is offered a job, but it's not the sort of job he can tell Doreen or Rod about.......

videos.title: Episode 498 - Not Ready
videos.overview: Laura has bad news. Terry decides it's time to call a halt to Pat's behaviour. Bobby extends the hand of friendship, although he knows Sheila is unlikely to co-operate with the promise he makes.

videos.title: Episode 499 - Nearly There
videos.overview: Laura reassures Jonathan that she does want to marry him, as they have a joint mortgage, but he's still not convinced that it will go ahead. Billy receives some instructions, and Ellie and Trish drop Pat and Fran from the band.

videos.title: Episode 500 - Ready
videos.overview: With only a few hours to go until the wedding, Laura disappears. Meanwhile, Billy prepares for the robbery, and needs to establish a good alibi.......

videos.title: Episode 501 - Stabbed
videos.overview: The robbery attempt goes disastrously wrong for Billy. Bobby finally plucks up the courage to tell Sheila what he has done.

videos.title: Episode 502 - Token Gestures
videos.overview: Bobby and Sheila have a tense lunch with Stan and Mrs Higgins. Billy tried to find out the condition of the stabbed supermarket manager. When Harry finds his tomatoes all over the Close, he decides to set up an action group. There is not much harmony among the members of the band.

videos.title: Episode 503 - A Quiet Close
videos.overview: Harry wants to show potential housebuyer Alison what a quiet close she would be moving to, but Tracy returns home in tears after being attacked, and Mona starts throwing crockery out of the bedroom window, accusing Paul and Annabelle of attempted murder.

videos.title: Episode 504 - Easier Said Than Done
videos.overview: Harry's meeting is not very well attended. Gene comes to the Close to confront Billy and threaten Tracy. Paul and Annabelle are disappointed when Mona's doctor refuses to sign her committal forms.

videos.title: Episode 505 - We Don't Need Them
videos.overview: Both factions of the band plan to dump the other after the gig. Tracy sees Billy in town talking to the man who attacked her. Paul finds it hard to keep the pace when he unexpectedly meets someone else who is training for the Marathon.

videos.title: Episode 506 - Double Crossing
videos.overview: Paul and Annabelle receive an unexpected visit from a social worker. Pat leave the Close for Dubai, but not before double-crossing Harry.

videos.title: Episode 507 - Forward Planning
videos.overview: The honeymooners return, and Jonathan finds out that Laura has been applying for a new job. Harry places a bet on the results of the Mersey Marathon. Mona decides to change her will to leave her home to Gordon.

videos.title: Episode 508 - Doubters
videos.overview: Both Jonathan and Harry take the credit when there is a flurry of activity around the hole in the Close. Laura has second thoughts about her job offer, but so does Jonathan. Harry is determined to sell his house, but is unaware that there is a conspiracy against him.

videos.title: Episode 509 - Exposing
videos.overview: Gene spills the wrong beans when he is arrested. Mona sees more than she bargained for when she turns up unexpectedly at Harry's, and reports him to the police for indecent exposure and possession of chocolate. Ralph fails to heed Paul's warnings about the dangers of trowels.

videos.title: Episode 510 - Disturbing the Peace
videos.overview: Annabelle draws the line at Paul's ideas about repelling ants. Doreen decides to leave Billy. Laura tells Jonathan where he can stick his new CD system.

videos.title: Episode 511 - Making a Will
videos.overview: Harry decides that he and Ralph should prepare their wills, leading Ralph to wonder of he has any living relatives. Mona readily accepts Gordon's suggested solution to Paul and Annabelle's problems. Billy is convinced that he is about to be arrested, but he gets a bigger shock when he goes into Tracy's bedroom.

videos.title: Episode 512 - Tiles
videos.overview: Annabelle is concerned when she can't get any answer when ringing Kendal. Doreen is concerned when Billy is taken away for questioning by the police. Sinbad's roof-tiling money-making scheme is not one of his greatest successes.

videos.title: Episode 513 - Line-up
videos.overview: Rod is sent home while Billy is questioned, and Doreen's panic increases when she hears that there is to be an identity parade. Harry cannot agree with Alison on what is to happen to his furniture. Ralph discovers that his advert is open to misinterpretation.

videos.title: Episode 514 - Burgers
videos.overview: Billy cannot understand why Riordan failed to recognise him at the identity parade. Jonathan attempts to demonstrate his barbecuing skills. Paul brings Mona back from Kendal, but it is clear that she still needs help.

videos.title: Episode 515 - Barbecues
videos.overview: Laura takes her ring off, but when she goes to put it back on she can't find it. Jamie needs somewhere to stay, but discovers that Julia is looking after Rod and Tracy.

videos.title: Episode 516 - Looking
videos.overview: Ralph decides to go to the cemetery in search of clues about his ancestors. Julia is not amused when she finds out that Jamie has been staying in the Corkhills' garage, Laura spends the whole day searching for her ring.

videos.title: Episode 517 - Cracking
videos.overview: There is a happy reunion for Damon and Debbie, but there have been one or two changes while they have been apart. Ralph tries to find out who is putting flowers on Jean's grave.

videos.title: Episode 518 - Mockery
videos.overview: Damon puts his foot in it in a big way with Debbie. Ralph finds himself following a treasure hunt.

videos.title: Episode 519 - Today
videos.overview: Annabelle is not convinced that Paul should be running the Mersey Marathon, or that he should be allowing Matty to use their shower. It's Laura's 24th birthday, but she is totally unprepared for the shock which awaits her.......

videos.title: Episode 520 - Alive, Just....
videos.overview: Damon wants Debbie to come and stay, but Bobby and Sheila have other ideas. Paul and Annabelle hear that someone they know has died. Jonathan is not prepared for what he finds when he returns home to look for Laura.

videos.title: Episode 521 - Exhibits
videos.overview: Billy discovers that he is going to have to pay a price for his freedom. Paul runs the Marathon, but will he finish it?

videos.title: Episode 522 - And Then There Was One
videos.overview: Geoff becomes less optimistic about Laura's chances of recovery, and tries to find out how the accident could have happened. Annabelle is concerned by Paul's twinges before and during the Marathon, but Matty reassures her. Doreen pleads with Billy not to go along with Riordan's plan. Damon and Debbie leave, and Sheila feels that she and Bobby have let them down.

videos.title: Episode 523 - Bathrobe
videos.overview: Barry tries to convince both his new girlfriend Ursula and Terry that he has turned over a new leaf and branched out into the tree business, but then he has to made a quick getaway minus his underpants from the home of a gangster with a sh-sh-sh-shotgun.

videos.title: Episode 524 - S-S-Sullied
videos.overview: Sizzler turns up on the Close in search of his missing bathrobe. Jonathan receives bad news about Laura. Billy has to choose between Doreen and Riordan.

videos.title: Episode 525 - Not Today. Santa
videos.overview: Sinbad makes a series of bad moves, and there is bad news for Terry. Harry is offered the post of Part Time Joint Membership Co-ordinator of the Commonwealth and Empire Club, whose responsibilities sound suspiciously similar to those of a doorman.......

videos.title: Episode 526 - Community Service
videos.overview: Bobby is concerned when Barry gets Sheila a video recorder, and annoyed when he finds out why. Terry moves in with Jonathan, who helps him to reach an amicable settlement with Harry. Billy and Jimmy confront Riordan, and Sizzler outlines his community s-s-s-service requirements.

videos.title: Episode 527 - That's It
videos.overview: Barry puts two and two together, and Jonathan discovers what - and who - caused Laura's accident. Doreen has to decide whether she will go back to Billy. Now that Harry is the Commonwealth and Empire Club doorman, Ralph has no chance of meeting the entrance requirements.

videos.title: Episode 528 - Non-active Status
videos.overview: Laura's parents are concerned to find that Terry has moved in with Jonathan, and refuse to prepare for the worst. Billy's hopes of a reconciliation with Doreen are dashed. Ralph finally gains entry to the Commonwealth and Empire Club, only to discover that he isn't actually allowed to do anything there.......

videos.title: Episode 529 - Complications
videos.overview: Harry is still taking his role at the Commonwealth and Empire Club seriously. Barry and Sinbad return some stolen property. Bobby and Sheila prepare for a night out, unaware that some terrible news is about to be brought to them......

videos.title: Episode 530 - Our Fault
videos.overview: Bobby and Sheila go to identify Damon's body, leaving Billy to break the news to Barry. Sheila blames herself, while Bobby blames Debbie....... A visitor to Jonathan's makes Terry wonder what the new year will bring.

videos.title: Episode 531 - Vigil
videos.overview: Damon's body is brought home, and Sheila prepares for an all-night vigil. There are other unexpected arrivals.

videos.title: Episode 532 - A Special Fella
videos.overview: At Damon's final farewell, Barry decides to set the record straight. New residents arrive on the Close.

videos.title: Episode 533 - Tolerance
videos.overview: Harry makes an effort to be nice to his new tenants, the Rogers family, but starts to regret it. Rod becomes romantic with Kirsty. Paul and Annabelle agree to let Chris stay with them for a while.

videos.title: Episode 534 - Snakes
videos.overview: Harry finds that he has to seek reassurances that his new tenants have no mad dogs, pet snakes or grass growing in their living room. Paul and Sammy are both aware that "Growler" is playing truant, but will either of them tell his parents?

videos.title: Episode 535 - Fairy Lights
videos.overview: Terry is full of Christmas cheer, until he is stranded with nowhere to go. Billy receives a letter from Doreen.

videos.title: Episode 536 - Presents
videos.overview: Sitting in for his father as Santa, Terry decides to try to impress Sue by leaving the present she asks for at her office, but she thinks she is being stalked and gets Jonathan to lodge a complaint with the store. As Christmas approaches, Billy hopes that his luck is changing.

videos.title: Episode 537 - A Quiet Christmas
videos.overview: The Grants are about to go away for Christmas, but something is holding them back. Gordon makes a confession, and so does Terry. When Chrissy asks Frank to invite a couple of the neighbours for a drink on her behalf, the ones that arrive aren't who she is expecting..

videos.title: Episode 538 - Christmas Dinner
videos.overview: Laura's parents disapprove of Jonathan's plans for Christmas and the future. There is conflict in the Rogers household on Christmas Day, while the Collins family find Mona's allegations difficult to believe.

videos.title: Episode 539 - Active Imaginations
videos.overview: Sammy is left in charge when Frank and Chrissy go out to celebrate New Year, but her idea of fun isn't exactly safe. Terry plans a romantic New Year, but the best-laid plans.......

videos.title: Episode 540 - New Year, New Start
videos.overview: Jonathan is not amused to find his room occupied when he returns home. Bobby makes a resolution, but has he left it too late? Frank and Chrissy solve the mystery of the Lone Ranger.

videos.title: Episode 541 - The Gift Of Life
videos.overview: Laura's life-support machine is turned off. Ralph finds out that Harry is going to be on the panel interviewing him for membership of the Commonwealth and Empire Club.

videos.title: Episode 542 - Pertinent Questions
videos.overview: Bobby resents Sheila's studying. Jonathan has to face the inquest into Laura's death, and decides to lie in order to prevent her parents from discovering the truth.

videos.title: Episode 543 - Ways And Means
videos.overview: Paul feels that Chris has overstayed his welcome. Terry and Annabelle are surprised by the way Jonathan is behaving following Laura's cremation.

videos.title: Episode 544 - Moral Judgements
videos.overview: Jonathan invites Terry to go on a holiday with him. Growler is driving everyone up the wall. Annabelle has an embarrassing experience involving a man in a rusty old car. Harry's economy drive backfires.

videos.title: Episode 545 - Contraflow
videos.overview: Terry tests the power and effectiveness of Jonathan's cordless telephone, and invites Sue round to help him fill in his taxi licence application form. Gordon is jealous that Chris is getting a free trip to St Moritz.

videos.title: Episode 546 - Rearranging
videos.overview: Annabelle receives a letter from Mona asking for help. Frank's chances of getting a new job take a turn for the worse. Gordon feels that Paul will never understand him.

videos.title: Episode 547 - Paperwork
videos.overview: Bobby thinks he has done a good turn, but Sheila doesn't react in the way he expects. Paul is surprised to find that Annabelle is willing to give Terry a reference. Growler and Bumper accidentally cause some people's plans to go up in smoke.

videos.title: Episode 548 - Hoping For.......
videos.overview: Annabelle is disappointed with Paul's attitude to the new neighbours, and he fails to prevent her from giving Terry another reference. Bobby can't seem to put a foot right with Sheila. Sue wants to keep her business and private life seperate.

videos.title: Episode 549 - I'm Keeping It
videos.overview: Paul's mug is broken, so he doesn't let Gordon watch "The Magic Rabbits". Chrissy receives a letter from the school about Sammy's coat. Brian comes to Annabelle's aid when her car breaks down. Growler and Bumper retaliate when their football is confiscated.

videos.title: Episode 550 - Someone To Blame
videos.overview: Billy is on the spot when Tracy wants to know all about Doreen and his involvement in crime. When Jamie needs money, he finds a surprisingly easy way of earning it on the Close. A household loses two of its members.

videos.title: Episode 551 - Sorry, Sorry, Sorry
videos.overview: Bobby appears in court on the drink-driving charge, and is fined £150. He and Barry go for a drink together, and forget to bring something home....... Annabelle receives another strange letter from her mother.

videos.title: Episode 552 - School Rules
videos.overview: Chrissy confronts Sammy's headmistress, and is determined to make Frank's company keep to their word. The Corkhills' becomes a haven for waifs and strays.

videos.title: Episode 553 - Venison
videos.overview: Gordon makes an unexpected return to the Close - in an ambulance. Jamie is a victim of Rod's dedication to his police work, and when Jimmy is left to handle the food supply at number 10, it's best not to question where it came from.

videos.title: Episode 554 - Pancakes
videos.overview: All of a sudden, both Paul and Annabelle are keen to visit Mona. Harry realises that he has to take action now that there is a vacant committee post.

videos.title: Episode 555 - Comradeship
videos.overview: Jimmy's mistress, Kathy, arrives at the Corkhills'. Harry and Ralph are both urgently seeking sponsors. Paul refuses to ring Chris on Gordon's behalf.

videos.title: Episode 556 - Our Grandchild
videos.overview: Mr McGrath brings news about Debbie to the Grants, and ends up being thrown out of the house. Chris is amused to find Gordon looking like something out of "Doctor Who". Mona turns up late at night, claiming that she is being beaten at the home.

videos.title: Episode 557 - Elected
videos.overview: Harry employs below-the-belt tactics in his bid to be elected to the committee after his sponsor realises he has been conned. Jamie tries to convince Billy to allow him to move in indefinitely.

videos.title: Episode 558 - Speechless
videos.overview: There is an unexpected setback for Harry during his inaugural anti-women speech at the Commonwealth and Empire Club. Mona is in a bad way. Jimmy has an ingenious solution to the Corkhills' overcrowding problem.

videos.title: Episode 559 - Knocking Through
videos.overview: Bobby has bad news for Sheila. Ralph decides to build a model of the Close. Jamie is woken up by the sound of holes being drilled all around him.

videos.title: Episode 560 - Lives Wasted
videos.overview: Bobby throws some hurtful allegations at Sheila, and they both seek solace in their own way. Terry makes a rash decision when he hears of Sue's resignation. Tracy and Jamie move out.

videos.title: Episode 561 - Commonwealth Day
videos.overview: Ralph's entertainment for Commonwealth Day at the Commonwealth and Empire Club doesn't quite fit the bill, but there's somebody around to save the day.

videos.title: Episode 562 - Kidnapped
videos.overview: Betty has an issue that she wants Harry to bring up at his first committee meeting. Terry is dubious about Barry's latest proposition. Chris and Gordon kidnap Mona.

videos.title: Episode 563 - Convinced
videos.overview: Terry makes a friend on holiday, while Jonathan finds it harder to cope. Paul receives unexpected assistance in his investigation of the care home. Billy discovers that Tracy has gone to London.

videos.title: Episode 564 - Out Of Order
videos.overview: Billy finds Jimmy's stolen loot. Jonathan feels that his spirits are too low for a holiday. Terry takes his chances on the piste. Harry and Ralph try to raise the possibility of admitting women at the committee meeting.

videos.title: Episode 565 - Living With Guilt
videos.overview: Barry is caught in the act, and Sheila tears a strip off Billy. Terry finds that ice-skating is just as difficult as skiing, and while he and Donna watch a dancing display, Jonathan and Cheryl play backgammon. Jamie comes back from London without Tracy.

videos.title: Episode 566 - Old Mates
videos.overview: Rod goes to London to search for Tracy. Donna drops a bombshell. Billy wonders whether his children would prefer to be with their mother. There's a surprise awaiting Kathy when she goes out looking for a fight.

videos.title: Episode 567 - Pull The Other One
videos.overview: The trail for Tracy goes dead for Rod and Jamie. Billy discovers he can't even count on Jimmy to be dishonest. Chrissy wonders where Growler got his football.

videos.title: Episode 568 - Holiday Friendships
videos.overview: Rod returns from London, but his news isn't good. Bobby receives a tip-off about the effects of automation. Sue's nose is out of joint when she finds out how popular Terry is with the ladies.

videos.title: Episode 569 - Sights
videos.overview: Barry and Sinbad show Cheryl and Donna the sights of Liverpool. Tracy returns from London, and Billy is all set to have a go at her. Frank gets a shock when he discovers he has lost something.

videos.title: Episode 570 - Held
videos.overview: Following the theft of Frank's articulated lorry, he is interrogated by the police and his home is thoroughly searched. Growler fears that the stolen football will be found.

videos.title: Episode 571 - Costing
videos.overview: Frank's story is not believed, Sheila seeks spiritual guidance, Bobby agrees to contribute his wages to the strike fund, and Barry receives a tip-off about his trees. Tracy tries to persuade Kathy to stay even though Jimmy has dumped her to go back to his wife.

videos.title: Episode 572 - Someone To Talk To
videos.overview: Bobby has a big decision to make as a strike seems possible at a factory. Sheila visits a marriage guidance counsellor.

videos.title: Episode 573 - Serious Misconduct
videos.overview: Things look bad for Frank as he faces a discliplinary hearing. There are revelations in the post for Bobby, an awkward customer for Sinbad, and an unexpected question for Sue.......about wallpaper.

videos.title: Episode 574 - Expert Opinion
videos.overview: Both Bobby and Sheila realise that they have been somewhat economical with the truth. Terry delegates the choice of Jonathan's wallpaper to Sue, and the decorating itself to Sinbad.......

videos.title: Episode 575 - Clubbing It
videos.overview: Kathy doesn't make Jimmy welcome when he returns to the Close, and she and Sheila decide to go out to a nightclub. When Tracy isn't available, Billy has to look after Claire.

videos.title: Episode 576 - Sexual Chemistry
videos.overview: Sheila and Kathy's night out has an unpleasant ending, and Paul also gets a shock.

videos.title: Episode 577 - Retaliation
videos.overview: Barry replaces the broken glass in Billy's door, then Bobby smashes it again. Paul wants to confront Gordon and Chris, but he has forgotten that it is Annabelle's birthday.

videos.title: Episode 578 - Rain Forest
videos.overview: Gordon and Chris consider buying a home together, and Chris has an idea about where the deposit might come from. Jonathan tries to find out who planted a rain forest in his back garden.

videos.title: Episode 579 - Absenteeism
videos.overview: Barry offers financial help to his parents, but Sheila wonders where he is getting the money from. Tracy is behaving very mysteriously. Harry is annoyed to discover than Ralph has disposed of two of his gnomes.

videos.title: Episode 580 - No Splits
videos.overview: There's a crisis in the factory, and Bobby is nowhere to be found, so Sheila has to cover up. Gordon and Chris receive a letter from the building society. Barry finds he must do some more community s-s-s-service.

videos.title: Episode 581 - Serious Words
videos.overview: Harry's gnomes are disappearing again. Bobby's whereabouts are still a mystery to George. Jonathan's boss has a few stern words with him.

videos.title: Episode 582 - Surprising Answers
videos.overview: Paul is in a panic over Mona and her money. Jonathan needs to find a missing paragraph. Harry catches the gnome-napper red-handed.

videos.title: Episode 583 - Get Them Down
videos.overview: The Grants' house goes up for sale. The Collins' glass door is the next to be smashed to pieces, and Jamie is caught with his trousers down.

videos.title: Episode 584 - Desert Rats
videos.overview: Jonathan takes a chance to dig deeper in search of the missing paragraph, and Paul prepares his speech. Chrissy is keen to see the model Growler claims to have made.

videos.title: Episode 585 - Mind Your Backs
videos.overview: Growler deceives Chrissy. Despite Betty's protests, Paul goes ahead with his D-Day speech. Gordon and Chris enjoy a night out, but the aftermath is not as pleasant.

videos.title: Episode 586 - No Contest
videos.overview: Gordon and Chris are charged. Sue and Terry's quiet night is interrupted. Sizzler explains what he requires Barry to do.

videos.title: Episode 587 - Insight
videos.overview: Jonathan tries to write a letter of apology, until Terry convinces him that he shouldn't bother. On the morning of Jamie's interview, he finds hiself asleep on the lawn. Sue repays the money that Terry owes Barry.

videos.title: Episode 588 - Leaning
videos.overview: Jonathan makes yet another attempt to prove that the missing paragraph was not his fault.

videos.title: Episode 589 - Now We Know
videos.overview: Sue joins Jonathan in his detective work. Jimmy's gift of a carpet is not appreciated. Kirsty is furious when a set of cufflinks mysteriously turns into something else.

videos.title: Episode 590 - Big Smile.......
videos.overview: Growler and Bumper get themselves into deeper trouble when they show Ralph's model to their teacher. The mystery of the packet found in Rod's jacket continues.

videos.title: Episode 591 - No Wazzocks
videos.overview: Ralph gets a surprise when he takes a look at the local newspaper. Jonathan asks Terry to help arrange a barbecue, and Matty plays host to an annoying potential housebuyer.

videos.title: Episode 592 - Early Retirement
videos.overview: Barry takes Penny to a hotel, but their passion doesn't go unrecorded. Bumper and Growler retrieve the model, but leave behind some incriminating evidence. Jonathan gives a barbecue party, but one of the guests has to be asked to leave.

videos.title: Episode 593 - The Last Pancake
videos.overview: Sheila returns from Basingstoke with news for Barry. Sammy is feeling off-colour, and Chrissy suspects that something may be really wrong.

videos.title: Episode 594 - Business Is Business
videos.overview: Chrissy discovers an article on teenage pregnancy Sammy has been reading and becomes more worried. Things may be about to hot up between Billy and Kathy.

videos.title: Episode 595 - Dirty Insinuations
videos.overview: The relationship between Billy and Kathy is much talked-about. When a scarf is shown around the school, some people recognise it.

videos.title: Episode 596 - Common Interest
videos.overview: Jimmy apologises for casting aspersions while under the influence, but Kathy is not impressed. Growler's absence is causing concern. Penny insists that Barry retrieves the videotape from Sizzler.

videos.title: Episode 597 - You Know Something
videos.overview: The police The police shock Chrissy and Frank. Sue wants Barry to return the money she gave him.Chrissy and Frank. Sue wants Barry to return the money she gave him.

videos.title: Episode 598 - No Bumpy Roads!
videos.overview: Frank and Chrissy steel themselves to expect the worst. Terry has a nightmare experience at the wheel of his taxi.

videos.title: Episode 599 - Hello, Mum
videos.overview: Growler's disappearance brings back memories of Damon for Sheila, while Frank and Chrissy are blaming each other. Terry continues to have a hard time, and a wanderer returns.

videos.title: Episode 600 - Remember That?
videos.overview: The Rogers' holiday doesn't start off very well. Jamie has an unfortunate encounter. Sheila is beginning to have doubts about her course - can she regain the confidence she needs?

videos.title: Episode 601 - Just The Start
videos.overview: The Collins family are receiving some frightening phonecalls, then things turn violent. Annabelle makes it clear just how far she is prepared to go with Brian.

videos.title: Episode 602 - Not The Same
videos.overview: Sue tells Terry what she has done for him, but will his male pride be able to accept it? Paul and Annabelle settle Mona in her new home - but while they are away, the mysterious white car turns up again.......

videos.title: Episode 603 - Calling Card
videos.overview: Penny fears for Barry's life if he insists on playing the tough guy. Paul doesn't know what he is letting himself in for when he tries to provoke a reaction from the thugs. As Rod and Kirsty plan to celebrate good news, there is an unexpected arrival.......

videos.title: Episode 604 - Congratulations, Harry
videos.overview: The burnt-out car is still on the Close, and the callers are on the line again. Harry, however, has some good news to celebrate.

videos.title: Episode 605 - Following Through
videos.overview: Paul tries to enlist help from his neighbours when the thugs threaten to return, but no-one seems to be willing, and there are ugly scenes when they turn up. Jonathan and Sarah fly off to Calgary.

videos.title: Episode 606 - Resistance
videos.overview: The solidarity of the Close sees off the queer-bashers, but there's a price to pay. Jonathan reveals to Sarah that his next destination is not Liverpool.......

videos.title: Episode 607 - Called In
videos.overview: Rod becomes involved in an allegation of police brutality. When the Corkhills don't confer with Jamie on what to get Tracy for her birthday, the results are obvious. Annabelle is surprised to discover who Paul has asked to remove the car, but there's a bigger shock for Jonathan in Vancouver.

videos.title: Episode 608 - She's Forgotten
videos.overview: Sheila leaves the Close, declining a farewell drink with Kathy. Sizzler has a job for Barry to do in return for the tape. It is Tracy's 18th birthday, but there is no card from Doreen.

videos.title: Episode 609 - Shaking
videos.overview: All Jamie's endeavours at the Job Club come to nothing. Annabelle refuses to go out with Paul because she has other plans. Jonathan is put in a difficult position, in more ways than one.

videos.title: Episode 610 - Taking Off
videos.overview: It's rehearsal time for Cheryl's wedding, but there is a surprise in store for her. Chrissy blames Growler for leaving the bath in a mess - until the true culprit arrives, wanting to use it again.......

videos.title: Episode 611 - After All I've Said!
videos.overview: Sizzler has another job for Barry, but this one involves something gruesome. Annabelle has some secret plans for a weekend away. There are a few problems for the Rogers family on the first day of term.

videos.title: Episode 612 - The Condemned Dog
videos.overview: Barry has to decide whether to follow Sizzler's instructions and kill Ma Johnson's dog. Frank decides that it is time to take some direct action, as Growler has been bunking off again. Jonathan unwisely offers to shake hands with Deburau while standing on the riverside.

videos.title: Episode 613 - All Arranged
videos.overview: Paul is surprised when Annabelle insists on going to her conference. Barry tries to make Ma Johnson see sense. Harry aims to maximise his chances of a committee victory, and a house on the Close is broken into.

videos.title: Episode 614 - Surprise, Surprise
videos.overview: Annabelle's liaisons with Brian don't go entirely unnoticed. Sammy and Growler both have medical appointments, Jonathan is reunited with Cheryl, and Barry and Penny are appalled when they finally get to see Sizzler's tape.

videos.title: Episode 615 - Knived
videos.overview: Sheila returns to the Close and finds Barry trying to recover from his break-up with Penny. The second part of Operation Hickory doesn't go as planned for Rod.

videos.title: Episode 616 - Conflabs
videos.overview: Frank has a series of confrontations, some more successful than others. Harry has a decision to make, and knows who he has to consult first. Cheryl has her interview, but is too nervous to tell Jonathan.

videos.title: Episode 617 - Up For Sale
videos.overview: Harry's romantic tea with Betty is interrupted by an unwelcome guest. Kathy visits Sheila, and can't believe what she finds.

videos.title: Episode 618 - You Can't Stay Here
videos.overview: Harry has an offer on the house, and Sammy starts her new job. Tracy's work situation doesn't get any better, but there's a comforting arm close at hand.

videos.title: Episode 619 - In The Way
videos.overview: Cheryl settles into her new home, but Sue is worried about Terry's feelings. The contracts are exchanged on the Grants' house, leaving Barry homeless.

videos.title: Episode 620 - That Kind Of A Day
videos.overview: As Jonathan is about to head out for a night on the town with Cheryl, he drops his car keys down a drain. There is a birthday surprise for Billy.

videos.title: Episode 621 - Distracted
videos.overview: Sheila insists on paying for her keep, but for Billy there's no smoke without fire. Frank tries to find somewhere to hide a bicycle, while Rod's forgetfulness could have serious repercussions.......

videos.title: Episode 622 - A Hard Day
videos.overview: Rod's sergeant initiates a search for the purse that was handed in, so he needs to decide whether to confess. Gerrard is making life difficult for Tracy, and there is some devastating news for Chrissy and Frank.

videos.title: Episode 623 - Absent Friends
videos.overview: Ralph employs undercover tactics to find out what Chrissy is up to. When Jimmy has an accident while cleaning the Collins' windows, he needs to lay his hands on a bathroom suite at short notice.......

videos.title: Episode 624 - Flooded
videos.overview: Frank decides that he is not going to stand for the post of shop steward, despite the protests. Barry turns the water back on at the Grants', with disastrous consequences.

videos.title: Episode 625 - Busybodies
videos.overview: A chance comment made by Chrissy gets back to Ralph and causes offence. Paul and Annabelle are surprised when they see their new bathroom suite.

videos.title: Episode 626 - Where Have You Been?
videos.overview: Paul becomes suspicious as to Annabelle's whereabouts and quizzes her when she returns. Kathy, meanwhile, wants to know where Linda is.

videos.title: Episode 627 - Plan B
videos.overview: Jimmy has to extricate himself from the Grants', while Tracy is persuaded to meet up with Gerrard. Annabelle finds that she will have to go on her weekend away with Paul instead of Brian, whose carelessness results in Sheila discovering her affair.

videos.title: Episode 628 - Get Stuck In
videos.overview: Katie finds out that in the nativity play she will be playing a sheaf of corn instead of the Virgin Mary. Frank decides that it is time for new tactics over the toilets, and blocks them. Terry proposes to Sue.

videos.title: Episode 629 - Unblocked
videos.overview: Gordon is worried about his health as he begins to show the early warning symptoms of AIDS. Sheila discovers that Bobby has gone to Poland, and worries about her financial situation.

videos.title: Episode 630 - Outmanoeuvred
videos.overview: Tracy is bonding with Nikki as a result of their mutual hatred of Gerrard. Sheila is bonding with Billy over money, but Kathy is stood up on a dinner date when he gets a better offer.

videos.title: Episode 631 - A Positive Step
videos.overview: Gordon receives good news and resolves to turn over a new leaf. Kathy hopes that a new dress will help to lure Billy away from Linda.

videos.title: Episode 632 - Don't Mention The War
videos.overview: Rod faces a police enquiry, Kathy adopts a new ploy to win Billy, Gordon reads a disturbing rumour on his first day at work, and no-one mentions the war.

videos.title: Episode 633 - Bitter Thoughts
videos.overview: Sue has to explain her reaction to Martin, and Terry doesn't find her explanation entirely convincing. Sheila has to face the anniversary of Damon's death alone.

videos.title: Episode 634 - So What?
videos.overview: Gordon confronts Brian over what he is up to with Annabelle, and is surprised by his reaction. Kathy enlists Julia's help to get rid of Linda.

videos.title: Episode 635 - Ex Nihilo Nihil
videos.overview: Kathy and Julia's cunning plans turns out not to be cunning enough. Gerrard returns from his holiday, determined to convince Tracy to go out with him. Katie is upset because Growler makes her believe she was adopted.

videos.title: Episode 636 - Arabs
videos.overview: Harry is expecting a family of Arabian brain surgeons to move into his house, but is about to be disappointed. Julia is causing conflict.

videos.title: Episode 637 - Ticklish
videos.overview: The furniture is getting on top of Harry, and Gerrard is getting Tracy down. Terry looks for a partnership, while Sheila looks for somewhere else to live.

videos.title: Episode 638 - A Lot To Learn
videos.overview: Brian thinks that Gordon lacks motivation. As they await Doreen's return, Billy and Rod argue. Tracy confides in Sheila, and Terry receives an offer.

videos.title: Episode 639 - Perestroika
videos.overview: Tracy tells Gerrard to back off, and there is bad news for Billy as Julia confesses to telling a lie. Rod's superintendent tries to persuade him to reveal more about Operation Hickory.

videos.title: Episode 640 - Deceived
videos.overview: Gordon learns a few tricks and makes a sale. Brian and Annabelle get their cover-stories mixed up, and Rod is confronted about his lost trousers.

videos.title: Episode 641 - Cuddly Seals
videos.overview: Barry and Sinbad enter a Christmas venture together, but it gets off to a slow start. Billy receives a card and a note from Doreen. Sheila and Julia argue.

videos.title: Episode 642 - Sacked
videos.overview: Terry sees something disturbing at a wine-bar, and Tracy gets the sack. Paul discovers Brian's Christmas present to Annabelle. When Ralph receives some bad news, Barry and Sinbad need to act quickly.

videos.title: Episode 643 - Stuffed
videos.overview: It is a rowdy Christmas Day at the Corkhills', and there is a surprise arrival. Chrissy has a theory about Growler's problem, while Frank is called into work. Sue tries to convince Terry that he was mistaken, and Paul confronts Annabelle and Brian about their affair.

videos.title: Episode 644 - So Proud
videos.overview: As Christmas Day continues, Billy dishes out the rosaries, and makes a major admission about Doreen. Sinbad and Barry are breaking and entering, while Paul is a broken man.

videos.title: Episode 645 - Nearly Finished
videos.overview: Tracy seeks help from the Citizens Advice Bureau, while Sheila consults a priest. Gordon tries to help reconcile Paul and Annabelle. A dramatic rescue is required, and Terry is the hero.

videos.title: Episode 646 - My House Is Your House
videos.overview: Jonathan wants to pay his dues, and Sheila is saying her goodbyes, as Sinbad and Barry continue to hunt for the missing seals.

videos.title: Episode 647 - Party Time
videos.overview: It's New Year on the Close, and a particularly subdued one for the Collins'. Sinbad has something for Ralph, and Barry's scheming causes Kirsty and Rod to be apart as 1989 arrives.

videos.title: Episode 648 - Relationships
videos.overview: Tracy is grilled by her lawyer. Gordon plans to leave Brian's employment, but is persuaded to stay on. The workforce want Frank to call a strike, and Paul forbids Annabelle to use his car.

videos.title: Episode 649 - Victory
videos.overview: Sheila asks for forgiveness, and Frank has some explaining to do. Paul has a few suggestions for Annabelle, Debbie has advice for Barry, and Gordon gets his revenge on Brian.

videos.title: Episode 650 - Getting A Bit Silly
videos.overview: When Jonathan and Cheryl return from their holiday, they discover that the decorating hasn't been done yet. Harry prepares his proposal to Betty. Rod needs to come up with some good explanations for not wanting Kirsty to iron his shirt.

videos.title: Episode 651 - Not Fair
videos.overview: Rod tells Kirsty about his suspicions. Gordon tells Paul about his last day at work, and Tracy has an interview at Head Office.

videos.title: Episode 652 - Lost Chances
videos.overview: Mona advises Annabelle to make up or break up. Billy is missing Sheila. Emma convinces Rod to do some overtime, and Frank realises he has been conned by the management.

videos.title: Episode 653 - Quick Off The Mark
videos.overview: It is a big day for Harry, but should he have listened to Ralph? Chrissy is visited by the mother of another child with dyslexia. Gordon makes a promising start towards his target.

videos.title: Episode 654 - Starting
videos.overview: After a lot of soul-searching, Sheila makes a major decision. Rod makes a horrifying discovery.

videos.title: Episode 655 - Love
videos.overview: Billy and Sheila are alone together at last.......until Barry walks in on them. Sammy and her friends make plans.

videos.title: Episode 656 - A Bad Start
videos.overview: Sheila is relieved that Barry won't be telling Bobby what he has discovered. Growler's first day at the remedial class goes badly.

videos.title: Episode 657 - Not All That Happy
videos.overview: Sheila moves furniture and comes clean. Sammy does her best to convince Nisha's parents to let them stay overnight at Ronnie's.

videos.title: Episode 658 - Tests
videos.overview: Betty is less than impressed with Paul when she thinks she is being used to prove a point. An important conclusion is reached about Growler.

videos.title: Episode 659 - Breaking The Rules
videos.overview: Sheila's religious convictions are still troubling her, to Billy's annoyance. Gordon's dodgy deals start to get even more dodgy. Mona announces her engagement, and Sammy and her friends have a night out.

videos.title: Episode 660 - Down
videos.overview: Gordon takes further chances in his bid to meet his target. Harry receives another disappointment, as Kevin is unwilling to change or extend his grandson's name.

videos.title: Episode 661 - Loving Care
videos.overview: Gordon tries to make Paul and Annabelle realise that they need each other, and things come to a head for them. Chrissy reaches the end of her tether, and makes a decision about Growler's schooling.

videos.title: Episode 662 - Special Attention
videos.overview: Annabelle cooks a special breakfast, but Paul still isn't happy. Tracy's solicitor tries to convince her to go ahead with her action. Growler finds that Chrissy is a much stricter teacher than he expected.

videos.title: Episode 663 - Selfishness
videos.overview: Annabelle is impressed with Paul's handling of her brother, but Emma is not as impressed with Rod's handling of a domestic incident. Growler finds it difficult to concentrate on studying, and Tracy tries to persuade Nikki to speak up.

videos.title: Episode 664 - Hawaiian Magenta
videos.overview: Sammy is confronted by a young man bringing something from Ronnie. Tired of talking about his upcoming wedding, Rod seeks comfort elsewhere. Sue discovers she is pregnant.

videos.title: Episode 665 - Hooked
videos.overview: Owen comes clean about his true motives, and Sammy is suitably intrigued. Cheryl tries to help Sue with a major dilemma. An educational welfare officer arrives to check on Chrissy's teaching of Growler at home, but Growler has gone AWOL.

videos.title: Episode 666 - No End In Sight
videos.overview: Gerrard resorts to a variety of tricks to try to persuade Tracy to drop her case against him, and Rod is annoyed to find out about it from a newspaper. More than one member of the Rogers family is convinced that they are going to look foolish.

videos.title: Episode 667 - Ructions
videos.overview: It is Growler's first day back at school, and Chrissy is depressed about her future. Rod and Tommo have conflicting views on the article about Tracy. Sue goes to have an abortion, but changes her mind.

videos.title: Episode 668 - Desperate Measures
videos.overview: Gordon is determined to prove that he is not a loser, and stakes everything on a winner. Cheryl discovers Sue with her head in the oven. Frank tries to reassure Growler that he is still proud of him.

videos.title: Episode 669 - A Propensity To Act
videos.overview: Gordon finds himself the worse for wear, and well out of pocket. Sue tells Terry that she is pregnant, but misses out one small detail. Unexpected revelations have a major effect on the final outcome of Tracy's industrial tribunal.

videos.title: Episode 670 - Possibilities
videos.overview: Sue is not happy about the accuracy of Jonathan's guesswork. Tracy has to decide whether she wants her old job back. Jonathan is advised to move on sooner rather than later.

videos.title: Episode 671 - Tension
videos.overview: Cheryl is finding it difficult knowing Sue's secret. Tracy wonders why Doreen has not been in touch. Jimmy finds Kathy's son Sean loitering near her home, and brings him to the Close.

videos.title: Episode 672 - Talking Of Weddings
videos.overview: Terry has one disappointment after another. The Collins family make preparations for Mona's wedding. Matty is disappointed to find out about Sheila and Billy.

videos.title: Episode 673 - Violence
videos.overview: Sheila confides in Kathy and seeks her advice. Annabelle has to make a tough decision in court.

videos.title: Episode 674 - Fish
