videos.overview: A day off work leads to disaster for Sue.

videos.title: Episode 1002 - Lovely Person
videos.overview: A full police investigation begins into the circumstances of the deaths of Sue and Danny, and the Dixons feel unable to go ahead with their grand opening.

videos.title: Episode 1003 - You Didn't Know?
videos.overview: The Dixons' shop finally opens, while Terry is suspected of being involved in the deaths of Sue and Danny. Max is forced to make a few confessions to Patricia.

videos.title: Episode 1004 - Farnham vs Farnham
videos.overview: Terry fears that he may be responsible for the deaths. Max tries to reason with Patricia, who is still sulking over Susannah.

videos.title: Episode 1005 - You Think I Did It
videos.overview: Fran, Barry and Mick are interviewed as the police investigations continue. Elsewhere, there is a pregnancy, and an engagement.

videos.title: Episode 1006 - Proper Father
videos.overview: DD and Jacqui finally reach a compromise about the trainers. Ron finds out the truth about his father. Terry receives more shattering news.

videos.title: Episode 1007 - Life's Too Short
videos.overview: Graeme turns up at Sue's funeral. Marcia and Sinbad get closer. Sammy and Owen tell Frank of their decision, but how will he react? Cyril tries to apologise to Ron, but will he accept it?

videos.title: Episode 1008 - Think About It
videos.overview: Sammy and Owen make an announcement. Barry tries to prove Terry's innocence.

videos.title: Episode 1009 - Believe Me, Please
videos.overview: Jack Sullivan is questioned by the police, but will his alibi hold up? Mike has to tell a lie to explain the appearance of the keyboard.

videos.title: Episode 1010 - Undermining
videos.overview: Terry decides to take the law into his own hands, but the police are one step ahead. Mike's gig doesn't go according to plan. Chrissy and Frank have something to discuss with Owen's parents.

videos.title: Episode 1011 - The Gritty North
videos.overview: Despite the arrest of Graeme, Terry still blames himself for Sue and Danny's deaths, and his despair turns to violence. Mike has an ultimatum for Tina, and Julia feels like a camel with its head buried in the sand.

videos.title: Episode 1012 - Application
videos.overview: Something is bothering Diana, but can she tell Rod what it is? While Frank is helping Sammy with her plans, Chrissy has been doing some serious thinking.

videos.title: Episode 1013 - Rejection
videos.overview: Terry remains unconsolable, and Diana's secret is out. John and Barbara Harrison decide to make an offer for the bungalow.

videos.title: Episode 1014 - Nobody Needs To Know
videos.overview: Diana tells Nikki she doesn't want Rod to find out her secret, Chrissy asks Katie not to tell Frank what she has accidentally discovered from her teacher, and Barry asks Fran not to tell anyone that he slept with Sue.

videos.title: Episode 1015 - Whatever You Decide
videos.overview: Chrissy and Frank each have some last-minute advice for Owen. Marcia is desperate for Sinbad to stand up to Ellis. Katie tries to find out the difference between a liquidiser and a vibrator.

videos.title: Episode 1016 - New Beginnings
videos.overview: It is the morning of Owen's wedding day, but when his father goes to his room, he is nowhere to be found.

videos.title: Episode 1017 - Nothing To Be Ashamed Of
videos.overview: DD refuses to give up her job, Frank has to explain a few things to Katie, and Jimmy is reunited with someone from his past.

videos.title: Episode 1018 - So Noble
videos.overview: Mike's keyboard secret becomes hot news in the Dixon household. Jimmy feels sorry for himself. The future looks bleak for Terry, despite everyone's attempts to convince him that he didn't murder Sue and Danny.

videos.title: Episode 1019 - Purveyor Of Fine Provisions
videos.overview: Ron confronts Mike, and Terry finds an answer. Jimmy tries to impress his ex-wife with his new job. Rod discovers what Craig is up to, and wishes he hadn't.

videos.title: Episode 1020 - Playing Hard To Get
videos.overview: Derek tries to explain his vow of celibacy to Margaret. Freddie tries to ensure that Rod does not make contact with Diana. Jimmy tries to ensure that there is only one applicant for the job in the shop, but so does Julia.

videos.title: Episode 1021 - Warning
videos.overview: Rod is told to keep away from the arcade. Father Thornton tells Derek that he may have to move to another parish if his relationship with Margaret doesn't end. Jackie and Julia are both interviewed by Ron.

videos.title: Episode 1022 - Forbidden Fruit
videos.overview: Ron is still in a dilemma about whether to give the job to Jackie or to Julia. Rod disobeys orders and returns to the arcade in search of Craig. DD is angry to find out that Derek is going to Gloucester.

videos.title: Episode 1023 - Who Can You Trust?
videos.overview: Margaret's mind is not on her work, which nearly results in a serious accident. Rod tries to convince Diana that he still wants to marry her. Ron finally makes a decision.

videos.title: Episode 1024 - Pursuing The Impossible
videos.overview: Margaret visits Father Thornton to find out why she can't have a relationship with Derek. Diana's father turns up at the Corkhills', determined to cause trouble.

videos.title: Episode 1025 - Safe Hands
videos.overview: On Diana's hen night, the girls become extremely tipsy, and there is an embarrassing moment for the bride-to-be. Susannah has plans for Christmas, and Fran wonders where she stands with Barry.

videos.title: Episode 1026 - More To Offer
videos.overview: Patricia has something on her mind, but it takes a while for the penny to drop with Max. On their 20th wedding anniversary, Jimmy and Jackie have dinner together and receive a wedding invitation.

videos.title: Episode 1027 - Popularity Contest
videos.overview: There is a confrontation between Jimmy and Little Jimmy, who reveals why it is that he hates his father so much. Barry gets a surprise when he meets the new salon manager. Margaret is not impressed to find that Max has invited a young man to have dinner with her.

videos.title: Episode 1028 - A Little Bit Late
videos.overview: Preparations are underway in the Spence household as Diana's wedding day arrives. Rod is determined to be a good samaritan, but will he make it to the church on time?

videos.title: Episode 1029 - Off Day
videos.overview: Mike has a cash-flow problem. Diana and Tommo anxiously await news of Rod. Margaret bumps into Derek.

videos.title: Episode 1030 - Responsibilities
videos.overview: After seeing Derek at the Dixons' shop, Margaret is still confused. Mick and Ellis argue, Ron's takings are down again, and Rod's sergeant visits him on his honeymoon.

videos.title: Episode 1031 - Hard To Stay Away
videos.overview: Margaret realises that the odds are against her when she is competing with God for Derek's love. When Ron mentions that money has been going missing from the till, both Jackie and Julia walk out on him.

videos.title: Episode 1032 - Wrong Reasons
videos.overview: Diana gets the truth out of Rod, but it's not what she wants to hear. Margaret and Mick notice Patricia's anxiety, even if Max doesn't.

videos.title: Episode 1033 - Goodwill
videos.overview: Patricia worries about her presentation, missing the Nativity play, and something else. To his parents' surprise, Mike thinks about selling his car. Rod and Diana go to the annual police Christmas party.

videos.title: Episode 1034 - Over-zealous
videos.overview: Patricia needs support, but when she telephones Max at home, Susannah answers. Angela is grateful for the help Barry has given her, until she realises that the only way to his flat is through her salon.

videos.title: Episode 1035 - Found Out
videos.overview: Patricia picks Max up from his office Christmas party, and he is in no fit state for a conversation. Craig turns up on Rod and Diana's doorstep, and there is only one possible course of action. When Derek comforts Margaret, one thing leads to another.

videos.title: Episode 1036 - Wrong
videos.overview: It is Christmas Day in the Farnham household, as Susannah has a very expensive Christmas present for Max, Patricia confronts him about his involvement with his ex-wife, and Margaret and Derek talk about how they feel.

videos.title: Episode 1037 - Innocent
videos.overview: Margaret and Derek have to face up to reality. Ron discovers Mike's credit card slips. Max tries to resolve things with Patricia, but will she listen?

videos.title: Episode 1038 - Unsaid
videos.overview: On a typically quiet New Year's Eve on the Close, Susannah takes advantage of Max, Ron plans to sell Mike's keyboard, Fran is on the warpath, the Harrisons move in, a thief is caught in the act, and a dead body is discovered.

videos.title: Episode 1039 - Can't Believe
videos.overview: New Year's Day is sad and sombre for the Dixon family. Barry is surprised when he wakes up next to a child. Patricia tells Margaret why she is so scared.

videos.title: Episode 1040 - Everything At Risk
videos.overview: Fran plays her trump card, but how will Barry react? Mick comes home early and finds more babysitters than he expected. Ron is taken for a ride by a man on crutches. Max dashes to the hospital to be with Patricia.

videos.title: Episode 1041 - Waiting To Pounce
videos.overview: Patricia tries to put on a brave face, but can't quite manage it. Barry doesn't want to remain in a weak position for long. Ron refuses to accept responsibility for losing Mike's keyboard. Barbara intends to make her presence felt at the school.

videos.title: Episode 1042 - What To Say
videos.overview: Julia and the Dixons go to Cyril's funeral. Just as Patricia prepares to go into hospital, Susannah arrives to offer her support, but it isn't altogether appreciated.

videos.title: Episode 1043 - Suspicious Minds
videos.overview: DD confides in Ron about what she has discovered, but he is not really interested. When Mike's allegation is confirmed, Julia is sacked. Patricia is to have an operation, but will Max be able to give her the support she needs?

videos.title: Episode 1044 - Birth Certificate
videos.overview: Barry's attraction to Angela grows, as does Terry's hatred of Graeme. Derek has a chat with Father Thornton, but is left none the wiser. Jackie and Julia confront Mike about the stolen money. Sinbad checks his birth certificate for endorsements.

videos.title: Episode 1045 - Nervous
videos.overview: Terry is in court on the first day of Graeme's trial. Barry's hot date has an unexpected outcome. Mike takes a keen interest in medals. Max is annoyed when Susannah introduces herself to the new neighbours.

videos.title: Episode 1046 - Devoted Mother
videos.overview: Terry loses his temper in court. Sinbad wonders to whom his mother could have been devoted. Margaret is surprised to find Susannah helping Max out around the house.

videos.title: Episode 1047 - Keeping Secrets
videos.overview: Terry and Fran are questioned by the defence counsel. Derek has some bad news for Margaret. Patricia comes home.

videos.title: Episode 1048 - It's All Over
videos.overview: Patricia discovers that some things have been moved around in her absence. In a fight between Ron and Mike, John manages to come off worst. The trial nears its conclusion.

videos.title: Episode 1049 - Feelings Of Guilt
videos.overview: John has a few problems at Burns Night down at the Legion, where Julia embarrasses Ron after having too much to drink. Patricia invites Susannah over to thank her for her help and to tell her that they no longer need it.

videos.title: Episode 1050 - Families
videos.overview: Marcia pays another visit to the woman believed to be Sinbad's sister, and this time she has a different story to tell. DD is concerned about Mike, even if Ron isn't. Lindsey has some news for Jimmy and Jackie.

videos.title: Episode 1051 - Reliable Friends
videos.overview: Fran is so annoyed that Barry is going out with Angela that she tells Terry his secret. Patricia decides to make a will, and tries to persuade Max to do the same. Ron apologises to Julia, and Katie has a new friend who may lead her into trouble.

videos.title: Episode 1052 - Positive Action
videos.overview: Patricia is determined to get on with her life without the presence of Susannah, but Max's ex-wife has her own ideas. Terry and Barry have a confrontation over Fran, and the situation turns ugly.

videos.title: Episode 1053 - Damage To Repair
videos.overview: Sinbad is excited about finding his mother. Barry pushes Fran into a corner. Just as Jimmy is about to move back in with Jackie, Little Jimmy turns up with an ultimatum.

videos.title: Episode 1054 - Socks
videos.overview: Fran has only one choice left. Sinbad is hopeful, but may be too optimistic. Jackie thinks Jimmy is trying to back out of moving back in with her.

videos.title: Episode 1055 - Passionately Partisan
videos.overview: Leanne arranges a party at Katie's while Frank is away for the weekend, but Barbara puts a stop to it. Marcia thinks she has been told the truth about Ruth and Sinbad at last. Max and Patricia face an emotional situation together.

videos.title: Episode 1056 - Tidying Up
videos.overview: Katie is worried that Frank will find out what happened while he was away for the weekend. Terry considers opening a pizza parlour, but Jimmy's hopes of getting back with Jackie are fading.

videos.title: Episode 1057 - Rational Explanation
videos.overview: Jackie has had enough, and won't take any more nonsense. Mick resents the Christies' interference. Owen has to do some covering up for Katie and Leanne. The Harrisons are visited by a distraught businessman.

videos.title: Episode 1058 - A Big Moment
videos.overview: Marcia and Sinbad are in for a double shock. Frank is annoyed to find out that Katie, Owen and Katie's deputy headmistress have all lied to him. John discovers too late who he has let into his house, and that living next door to a policeman isn't going to help him with his latest problem.

videos.title: Episode 1059 - Inviting
videos.overview: Sinbad tracks Ruth down at the library where she works, and invites her to his wedding. Although they are able to retrieve their furniture, Barbara is not convinced that the Harrisons' problems are over. Ellis regrets making a snide comment. Katie tells Leanne she is leaving home.

videos.title: Episode 1060 - Overactive Imagination
videos.overview: Terry receives a letter that was written by Graeme before his death. John tries to win a motorbike. Eliis is suspicious of Ben and Rachel.

videos.title: Episode 1061 - Hasta La Vista
videos.overview: John and Barbara are ready to leave for Spain, but there is a last-minute hitch. Owen is made redundant, and has some explaining to do. Mick loses something very important. Men are queueing up to take Jackie Corkhill to the Revival Night.

videos.title: Episode 1062 - Shifts
videos.overview: The Harrisons' two-and-a-half hour holiday causes gossip. Jimmy moves back in with Jackie, and Little Jimmy says he's moving out. Mick goes to Wales in search of his lost property. Owen makes vegetable moussaka for his parents, and asks Frank to lie to them.

videos.title: Episode 1063 - Quality Of Life
videos.overview: Peter Harrison somes home, with loads of money. Jackie thinks Jimmy should use his initiative to earn them some extra money on the side. Frank and Joan disagree about Owen's future plans.

videos.title: Episode 1064 - Marital Arrangements
videos.overview: Mick hopes that everything is now sorted out with Leo and Gemma's grandparents. Jackie can't believe her eyes when Jimmy turns up in a limousine. But which Mr and Mrs Corkhill will end up in the bridal suite?

videos.title: Episode 1065 - You Owe Us
videos.overview: Jimmy and Jackie are intent on getting their revenge on Sinbad. Mick warns Ellis not to use the taxi. Sammy and Owen argue over where they should live and whether he ought to go back to college. Peter wonders if he has been conned, and whether he can help his parents.

videos.title: Episode 1066 - Explanations
videos.overview: Julia discovers Jimmy's scam involving the Moby, and Rod's secret. Sammy turns to her father for some impartial advice. The Harrisons win a competition prize which is no use to them at the moment.

videos.title: Episode 1067 - Call Me Ron
videos.overview: Jimmy and Jackie are pleased with their success on the Moby, but then they have a crash. John's brother turns up, just after Peter and John have withdrawn all his money from his bank account. Katie tries to warn Leanne off Owen.

videos.title: Episode 1068 - Now's Your Chance
videos.overview: Having heard nothing from Derek, Margaret wonders whether he has contacted DD. Jimmy urgently needs Ron's MOT and insurance documents, and his driving licence. Patricia goes back to work, and Frank sits down for a man-to-man chat with Owen.

videos.title: Episode 1069 - I Really Can't Say
videos.overview: Mick has a much better day than John and Hugh. Leanne becomes tearful when Owen tells her to leave. Margaret's mother turns up unexpectedly at the Farnhams', who need to decide whether to tell her what she wants to know.

videos.title: Episode 1070 - Adolescent Girls
videos.overview: Derek returns to the Close. Leanne has some shocking news for everyone. John has to decide whether to turn his brother in.

videos.title: Episode 1071 - Moral Choices
videos.overview: Barbara catches a thief. Rod is apprehensive about his first day back at work. Ron meets Jacqui's boyfriend, and tells her to be home by 9.30. Leanne admits that she has been lying, but Owen walks out on Sammy.

videos.title: Episode 1072 - Unfair To Deceive
videos.overview: Ron is surprised when he bumps into Derek, but less so when he finds out who Derek is visiting. It looks as if Owen has got a job, if he can be found.

videos.title: Episode 1073 - Happiness
videos.overview: Frank cancels his night out, as he has more important things to do at home. Barry has a difficult decision to make about Angela and her daughters. Mrs Clemence returns to confront the Farnhams about Margaret and Derek. John and Rod try to track down the source of the damp.

videos.title: Episode 1074 - Asians
videos.overview: Mrs Clemence joins forces with DD to wreck Margaret's affair with Derek. Barry has reservations about some potential tenants, but changes his mind when he sees the colour of their money.

videos.title: Episode 1075 - Don't Get Involved
videos.overview: Mick and Frank go for a night out at a singles bar. Barry's new tenants make it clear that they want privacy, but his curiosity finally gets the better of him.

videos.title: Episode 1076 - Chiller
videos.overview: John tries to set up a neighbourhood watch scheme, and while everyone is discussing it at a meeting, Rod's car is broken into and Julia is mugged. There is chaos at the pizza parlour as its opening day arrives.

videos.title: Episode 1077 - Plenty Of Feeling
videos.overview: Rod and Diana fear that Julia wants to move into the extension permanently after her mugging. Terry promotes Owen to manager. Max practises his Round Table speech at home, with Patricia and Margaret as his audience.

videos.title: Episode 1078 - Inaugurated
videos.overview: Derek and Margaret make the most of a real chance of some privacy. Jacqui gets permission from DD to go out on Friday night. Julia convinces Tommo to let her move into the extension at number ten.

videos.title: Episode 1079 - Excitement
videos.overview: Romance is in the air for Frank, Barry is on a mission, and the local primary school is burned down, with Jacqui trapped inside.

videos.title: Episode 1080 - Cockroaches
videos.overview: Katie is invited to stay over at a friend's house, which fits in well with Frank's plans. Angela finds out that Colin has remortgaged their home. The Harrisons have a bug problem.

videos.title: Episode 1081 - Gutted
videos.overview: The whole Close try to get to the bottom of the mystery of why the school burned down, and Jacqui certainly isn't saying anything.

videos.title: Episode 1082 - Unwanted Guests
videos.overview: Frank's romantic evening doesn't quite go according to plan. Rod believes that the Harrisons' cockroaches may have their uses. Barry and Sinbad are still wondering what is hidden in the Hamouds' room, and Barry plans to find out.

videos.title: Episode 1083 - Guidance
videos.overview: Derek meets his bishop

videos.title: Episode 1084 - Piece De Resistance
videos.overview: Ron corners Darren, then comes face to face with Darren's father. John tries to revive interest in the neighbourhood watch. Frank is feeling insecure.

videos.title: Episode 1085 - The Sins Of The World
videos.overview: Big trouble lands on Ron's doorstep. John and Barbara argue. Colin plans a surprise for Angela, but is he too late?

videos.title: Episode 1086 - Vigilantes
videos.overview: The joyriders cause expense for Frank. Margaret is worried about her relationship with Derek. Angela resents Barry's interference.

videos.title: Episode 1087 - Dad's Army
videos.overview: There is trouble for Owen and Matty at the pizza parlour. The vigilante group see their first piece of action.

videos.title: Episode 1088 - A Certain Lady
videos.overview: It's Max's turn to be on patrol duty, but he has a function to attend and leaves the Close unguarded. A mystery woman calls at the Corkhills', and Barry is pleased to see her. Frank and Denise share an intimate moment at last.

videos.title: Episode 1089 - No Confidence
videos.overview: Ron is furious that his shop window has been smashed, and promptly fires Max, who is secretly relieved. Barry's name is mud again.

videos.title: Episode 1090 - Awkward Questions
videos.overview: Tony is Darren's next victim, and when Jacqui finds out, it puts her in an even more difficult position. Derek visits Margaret, but things go wrong. Katie has an ultimatum for Frank.

videos.title: Episode 1091 - Something Important
videos.overview: Fran is back, with some unexpected news for Barry. Jacqui finally decides to tell the truth.

videos.title: Episode 1092 - Sausages
videos.overview: Margaret fears that she has frightened Derek away. Max only wants to buy sausages, but ends up being barred from the Trading Post. Mick seeks opinions on the school closure, but will anyone be interested?

videos.title: Episode 1093 - Rushed To Hospital
videos.overview: Frank and Denise get passionate in Frank's cab. When Fran sticks the knife in, Angela dumps Barry. Diana regrets offering to do Margaret a favour.

videos.title: Episode 1094 - Cracking Up
videos.overview: Mike finds Derek and tries to take him home. Patricia attends her last chemotherapy session.

videos.title: Episode 1095 - Practicalities
videos.overview: Terry closes the pizza parlour until further notice. Sinbad gets stitched up with a forged &pound

videos.title: Episode 1096 - Straightforward Answers
videos.overview: Mike begins to worry that Derek may do something drastic, and rushes to his parents for help.

videos.title: Episode 1097 - Better Hotels
videos.overview: Sinbad receives another counterfeit &pound

videos.title: Episode 1098 - Turmoil
videos.overview: Barry is reeling from the news about his father. Derek makes an appointment to see the bishop again, but Margaret is concerned that he will change his mind.

videos.title: Episode 1099 - Analyzing
videos.overview: Nawaz knows about Barry's scam, and decides that if he can't punish Barry himself, a friend will do. Patricia wants some straight answers from Max. Derek makes a decision.

videos.title: Episode 1100 - Choosing
videos.overview: Barry goes on the run, taking Fran with him. Sammy goes on a spending spree, Patricia tries to help Diana, and Max finds a bishop in his front room.

videos.title: Episode 1101 - Something I Need
videos.overview: Matty is Barry's last hope, while Mick is canvassing for the primary school.

videos.title: Episode 1102 - Something So Terrible
videos.overview: Rod has a lovely birthday. Matty encourages Barry to tell the truth.

videos.title: Episode 1103 - For Old Times' Sake
videos.overview: In a special episode set on a deserted beach, Barry and Terry reflect on ten years of life on the Close. When they reach the sombre events of recent months, one of them decides to pull the trigger of a gun.

videos.title: Episode 1104 - Angry Enough To Kill
videos.overview: When the Harrisons awaken to find a haggard-looking Terry in their back garden, holding a shotgun and wearing a blood-stained shirt, they quickly realise that he is not delivering a pizza.

videos.title: Episode 1105 - Delusions
videos.overview: Jimmy overhears Sinbad's thoughts on what has happened to Barry, and aims to turn events to his own advantage.

videos.title: Episode 1106 - Deep Breaths
videos.overview: The police continue taking statements, but Terry's silence could lead to him ending up behind bars. Despite all efforts, Owen can't be found, and Sammy has to give birth without him.

videos.title: Episode 1107 - Not Improving
videos.overview: Fran decides that she needs to confide in Matty. At the meeting to discuss the future of the school, Mick is in for a big shock.

videos.title: Episode 1108 - Half The Excitement
videos.overview: There are red faces all around when Max interrupts a moment of passion between Margaret and Derek. Fran intervenes in plans to present new evidence to the police.

videos.title: Episode 1109 - Ventures
videos.overview: Frank keeps a lonely vigil at his granddaughter's side. Ellis urges Marcia to tell Sinbad the truth.

videos.title: Episode 1110 - Where The Body Is
videos.overview: As things are looking grim for Terry, there is the unexpected arrival at the police station of someone who was on the beach at the time of the shooting incident.

videos.title: Episode 1111 - Squirming With Guilt
videos.overview: Fran and Matty want an explanation. Margaret upsets DD by going to church.

videos.title: Episode 1112 - Stony Ground
videos.overview: Marcia tells Sinbad her secret, and Ellis has disappointing news for Mick. Sammy comes home without her baby, and Mike receives an ultimatum from Ron.

videos.title: Episode 1113 - Ex-Brother
videos.overview: Mick tries to win his boss around, but he demands the return of the keys. Sinbad and Marcia wonder if they still have a future.

videos.title: Episode 1114 - Dusky Beauty
videos.overview: Mick's name appears in the press linked with a dusky beauty, then the dusky beauty pays him a visit. Ellis can't believe that his brother wants nothing more to do with him, and comes up with a scheme to change Mick's mind.

videos.title: Episode 1115 - Act Of God
videos.overview: Ellis tries to interest Mick in a business opportunity. DD grudgingly wishes Derek and Margaret a good time, but their happiness is short-lived.

videos.title: Episode 1116 - Time To Adjust
videos.overview: Margaret wants Derek to prove to her that he is able to live a new life. A visit from the educational welfare officer affects Mick's plans for Leo and Gemma's schooling.

videos.title: Episode 1117 - Reasons
videos.overview: Patricia's evening doesn't go as planned. Marianne offers to do something else for Mick. At the chapel of rest, Frank meets a relative of Nick.

videos.title: Episode 1118 - A Fistful Of Dollars
videos.overview: Things are not looking good for Marcia and Sinbad, or for Margaret and Derek. Sammy is finding it difficult to cope with Louise. Ron discovers a horse eating his flowers.

videos.title: Episode 1119 - Midnight Ramblers
videos.overview: Ron is struggling after DD's departure, while Margaret's disappearance with Derek leaves the Farnhams in the lurch. Rod tells Julia a secret, but will she be able to keep it?

videos.title: Episode 1120 - Second Priority
videos.overview: Mick plans Gemma's birthday party, and Ellis tries to use this to mend some bridges. Sammy takes advantage of Julia's adoration of her baby. Jimmy offers to help John find a sexy nightie for Barbara, but he may not need it.......

videos.title: Episode 1121 - New Nanny
videos.overview: Gemma's party goes well until Marianne turns up. Sammy begins to become frightened of what she might do to her baby.

videos.title: Episode 1122 - We Need You
videos.overview: Advertising a delivery service doesn't seem to have helped to improve business at the pizza parlour. Rod and Diana have big plans. The Farnhams have trouble with their new nanny.

videos.title: Episode 1123 - Incapable
videos.overview: Frank and Owen are out for the night, leaving Sammy alone with the baby, and things become too much for her. DD returns, but Anna gives her further cause for concern about Derek and Margaret.

videos.title: Episode 1124 - Minor Hiccup
videos.overview: Sammy has done a terrible thing, but will she regret it? It's Rod and Diana's wedding day, but how long will it remain a secret?

videos.title: Episode 1125 - Bruises
videos.overview: Mick is surprised when Marianne turns up at the pizza parlour, and even more surprised to discover why. Anna forces Max's hand.

videos.title: Episode 1126 - One Fowl Swipe
videos.overview: Louise comes home, but Sammy is still troubled. Mick does the books to see how the first month of trading has gone at the pizza parlour. John goes with Ron in search of falafel, but what will he come home with this time?

videos.title: Episode 1127 - Light Bulbs
videos.overview: A social worker visits the Rogers family, and wants to speak to Sammy on her own. Julia invites Tracy to come and stay with her. Peter finds out how many thieves it takes to steal a light bulb.

videos.title: Episode 1128 - Welsh Dresser
videos.overview: Patricia receives a generous gift from her parents, but is beginning to worry that Margaret's continued absence will make it easy for Anna to become established in her place. Mick and Ellis get some bad news from Terry.

videos.title: Episode 1129 - Cheek
videos.overview: Ron doesn't want to take Max's advice, but when he discovers Jimmy checking his prices, he sets off for the estate agent. Margaret and Derek return, and Mick and Ellis need to find &pound

videos.title: Episode 1130 - Parental Protection
videos.overview: Owen is determined to protect Louise from Sammy, even if it means divorcing her. Terry wants his keys back. Ron, furious that Max's firm are his landlords, insists that Max confronts Jimmy.

videos.title: Episode 1131 - Survival
videos.overview: An unexpected guest makes life difficult for Sinbad. Ron is trying to sell tickets. Margaret fears that Anna will be kept on as the Farnhams' nanny. Ellis asks for two more hours, but can he achieve anything in them?

videos.title: Episode 1132 - Spending
videos.overview: Sinbad realises that there is no point in trying again with Marcia. Frank fails to convince his boss to compensate Nick's family for his death. Mick is not impressed when Terry decides to go on a spending spree.

videos.title: Episode 1133 - Taken
videos.overview: John is seen thieving from Ron's shop. Rod and Diana don't like what they find when they return from their honeymoon.

videos.title: Episode 1134 - No Power
videos.overview: Jimmy discovers that his electricity and water have been cut off, while most of the residents are preparing for their day trip to Alton Towers.

videos.title: Episode 1135 - Mistake
videos.overview: Thomas is lost and found, Sinbad is reunited with Marcia, and Frank has to convince Sammy not to commit suicide, in a special episode at Alton Towers.

videos.title: Episode 1136 - Nicked
videos.overview: Margaret tells Patricia she has found another job and is leaving. Ron tells Peter of his suspicions about John, but he may have left it too late.

videos.title: Episode 1137 - Devious Logic
videos.overview: Ron decides to become a squatter. Frank tries to persuade Owen not to divorce Sammy.

videos.title: Episode 1138 - Dim The Lights
videos.overview: Ron discovers that being a squatter might create more problems than it resolves. Rod and Diana go to Peter's to watch a film, and when Rod falls asleep Diana betrays a confidence.

videos.title: Episode 1139 - Up Yours
videos.overview: Peter advises John to tell Barbara about his arrest. Patricia makes a decision. At the end of the day, when the shops are all cashing up, a gang of men who have been lying in wait make their move.

videos.title: Episode 1140 - Scarred
videos.overview: Terry feels guilty for being drunk while the shops were raided. Jackie wants Ron to install a panic button, but he explains that this would cost money.

videos.title: Episode 1141 - Charges
videos.overview: Mike and Keith set off for Edinburgh, unaware that Ron plans to follow them. Lyn makes Frank suffer before she agrees to go camping. Angela reopens the salon, but is far from happy. John learns whether he will be charged with shoplifting.

videos.title: Episode 1142 - Made Up
videos.overview: Diana is offered a job on the make-up counter, but it may mean moving to Manchester. Jacqui gets into some trouble in Scotland. John blows his top at Sinbad.

videos.title: Episode 1143 - Interruptions
videos.overview: The campers return home, and Rod's career hangs in the balance. Tracy and Peter have a date, and end up in the spotlight. Julia interprets Jackie's instructions slightly differently than expected.

videos.title: Episode 1144 - Defrosted
videos.overview: Jacqui tells Ron and DD that she is not going back to school, and already has a job lined up. Ron discovers that his shop is flooded. Patricia has a secret.

videos.title: Episode 1145 - Sure
videos.overview: Ron discovers the source of the flood. Margaret and Derek plan their engagement. Ron resigns from the police force. After seeing her doctor, Patricia reveals to Max that she is pregnant.

videos.title: Episode 1146 - Bargain
videos.overview: Frank confronts Barbara about Katie's stolen coat. Rod studies his bad eye, and becomes distressed. Mick discovers that Ellis has misled him about the loan.

videos.title: Episode 1147 - Repelling
videos.overview: Margaret's mother says she won't come to the engagement party because she thinks Margaret is too young to get married. Tracy gets an offer she can't refuse. Ellis plans a date with Marianne, but has to deliver pizzas instead.

videos.title: Episode 1148 - They Know
videos.overview: Everything comes to a head for a distraught John. Marianne has a date, but is it with the right brother? Patricia's parents are coming to visit, and she has sold their Welsh dresser.......

videos.title: Episode 1149 - Taking Root
videos.overview: Julia is shocked to see a "For Sale" sign outside the Corkhills', and Rod has some explaining to do. Barbara is getting worried about John's disappearance. Max and Patricia try to convince Patricia's parents that they like the Welsh dresser.

videos.title: Episode 1150 - Stained
videos.overview: Strange stickers reading "Strength Through Purity" appear on the window of the pizza parlour. Rod and Terry are rivals for a job. Max entrusts the repair of the dresser to David, who dyes it dark green.

videos.title: Episode 1151 - Words
videos.overview: Margaret isn't in the mood for her engagement party, but her mother convinces DD to come along and give Derek her blessing. Mike and Matty receive a sinister threat.

videos.title: Episode 1152 - Nightclub
videos.overview: George Webb's unpleasantness means more headaches for Mick. Ron opposes the new nightclub development.

videos.title: Episode 1153 - Spanners
videos.overview: Patricia agrees to be a speaker at Max's Round Table meeting, and makes sure that Ron comes up with a cunning plan. Barbara suggests that Peter gives Diana a lift to work, and Diana discovers that Rod turned down a desk job in the police.

videos.title: Episode 1154 - Bleeding
videos.overview: Rod returns to try to make things up with Diana, but it doesn't go well. Max serves Terry with a notice to quit. Patricia is determined not to lose the baby.

videos.title: Episode 1155 - Coping
videos.overview: The pizza parlour is under threat, while Terry has no intentions of moving out of his flat. Barbara confesses to Peter that she fears she has lost John forever. Marianne takes Ellis and Mick van-hunting.

videos.title: Episode 1156 - Wheels
videos.overview: Max is surprised when he meets the new nightclub owner, Joe Halsall. Diana confesses a lie to Peter. Derek needs to find somewhere to live.

videos.title: Episode 1157 - Going, Going.......
videos.overview: In the middle of making a speech to Max's Round Table, Patricia collapses in agony. Terry discovers he is going on a journey, but with whom?

videos.title: Episode 1158 - Nothing There
videos.overview: Mick has an interview at the building society regarding his failure to pay the mortgage. Ellis finds something unpleasant in a milk bottle. Terry and Sinbad begin their holiday in Spain, but there may be a surprise in store for them.

videos.title: Episode 1159 - Cuisine
videos.overview: Brian and Tracy have a romantic evening with a twist. Max plans to take Patricia on a holiday to Spain. Anna is asking questions about Peter.

videos.title: Episode 1160 - Time To Go
videos.overview: Julia wonders why Tracy's bed hasn't been slept in. Patricia asks about the missing teddy, Frank meets Lyn's children, and another member of her family.......

videos.title: Episode 1161 - Nothing To Discuss
videos.overview: Terry returns home and tells Derek he can stay on in the flat. Tommo reappears, with a message for Diana from Rod. Mick is concerned about his children, and needs to decide whether to report the attempted arson attack to the police.

videos.title: Episode 1162 - Fall-out
videos.overview: Mike makes a film in which everyone is taking part. Peter gives Anna a lift to Manchester. Ellis and Marianne have some news for Mick. Sammy tries to convince Katie to have tea with Lyn's children.

videos.title: Episode 1163 - Fatal Mistake
videos.overview: Mrs Shackleton returns to discuss a few things with Diana. Tracy makes Julia tell Brian what she has been saying about him. Barry takes steps to wreck Jimmy's business.

videos.title: Episode 1164 - I Said No
videos.overview: Marianne takes Ellis shopping. Jimmy confronts George. Max returns early from his holiday and allows Anna's party to go ahead, with potentially far-reaching consequences.

videos.title: Episode 1165 - Wiped Out
videos.overview: Anna has some big plans, but Jimmy can only survey the wreckage of his shop. Barbara has a surprise visitor.

videos.title: Episode 1166 - You Said No?
videos.overview: It is the last day of Peter's course, but he has other things on his mind. Jacqui gets a job at the petrol station. Diana confides in Julia.

videos.title: Episode 1167 - No Means No
videos.overview: Tracy calls Rod, but he won't come home. Jimmy is at a loose end, and Jackie considers buying Ron's Moby for him. Jacqui receives a letter from Paul.

videos.title: Episode 1168 - I Meant No
videos.overview: Diana is examined by a police doctor. Ron tries to drum up support for an objection to the liquor licence, and to tell a joke about a fish, but doesn't have much success with either endeavour.

videos.title: Episode 1169 - No I Didn't
videos.overview: George follows Mick home to find out where he lives. Ron finishes off his joke, but no-one finds it amusing. Terry insists that Barry gives Derek rent-free use of the vacant shop until Christmas. Peter is interviewed by the police.

videos.title: Episode 1170 - No Should Mean No
videos.overview: The rape investigation continues, and Patricia becomes involved. Paul comes to see Jacqui, but she wonders what she ever saw in him.

videos.title: Episode 1171 - Audition
videos.overview: Ron becomes the new compere at the Legion. Peter worries about what Max will tell the police. Mick is visited by officials from the immigration department.

videos.title: Episode 1172 - A Bit Dodgy
videos.overview: Mick comes home after being interrogated, and wonder who was responsible. George takes Ron to his local and introduces him to his "mates".

videos.title: Episode 1173 - Really Dodgy
videos.overview: Ellis finds out what happened to Mick, and tries to teach George a lesson. Patricia tries to reassure Diana. Derek opens a charity shop, but Ron brings him some bad news.

videos.title: Episode 1174 - Passion Wagon
videos.overview: DD interrupts Leanne and Paul at an extremely awkward moment. Diana considers whether she could go to court. Marianne is not sure that she can put up with Ellis's violence.

videos.title: Episode 1175 - Bleach On Germs
videos.overview: Jacqui thinks about changing her name again, while Katie has to do some quick clothes-changing. On his way home after his big night, Ron discovers George attempting to burn down Mick's bungalow.

videos.title: Episode 1176 - Defence Witness
videos.overview: Peter discovers that he has an ally against Diana. Barry has an ulterior motive in offering to help Karyn with her charity work, and Max unwittingly helps him.

videos.title: Episode 1177 - Subdued
videos.overview: Ron visits Jackie late at night, Barbara is worried that Peter will run away from his troubled, and Barry is being enigmatic.

videos.title: Episode 1178 - Winning Side
videos.overview: Patricia encourages Diana to go to counselling, and press ahead with the rape allegation. Ron joins Mick and Ellis in an attempt to force George to see the error of his ways.

videos.title: Episode 1179 - Paint Job
videos.overview: Julia starts to clear the Corkhills' house, and enlists Max's help. George discovers that Ellis has redecorated his windows.

videos.title: Episode 1180 - Half Of Everything
videos.overview: Mick and Ellis need to talk to the police, but want to convince Ron to go with them. Tommo comes round to Diana's to collect some of Rod's belongings. George is forced to leave the garage, but not without making a final threat.

videos.title: Episode 1181 - Let Me Help
videos.overview: Tommo helps Diana move out of number ten. Terry asks Barry for money, but won't reveal why he needs it.

videos.title: Episode 1182 - That Way Declined
videos.overview: Diana is shocked to discover that someone has returned to number ten, then has an argument with Tracy and decides not to move in with Julia after all.

videos.title: Episode 1183 - Space Invaded
videos.overview: Barry assigns Jimmy the task of trailing Terry to find out what he is up to. Patricia finds herself invaded by the Corkhills. Ellis and Marianne seek Mick's blessing for a Valentine's Day wedding.

videos.title: Episode 1184 - Not Now, Eh?
videos.overview: Jackie and Ron take their relationship one stage further. Peter appears in court. Barry wrecks Jimmy's plans. Katie and Leanne try to discover whether Christmas is becoming more commercialised, but Leanne has something more pressing on her mind.

videos.title: Episode 1185 - Unlucky For Some
videos.overview: Ellis lines up a special night for Mick. Diana visits her barrister to prepare for her court case. Ron's efforts to get closer to Jackie are frustrated.

videos.title: Episode 1186 - Guest Of Honour
videos.overview: Mick's night out goes painfully wrong. Patricia discovers that all her guests have apparently had a sex change. Leanne takes a pregnancy test. Ron invites Jackie for a weekend away.

videos.title: Episode 1187 - Laying It On Thick
videos.overview: The rape trial begins. Barry warns Terry that he can't keep his secret for long. It is the day of Patricia's fashion show.

videos.title: Episode 1188 - Trying To Woo
videos.overview: As the trial continues, Max gives his evidence. Ron asks Jimmy to encourage Jackie to come back to work for him. Leanne takes more and more pregnancy tests in the hope of getting the result she wants, and DD finds them under Jacqui's bed.

videos.title: Episode 1189 - Pulling The Strings
videos.overview: DD confronts Jacqui about pregnancy tests. Max suggests that Diana should go home to her father's. After Anna gives her evidence in court, Patricia gives her an ultimatum.

videos.title: Episode 1190 - Looking Good
videos.overview: Terry convinces Fran to join him for Christmas dinner. DD is in a dilemma about what to do when Jacqui misleads her about Katie. Joe gives Barry a stern talking-to. Peter gives his evidence.

videos.title: Episode 1191 - Parental Advice
videos.overview: John has some advice for Peter, but he might not want to take it. Diana needs to find somewhere else to stay, and Max gives a helping hand. DD confides in Lyn about her suspicions regarding Katie.

videos.title: Episode 1192 - A Day For Surprises
videos.overview: Christmas Eve brings an unexpected visitor for the Farnhams. Margaret has an unusual present for Derek, and Frank discovers that all the wheels of his car have disappeared.

videos.title: Episode 1193 - Opening Up
videos.overview: On Christmas Day, Frank gets his wheels back, Max has an extravagant present for Patricia, Peter tries to convince Diana to change her mind, and Jimmy has to decide who should be allowed into the nightclub, and who shouldn't, on its opening night.

videos.title: Episode 1194 - Threatening Behaviour
videos.overview: Barry gives Fran and Terry something to worry about. Peter receives an unexpected Christmas card. Ron tries to persuade people to come to the Legion on New Year's Eve.

videos.title: Episode 1195 - Sneaking Away
videos.overview: On New Year's Eve, Patricia is furious with Anna, Terry prevents Barry from talking to Fran, Joe gets a free hairdo, Leanne tries to lose her baby by drinking a full bottle of gin, and Peter refuses to leave the Close with John and Barbara.

videos.title: Episode 1196 - Lessons
videos.overview: On New Year's Day, Tracy is suspicious of Brian and Joe, Marcia tells Sinbad what she has seen, and Patricia sacks Anna.

videos.title: Episode 1197 - Emotional Scars
videos.overview: Peter can't cope with Anna's romantic advances. Fran refuses to allow Barry to see his son. DD tries to make Leanne consider the options she faces.

videos.title: Episode 1198 - Pre-Occupied
videos.overview: A big event is arranged for the residents of the Close. John is not impressed when he returns and finds that Anna has moved in with Peter. Ron is not the only one who wants the vacant shop.

videos.title: Episode 1199 - Summation
videos.overview: It is the final day of the trial. Marianne has some news for Ellis about their wedding plans.

videos.title: Episode 1200 - In The Clear
videos.overview: The verdict is reached, and Jimmy is out for revenge. Ron discovers that DD is opening a florists' next door to the Trading Post. Sinbad has to choose a best man. Max brings Jean back from Spain, but David is determined to be somewhere else.

videos.title: Episode 1201 - Best Off Forgetting
videos.overview: Barry tries to ensure that Jimmy doesn't do anything stupid. Sinbad seems to have lost his mother again. Patricia tries to resolve the conflict betwwen David and Jean, and Derek runs out of toilet paper.

videos.title: Episode 1202 - Adultery
videos.overview: There is a shock from the past for Patricia, while DD reveals the truth about Derek's Romanian job to Margaret. Diana steals some scissors from Tracy's salon, but it's not her hair that she plans to cut.

videos.title: Episode 1203 - Safer Hands
videos.overview: Peter is upset about Diana's attempt to commit suicide in his bathroom. Sinbad has too many best men. Patricia is reluctant to let David teach Margaret to drive.

videos.title: Episode 1204 - Will It Hurt?
videos.overview: Leanne has an abortion. Peter talks to Tracy about Diana. Terry asks Fran to move in with him. Margaret has her first driving lesson in Max's car, and crashes it.

videos.title: Episode 1205 - A Different Light
videos.overview: Leanne's parents find out about her abortion, and are not pleased. Sinbad's surplus of best men shows no sign of abating. Max may have found a buyer for David and Jean's Spanish apartment, but Patricia is not pleased at the price.

videos.title: Episode 1206 - Still Your Wife
videos.overview: DD tries to explain and justify her actions to Mrs Powell. Patricia talks to David about his affair. Several people consider offering Margaret the money she needs to go to Romania, and the best men find out about each other.

videos.title: Episode 1207 - Seals
videos.overview: Tracy convinces Diana that she needs help, and takes her to see a psychiatrist. DD does not intend to apologise to anyone for her involvement in Leanne's abortion. Derek disturbs Patricia while she is meeting a potential client.

videos.title: Episode 1208 - Dad's Privilege
videos.overview: Barry snatches his child, and Margaret puts on a brave face about Romania. Ron drops Lyn in it with Frank by revealing that she was involved with Leanne's abortion.

videos.title: Episode 1209 - Neutral Territory
videos.overview: Peter feels more guilty, and Fran gets Steven back. Max and Ron both plan leaving parties for Margaret and Derek, and neither of them want to give way to the other.

videos.title: Episode 1210 - Come One, Come All
videos.overview: Margaret and Derek have their farewell party. Terry realises how he can help Fran. Marianne is annoyed when Ellis makes some decisions without consulting her.

videos.title: Episode 1211 - Off You Go
videos.overview: Terry takes drastic action to prevent Barry from gaining access to Steven. Everyone waves farewell to Margaret and Derek, but it is not too late for a last-minute change of plan.

videos.title: Episode 1212 - Who Wants Another?
videos.overview: It is an emotionally charged night for the stags and hens. Frank suggests that Lyn moves in with him.

videos.title: Episode 1213 - Arrangements
videos.overview: Margaret reappears, but doesn't want to talk to DD. The Crosbies may have found somewhere to settle.

videos.title: Episode 1214 - Pre-Wedding Nerves
videos.overview: Sinbad goes against Marcia's wishes by telling Marianne what Mick has said about her. There are mysterious new occupants at number 10. Margaret receives a message from Derek.

videos.title: Episode 1215 - Re-think
videos.overview: Sinbad makes a big decision, and Mick seizes his last chance.

videos.title: Episode 1216 - A Big Step
videos.overview: When the bride is late for the wedding, Ellis is concerned, but Mick is hopeful. Lyn decides to apply for a new job.

videos.title: Episode 1217 - Too Much Pain
videos.overview: Josie and Marcia are forced to leave for good. Sinbad gets most of the blame for the wedding fiasco, but not from Marianne. Patricia offers Margaret a way out of her misery.

videos.title: Episode 1218 - Too Close To Home
videos.overview: Mandy has an accident, which arouses suspicion. Marianne plucks up the courage to go and see Mick. David and Jean have some news which infuriates Max.

videos.title: Episode 1219 - I Want To, But....
videos.overview: Mick gets advice from his solicitor, but his situation is not looking good. Frank's plans may be spoiled by the unexpected arrival of Lyn's younger sister, Bev.

videos.title: Episode 1220 - Something Odd
videos.overview: There is bad news for Mandy and Beth. Ellis sees something he wasn't meant to. Lyn and her children move in with Frank and Katie.

videos.title: Episode 1221 - A Bit Lost
videos.overview: Alison doesn't feel at home. Beth worries that her father will track down the Jordaches' new home. Ron and DD go to Blackpool, while Mick and Marianne talk about their future.

videos.title: Episode 1222 - Telly
videos.overview: Mick tries to sort out his problems, and a familiar face returns to the Close, which gives Mike a convenient excuse to have a party.

videos.title: Episode 1223 - Family Loyalty
videos.overview: Jimmy interviews for bar staff. DD and Ron return home unexpectedly, and quickly discover what has been going on in their absence.

videos.title: Episode 1224 - Porkies
videos.overview: A charming stranger arrives on the Close in search of some of its residents. Luckily, those he speaks to don't give anything away. Bev is having trouble with her love life, and turns to Frank.

videos.title: Episode 1225 - Catching Up
videos.overview: Mandy's worst fears are realised, thanks to David. Jimmy thinks he has the answer to Mick's money worries. Ellis returns from his solo honeymoon. Diana's first shift behind the bar doesn't go well.

videos.title: Episode 1226 - Leaving Present
videos.overview: Jean and Patricia are horrified to hear that David may have jeopardised the safety of the Jordaches, and try to check on Mandy. Ron realises that it is time to do some serious thinking about the state of his marriage.

videos.title: Episode 1227 - The Beast Has Risen
videos.overview: If he can't get to see Mandy, Trevor is determined to make contact with Beth. Mick is worried about his relationship with Marianne. There is friction between Peter and Anna.

videos.title: Episode 1228 - When You Gotta Go
videos.overview: Jimmy tries to get some help with his latest dodgy scheme. Anna loses another job, while Mike fancies Beth.

videos.title: Episode 1229 - Now You Know
videos.overview: DD is worried about the state of her marriage. Ron gets a new assistant at the Trading Post. Rachel asks for a pair of football boots.

videos.title: Episode 1230 - Weakening
videos.overview: Beth confides in Mike. Margaret realises that it is all over for her and Derek. There are arguments about rent and sleeping arrangements.

videos.title: Episode 1231 - Sickness
videos.overview: Ron is flirting at work again, Sinbad is tempted to help Jimmy out, and Mandy goes to visit Trevor.

videos.title: Episode 1232 - Inhibitions
videos.overview: Ron takes Bev to the cash and carry, and on the way back their relationship takes a new turn. Sinbad discovers that he has volunteered to carry out a robbery.

videos.title: Episode 1233 - Instinctive
videos.overview: On Rachel's 14th birthday, Trevor calls at number 10 again, and Mandy tells him she is filing for a divorce. The bungling burglars prepare to empty Mick's bungalow.

videos.title: Episode 1234 - Break-In
videos.overview: Ron decides to take things a stage further with Bev. Karyn and Patricia discuss business and Barry. Trevor comes to see Rachel while Mandy is out.

videos.title: Episode 1235 - Awkward Atmosphere
videos.overview: Mandy can't ignore a distress call from Trevor, which improves his chances of getting back into the house. Ron is worried, which is exactly what Bev was hoping for.

videos.title: Episode 1236 - You Are Joking?
videos.overview: Mandy tells Beth and Rachel that Trevor is coming to stay for a couple of nights. Anna asks Peter to marry her. Mick arrives home early, and no-one has time to tell him what to expect.

videos.title: Episode 1237 - Repossession
videos.overview: Jimmy and Sinbad try to turn back time. Susannah needs a favour from Max. Beth confronts Trevor.

videos.title: Episode 1238 - Backstage
videos.overview: Mick moves upstairs, Trevor looks for digs, Mike takes the plunge, and Ron and Bev have a secret.

videos.title: Episode 1239 - Two Of A Kind
videos.overview: After their kiss, Ron starts telling everyone that he and Bev are together. Beth insists that Trevor cannot stay at number 10.

videos.title: Episode 1240 - Another Chance
videos.overview: Ron plans a romantic night at a hotel with Bev. Max is shocked that Susannah plans to go to the United States with her boyfriend Andrew.

videos.title: Episode 1241 - Opportunity
videos.overview: David discovers that the bungalow is up for sale, and thinks it would be ideal for him and Jean. Marianne and Mick have a quiet night in, but the kids are there too. Ron takes Bev to Southport, and Trevor joins Mandy in her bed.

videos.title: Episode 1242 - Insecure
videos.overview: Frank knows Ron was not where he claimed to be on Friday night, and warns him to be careful. Trevor is back in control at number 10, and things go from bad to worse for Mandy and Beth.

videos.title: Episode 1243 - Guests
videos.overview: When nobody turns up to their anniversary drinks party except the Crosbies, Trevor blames Mandy. Caught out in one lie, Ron tells DD another one. Max is not able to persuade Susannah to change her mind.

videos.title: Episode 1244 - Always The Same
videos.overview: Beth notices Mandy's bruises. Anna is shocked to find out what her new job involves. Sinbad discovers that Trevor has been in prison.

videos.title: Episode 1245 - Snitching
videos.overview: Max is determined to stand in the way of Susannah's plans. Mick wants to marry Marianne. Ron insists that DD sees a doctor.

videos.title: Episode 1246 - Bevvies
videos.overview: Sinbad tells Terry and Jimmy that he is worried about Mandy. Mick may be rushing into things.

videos.title: Episode 1247 - Circumstances
videos.overview: Sinbad is horrified when he witnesses Trevor beating Mandy up, but Beth is even more horrified when she finds him with Rachel in her bed.

videos.title: Episode 1248 - I'm Sorry
videos.overview: Beth confronts Rachel, who breaks down. Mandy promises that Trevor will not touch her again. Max goes behind Patricia's back to see Susannah, while Ron risks being caught out by DD.

videos.title: Episode 1249 - Agony
videos.overview: Patricia's fears are confirmed, Ron is worried, and in desperation Beth and Mandy carry out their plan to poison Trevor.

videos.title: Episode 1250 - No Turning Back
videos.overview: Ron helps to move Bev into her new flat, then Lyn sees him kissing her. DD feels that she needs to talk to someone neutral. Mandy and Beth's plan does not go entirely as they hoped.

videos.title: Episode 1251 - Self Defence
videos.overview: Mandy and Beth are exhausted, but they need to act quickly before Rachel comes home and notices that they have killed her father.

videos.title: Episode 1252 - Something And Nothing
videos.overview: Ron is relieved that Lyn has not said anything to DD about his affair with Bev. More and more cracks seem to be appearing in Barry and Joe's business partnership, and the Jordaches are visited by a policeman.

videos.title: Episode 1253 - Digging
videos.overview: Beth is determined to bury Trevor's body, but it may not may that simple. Keith suggests a job at his college for which Anna might be ideal. Sinbad discovers something nasty in Mandy's bin-bag.

videos.title: Episode 1254 - Nervous Wreck
videos.overview: Mandy and Beth dispose of Trevor's body. DD's behaviour becomes very strange. Anna has to decide whether to go ahead with her nude modelling job.

videos.title: Episode 1255 - Better Away
videos.overview: Patricia is not convinced that Max is doing the right thing. Sinbad discovers that Beth's hole in the garden has disappeared, and discourages Rachel from trying to find her father. Father Monroe advises Ron that DD needs to enter a convent.

videos.title: Episode 1256 - So Easy
videos.overview: Mandy is close to a breakdown, and Ron is feeling guilty. Barry organises another rave night, and Joe has a proposition for Anna.

videos.title: Episode 1257 - No Future
videos.overview: Joe wants Barry out of the club, or else. Ron breaks up with Bev. There are more visitors for Mandy.

videos.title: Episode 1258 - Will You Miss Me?
videos.overview: Barry's rave is a success, until the police show up. About to enter the convent, DD reveals to Ron that she knew about his affair with Bev. David and Jean throw a house-warming party, and Sinbad has a few questions for Mandy.

videos.title: Episode 1259 - Follow-Through
videos.overview: The Jordaches are asked to move out, causing Mandy to panic. Max is missing his children, and Susannah.......

videos.title: Episode 1260 - Trying To Prevent
videos.overview: Ron wants to know why Bev is going out with Mike. Mandy confides more in Sinbad. Anna finds herself in a compromising situation with a client.

videos.title: Episode 1261 - What Have You Done?
videos.overview: Anna comes home in the morning and begins to think about what she has done. Jean and David discover that Max has snatched Matthew and Emily from Susannah and brought them home.

videos.title: Episode 1262 - Best Side
videos.overview: Patricia returns from London, and quickly notices that there are more of Max's children playing in the garden than there should be. After talking to Rachel, Mrs Shackleton realises Mandy has been lying. Ron and Bev photograph themselves with Mike's camera.

videos.title: Episode 1263 - Realising
videos.overview: Ron wants Bev to dump Mike, but she won't. Mandy tries to explain her actions so that she and the girls can stay on at number 10. Peter tells Anna he has found someone who is willing to marry her.

videos.title: Episode 1264 - Increased Rent
videos.overview: Max apologises to Susannah, and convinces her to leave the children with him for three months. The tenants on the parade are annoyed when Barry raises their rent.

videos.title: Episode 1265 - Bursting Point
videos.overview: Ron and Max both fear that they are all about to be caught out over things they shouldn't have done. Beth runs out of her Chemistry "A" level exam.

videos.title: Episode 1266 - All Families Have Secrets
videos.overview: Keith develops the photographs of a somewhat naked Ron and Bev. Max is sure that David will tell Patricia that Susannah stayed overnight. Sinbad tries to help the Jordaches out of their predicament. Barry finds his belongings dumped in the street.

videos.title: Episode 1267 - Developing
videos.overview: Ron and Bev try to retrieve the incriminating photographs before Mike sees them. Max admits to David that he slept with Susannah. Peter discovers that Anna has been lying.

videos.title: Episode 1268 - Wrong Conclusions
videos.overview: Anna makes a controversial confession about her job. Mandy and the girls go off on holiday. Joe forces Barry to sign away his share of the nightclub.

videos.title: Episode 1269 - Applications
videos.overview: Barry's plans to gain his revenge by torching the nightclub are spoiled by Jimmy. Ron delegates David the task of preparing a shortlist of applicants for the job in the florists'.

videos.title: Episode 1270 - Options
videos.overview: Peter finds Anna's savings, and suspects the worst. Jimmy wants revenge on Barry, and Joe is able to arrange it.

videos.title: Episode 1271 - Knocking Off Early
videos.overview: Barry doesn't realise that he is being set up, and the consequences for Jimmy could be deadly. Julia is pipped at the post for the job in the flower shop. Peter has to rescue Anna from a difficult situation.

videos.title: Episode 1272 - Barry Grant Did This
videos.overview: Jimmy is in hospital, and is convinced that Barry is responsible. Peter tries to convince Anna that sleeping with men for money is immoral. Bev asks Ron for money.

videos.title: Episode 1273 - In Trouble
videos.overview: Mike is looking forward to a holiday abroad, until Bev has some news for him that he was not expecting. Max finally goes to the doctor, but what he is told doesn't make him feel any better.

videos.title: Episode 1274 - Somebody Else's Fault
videos.overview: Mike confides in Keith about his predicament, and Keith decides that someone else may have just as much right to know about it. David is pursued by an unwanted admirer.

videos.title: Episode 1275 - Is There A Future?
videos.overview: Barry feels cornered, and leaves himself vulnerable. Ron is pleased with Bev's news, but she is not so happy about it. David is convinced that Max is faking illness in order to avoid confessing to Patricia.

videos.title: Episode 1276 - Cruising For A Bruising
videos.overview: Mike considers selling his guitar so that he can pay for an abortion for Bev. Patricia collects Max from hospital, then throws him out of her car. Barry plans to repair his damaged jeep with Sinbad's help, but finds that it has disappeared.

videos.title: Episode 1277 - Raring To Go
videos.overview: Marianne is optimistic that her interview went well. Ron discovers that Mike is distributing copies of photographs that he would prefer to be kept private. David discovers that Jean isn't going to the dance with him and Julia.

videos.title: Episode 1278 - Scared
videos.overview: Ron asks Bev to move in with him. Patricia decides to divorce Max. Barry explains to Oscar how he has been set up by Joe.

videos.title: Episode 1279 - Believe Me!
videos.overview: Oscar takes Jimmy under his wing, Patricia is not interested in Max's excuses, Jacqui packs her bags, and Peter fails to make Anna reconsider her chosen profession.

videos.title: Episode 1280 - Change Your Mind
videos.overview: The case against Barry begins to fall apart. Patricia wonders if she is doing the right thing by divorcing Max.

videos.title: Episode 1281 - Raised Voices
videos.overview: Bev moves the last of her stuff into Ron's, but a visit from Lyn turns into a catfight. Anna is out on the streets, and soon gets an offer she really can't refuse.

videos.title: Episode 1282 - Reopening
videos.overview: Max doesn't like it when he sees Patricia on the arm of another man. Just as things appear to have calmed down for the Jordaches, an unexpected visitor appears.......

videos.title: Episode 1283 - Unsolved Mysteries
videos.overview: Mandy and Beth return from their holiday, and face some more awkward questions. Barry is suspicious of Oscar. Max is desperate to win Patricia back, and tries everything he can - but will it be enough?

videos.title: Episode 1284 - Boyfriends
videos.overview: Marianne starts her new job. Jimmy catches some young drug dealers in the club. When Terry receives a dinner invitation, he invites Sinbad to be his partner.

videos.title: Episode 1285 - Drugs
videos.overview: Max's jealousy gets the better of him. Sinbad plucks up the courage to ask Mandy to join him at a dance.

videos.title: Episode 1286 - I Want The House
videos.overview: Patricia moves back in, and throws Max out. Terry finds a dance partner. Jacqui moves back into the Dixons'. Jimmy is told to turn a blind eye.

videos.title: Episode 1287 - Cosy Nights In
videos.overview: The Farnhams' divorce becomes more acrimonious, but Terry is very taken with Anna. Brian asks Jimmy for more information about the drug dealers.

videos.title: Episode 1288 - Lust
videos.overview: Patricia has nothing but contempt for Max. The police revisit the Jordaches. Mike and Jacqui have a plan, but Sister Mary Joseph does not approve.

videos.title: Episode 1289 - Effects
videos.overview: Mandy and Beth are called to the police station to identify a body, which could be the perfect opportunity for them. Mick is jealous of Charles. Max finds that Patricia has changed the locks.

videos.title: Episode 1290 - Misplaced Optimism
videos.overview: Mandy has a funeral to arrange. David gives Jacqui and Mike a lift to Pwllheli.

videos.title: Episode 1291 - Second Round
videos.overview: There is a very strained atmosphere between Max and Patricia. David and Julia trip the light fantastic. The house is too crowded for Ron and Bev.

videos.title: Episode 1292 - Tormented
videos.overview: It is the day of the funeral of "Trevor", but Mandy doubts whether she can go through with it. The pressure placed on her by Jacqui and Mike becomes too much for Bev to take. Mick and Marianne argue.

videos.title: Episode 1293 - Concern
videos.overview: Ron is desperately seeking Bev, while she is secretly seeing Lyn. Peter suspects that Anna is beginning to enjoy her new line of work. Sinbad and Mandy realise that there is only one way that they can satisfy Brenna.

videos.title: Episode 1294 - Happy Birthday, Beth
videos.overview: Beth has to spend part of her 18th birthday digging up the garden to retrieve a ring from her dead father's finger. Anna has arranged a date with Terry, and doesn't want to be in the club when the birthday group arrive.

videos.title: Episode 1295 - The Wrong Idea
videos.overview: Mandy is finally able to get rid of Brenna, but it leads to a misunderstanding with Sinbad. Terry is curious about what a marriage of convenience would involve.

videos.title: Episode 1296 - Game, Set And Match
videos.overview: Ron searches high and low for Bev to prevent her from having an abortion, and his desperation drives him to do a few stupid things.

videos.title: Episode 1297 - Objections
videos.overview: Mandy turns to Sinbad, and involves him even more deeply in her problems. Keith encourages Peter to tell Beth about his rape trial before she finds out from someone else.

videos.title: Episode 1298 - Interrupting
videos.overview: Anna is disappointed that Peter appears keen to have a relationship with Beth. While driving Bev home from the Legion, Frank has a heart attack.

videos.title: Episode 1299 - No Naughties
videos.overview: Jackie agrees to help out in the club, but is horrified to find out what is going on. Mick sees a new side of Garry. Anna leaves Peter and moves in with Terry. Beth is scared by memories of the past.

videos.title: Episode 1300 - Don't Do That
videos.overview: Sinbad continues with his plan to help the Jordaches. Peter and Beth seal their relationship. Charles' desire overcomes him, which makes life difficult for Marianne.

videos.title: Episode 1301 - I Can't Take This
videos.overview: Cracks are appearing in the Farnham house. Mandy feels obliged to tell Beth what she has found out about Peter. Marianne's problems at work get worse. Katie tells Frank her plans, and doesn't get the response she expected.

videos.title: Episode 1302 - Souvenir
videos.overview: Brian invites Patricia to an opening do. Marianne has a fight on her hands. Frank gets a warm welcome home from everyone.......except Alison.

videos.title: Episode 1303 - Gatecrashing
videos.overview: Jackie is curious about why Brian has invited Jimmy to a party. Anna, aware of Barry's impending return, suggests to Terry that she should leave his flat, and he proposes to her.

videos.title: Episode 1304 - Disappearing Act
videos.overview: Patricia has first-date nerves. Marianne has even more problems with Charles at work. Alison comes home from school, and sneaks out to David's while Frank is asleep.

videos.title: Episode 1305 - Extravagance
videos.overview: Patricia has another date, in which she takes things a stage further. Frank buys Alison an expensive computer to try to encourage her to support his plans to marry Lyn.

videos.title: Episode 1306 - All My Fault
videos.overview: David takes Alison under his wing, which just makes things more difficult for Lyn and Frank. Charles is relieved to hear that Mick knows nothing about the reason for Marianne's resignation.

videos.title: Episode 1307 - Cannon Fodder
videos.overview: Mick's remarks to Charles make Marianne feel that she has only one remaining option. Peter decides to go with Margaret to Oxford for a couple of weeks. Barry tries to find out why Terry is marrying Anna.

videos.title: Episode 1308 - So Naive
videos.overview: Mick wants to know the truth about Marianne and Charles. Anna and Terry fell embarrassed when everyone congratulates them on their forthcoming marriage.

videos.title: Episode 1309 - Sulking
videos.overview: Marianne and Mick both lose their appeals. Max returns home, and finds it isn't just his marriage that's cracked. Terry encourages Anna to show off the engagement ring he has bought her.

videos.title: Episode 1310 - Remember Me?
videos.overview: Mick is made to realise how wrong he was. Max is determined to speak to Patricia, even if it means that he has to steal a bicycle. Peter decides to stay in Oxford. A compromise is reached over Alison, and Frank has a surprise visitor.

videos.title: Episode 1311 - Not A Good Time
videos.overview: Mick finds out about Garry, and Geoff reveals what his problem is. Mike and Keith try to interest Barry in a new opportunity, and Max tries to persuade Patricia to think again.

videos.title: Episode 1312 - It Won't Work
videos.overview: When Barry spoils Terry and Anna's plans, she appeals to Peter to take her away with him. Steve advises Bev to leave Ron, and makes her a tempting offer. It looks like it is all over for Max and Patricia.

videos.title: Episode 1313 - Withdrawal Symptoms
videos.overview: Max is busy packing his things, when Patricia turns up. As their wedding day gets closer, life is far from uneventful for Lyn and Frank.

videos.title: Episode 1314 - Holding Back
videos.overview: Max is anxious to remarry as soon as possible, but Patricia is not sure. Steve tries to cause trouble between Bev and Ron.

videos.title: Episode 1315 - Whatever It Takes
videos.overview: Marianne considers Charles's offer and, with Mick's backing, gives him her decision. Lyn and Frank resolve to be with each other, come what may. Ron's credit card reaches its limit.

videos.title: Episode 1316 - Hot Air
videos.overview: Max is definitely up to something, and Patricia is getting suspicious. Mandy has some good news, and Jimmy gets an ear-bashing from Julia.

videos.title: Episode 1317 - Complaints
videos.overview: Ron is worried because he hasn't heard from Bev. Lyn lays down the law to Alison. PC Coban turns up to follow up a complaint made by Charles against Mick.

videos.title: Episode 1318 - School Concert
videos.overview: Frank's guitar comes in handy. and Terry is called to a hospital urgently when Anna is beaten up by one of her clients.

videos.title: Episode 1319 - Decisions
videos.overview: David needs to decide whether he will go to Max and Patricia's wedding, and Anna also has a decision to make. Ron learns the truth about Bev, and walks out on her.

videos.title: Episode 1320 - Jibbed
videos.overview: It is the final of the dancing championship in Preston, and most of the residents of the Close turn up to support David and Julia.

videos.title: Episode 1321 - Builders
videos.overview: An innocent good luck kiss is wrongly interpreted. Barry returns from his holiday, discovers that Anna and Terry have broken up, and is determined to find out why.

videos.title: Episode 1322 - Assurances
videos.overview: Anna and Barry come to a business arrangement, but both of them have conditions. It looks as if Charles will walk away scot-free - but Marianne has other plans.

videos.title: Episode 1323 - Careless Talk
videos.overview: Charles is smug in the knowledge that Marianne will drop the sexual harrassment charges, but there is still time for the smile to be wiped from his face. Anna insists that if she is to have an AIDS test, so must Barry.

videos.title: Episode 1324 - How's It Feel?
videos.overview: Mick and Marianne are celebrating, but Charles has the last word. Lyn is annoyed when Bev turns up at Frank's stag party.

videos.title: Episode 1325 - Avoiding
videos.overview: Barry and Anna receive their test results. Ron is depressed when DD sets out her terms, and Max and Patricia are unable to discover why Clive's cheque has bounced.

videos.title: Episode 1326 - You've Got To Tell Her
videos.overview: Jean and David find a crowd of waiting journalists when they arrive at Banbury. Jimmy is desperate to dump his stash of drugs, but Brian won't help him.

videos.title: Episode 1327 - We're Gonna Be Late
videos.overview: The Crosbies return home. DD and Bev come face to face at Lyn and Frank's wedding.

videos.title: Episode 1328 - You Caused This
videos.overview: The bad news is broken at the reception, and a distraught Lyn is at Frank's bedside when he dies. Jimmy decides he has got to get away.

videos.title: Episode 1329 - Speculation
videos.overview: A guilt-ridden Ron keeps vigil at Tony's bedside, praying that he will wake up. Lyn learns some horrifying details about the crash, but can't bear to tell Frank's children.

videos.title: Episode 1330 - Your Mum's Here
videos.overview: Keith manages to spend the night at the Farnhams'. A journalist arrives on the Crosbies' doorstep. Chrissy arrives to support her family.

videos.title: Episode 1331 - Comforting
videos.overview: Mandy can find no reason to prevent Rachel from going to see her father's grave. Mike begins to come to terms with what has happened to Tony.

videos.title: Episode 1332 - Sorrows
videos.overview: On the day of Frank's funeral, a secret is revealed.

videos.title: Episode 1333 - Claustrophobic
videos.overview: Anna hears the horrific truth about Barry. Sinbad convinces Mandy to have a night out. Adrian introduces Penny to someone she really didn't want to meet. David tries to obtain proof that Mike and Keith have been living with Margaret.

videos.title: Episode 1334 - First Date
videos.overview: Penny comes face-to-face with Mike and Keith, and David declares war.

videos.title: Episode 1335 - Paint
videos.overview: Ron is determined that Tony will pull through. The talent night is a great success. Terry tells Anna that he loves her.

videos.title: Episode 1336 - Kicking
videos.overview: Animosity continues at the Rogers' home, and between DD and Bev at the hospital. Terry and Anna go shopping. Mike and Keith move a piano into the Farnhams'.

videos.title: Episode 1337 - Moral Force
videos.overview: Mandy's obsession with the dead man in Trevor's grave makes Sinbad concerned that she will ruin everything. There is no good news for Penny, and when Jimmy visits the hospital he sees what he has done.

videos.title: Episode 1338 - Demanding
videos.overview: Jimmy returns to the club, wanting his job back. A letter from Derek raises Keith's hopes, but there is no hope for Penny.

videos.title: Episode 1339 - No Chance At All
videos.overview: Ron is ecstatic by what he sees at the hospital, but his elation soon turns to devastation. Things go from bad to worse in the Rogers', forcing Katie more towards her strange friend Simon.

videos.title: Episode 1340 - Jumble
videos.overview: Ron is determined to help Tony recover, no matter what the cost is. Jimmy breaks down, and turns to drugs to take his mind off his problems.

videos.title: Episode 1341 - For A Good Cause
videos.overview: Sinbad hints to Beth that he thinks something might be going on between Keith and Margaret, but Beth isn't admitting who she fancies. Mike sells his photo of Penny to the press.

videos.title: Episode 1342 - Two Can Play
videos.overview: Sinbad is determined to play matchmaker for Margaret and Keith, but only ends up losing some of his clothes.

videos.title: Episode 1343 - Not My Type
videos.overview: Penny's photograph appears in the newspaper. Katie has to choose between Simon and Jacqui. Beth reveals her true feelings, and Barry almost catches Jimmy in the act of taking drugs.

videos.title: Episode 1344 - Fighting
videos.overview: Anna and Terry decide that the wedding is on again. Beth breaks up Keith's romantic dinner. Jimmy is a hero, and everything comes to a head on the Rogers' staircase.......

videos.title: Episode 1345 - Fixing
videos.overview: The full implications of Lyn's fall become apparent, which doesn't improve the atmosphere at the Rogers'. How the photograph of Penny got into the wrong hands becomes clear.

videos.title: Episode 1346 - Horizons
videos.overview: Lyn is surprised by a visitor. David wastes no time making his feelings known at the Farnhams'. Ron receives more bad news at the hospital.

videos.title: Episode 1347 - Not Long Now
videos.overview: Katie has a decision to make. Terry and Anna set a date for their wedding, but Barry has other plans. Sinbad suddenly deduces who it is that Beth fancies.

videos.title: Episode 1348 - Redirecting
videos.overview: Mick sides with Carol when Marianne has some bad news. Terry asks Sinbad and Simon to be secret witnesses for his wedding. When Jackie flushes Jimmy's drugs down the toilet, he confesses why he needs them.

videos.title: Episode 1349 - Baptism
videos.overview: Beth declares her feelings for Margaret. A broken and inconsolable Jimmy goes on a bender. Bev has a Christmas Day she is not likely to forget.

videos.title: Episode 1350 - Strong Feelings
